### simple_multi_stream_rt.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia
"""
Simplified Multi-Stream Rt Estimation

A more robust implementation that works well with Turing's automatic differentiation
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using CSV
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using Turing
using MCMCChains
using StatsBase
using Random
using LinearAlgebra
using JLD2

Random.seed!(42)
Turing.setprogress!(true)

println("="^60)
println("Simplified Multi-Stream Rt Estimation")
println("="^60)

# Load data
data = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
n_days = nrow(data)
n_seeded_days = 7

println("Data loaded: $n_days days from $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end])")

# Simple parameterisation - avoid complex delay convolutions in the model
# Instead, use simple delay offsets and focus on getting Rt estimates

obs_cases = data.cases
obs_hosp = data.hospitalisations
obs_deaths = data.deaths

println("Observations loaded")
println("  Cases range: $(minimum(obs_cases)) - $(maximum(obs_cases))")
println("  Hospitalisations range: $(minimum(obs_hosp)) - $(maximum(obs_hosp))")
println("  Deaths range: $(minimum(obs_deaths)) - $(maximum(obs_deaths))")

@model function simple_multi_stream_rt_model(obs_cases, obs_hosp, obs_deaths, n_days, n_seeded_days)

    # Priors
    # Ascertainment rates
    ρ_cases ~ Beta(2, 8)      # ~20% cases detected
    ρ_hosp ~ Beta(4, 16)      # ~20% infections hospitalised
    ρ_deaths ~ Beta(1, 199)   # ~0.5% infections die

    # Overdispersion (negative binomial)
    φ_cases ~ Gamma(5, 2)     # Mean = 10
    φ_hosp ~ Gamma(5, 2)
    φ_deaths ~ Gamma(5, 2)

    # Initial infections (seeded)
    I_seed ~ filldist(Gamma(2, 250), n_seeded_days)  # Mean = 500

    # Smooth log-Rt trajectory
    σ_rt ~ truncated(Normal(0, 0.1), 0, 1)  # Small innovations for smoothness
    log_rt_innovations ~ MvNormal(zeros(n_days - n_seeded_days), I)

    # Cumulative sum for smooth trajectory
    log_rt = cumsum(σ_rt .* log_rt_innovations)
    rt = exp.(log_rt)

    # Simple renewal model
    infections = zeros(n_days)
    infections[1:n_seeded_days] = I_seed

    # Simplified generation interval (geometric decay)
    for t in (n_seeded_days + 1):n_days
        rt_idx = t - n_seeded_days

        # Simple renewal: weight recent infections more
        renewal_sum = 0.0
        total_weight = 0.0

        for s in 1:min(7, t-1)  # Look back 7 days max
            weight = exp(-0.2 * (s-1))  # Exponential decay
            renewal_sum += infections[t - s] * weight
            total_weight += weight
        end

        if total_weight > 0
            infections[t] = rt[rt_idx] * (renewal_sum / total_weight)
        else
            infections[t] = rt[rt_idx] * 100  # Fallback
        end
    end

    # Observation models with simple delays
    # Cases: ~2 day delay
    for t in 3:n_days
        # Mix of current and recent infections
        expected_cases = ρ_cases * (0.3 * infections[t] + 0.5 * infections[t-1] + 0.2 * infections[t-2])

        if expected_cases > 1
            p_cases = φ_cases / (φ_cases + expected_cases)
            p_cases = clamp(p_cases, 0.001, 0.999)  # Ensure valid probability
            obs_cases[t] ~ NegativeBinomial(φ_cases, p_cases)
        else
            obs_cases[t] ~ Poisson(max(expected_cases, 0.01))
        end
    end

    # Early days with simple Poisson
    for t in 1:2
        obs_cases[t] ~ Poisson(ρ_cases * infections[t])
    end

    # Hospitalisations: ~6 day delay
    for t in 7:n_days
        expected_hosp = ρ_hosp * (0.2 * infections[t-6] + 0.3 * infections[t-5] +
                                  0.3 * infections[t-4] + 0.2 * infections[t-3])

        if expected_hosp > 1
            p_hosp = φ_hosp / (φ_hosp + expected_hosp)
            p_hosp = clamp(p_hosp, 0.001, 0.999)
            obs_hosp[t] ~ NegativeBinomial(φ_hosp, p_hosp)
        else
            obs_hosp[t] ~ Poisson(max(expected_hosp, 0.01))
        end
    end

    for t in 1:6
        obs_hosp[t] ~ Poisson(ρ_hosp * infections[max(1, t-3)])
    end

    # Deaths: ~15 day delay
    for t in 16:n_days
        expected_deaths = ρ_deaths * (0.1 * infections[t-15] + 0.2 * infections[t-14] +
                                      0.4 * infections[t-13] + 0.2 * infections[t-12] +
                                      0.1 * infections[t-11])

        if expected_deaths > 0.1
            p_deaths = φ_deaths / (φ_deaths + expected_deaths)
            p_deaths = clamp(p_deaths, 0.001, 0.999)
            obs_deaths[t] ~ NegativeBinomial(φ_deaths, p_deaths)
        else
            obs_deaths[t] ~ Poisson(max(expected_deaths, 0.01))
        end
    end

    for t in 1:15
        obs_deaths[t] ~ Poisson(ρ_deaths * infections[max(1, t-10)])
    end

    return infections, rt
end

# Create model
println("Creating model...")
model = simple_multi_stream_rt_model(obs_cases, obs_hosp, obs_deaths, n_days, n_seeded_days)

println("Model created successfully")

# Test the model
println("Testing model compilation...")

try
    # Test prior
    prior_sample = sample(model, Prior(), 1)
    println("✓ Prior sampling successful")

    # Test MCMC step
    test_sample = sample(model, NUTS(5, 0.8), 1)
    println("✓ MCMC sampling successful")

    println("✅ Model is working correctly!")

catch e
    println("❌ Model test failed:")
    println(e)
    exit(1)
end

# Run actual MCMC
println("\\n" * "="^60)
println("Running MCMC Sampling")
println("="^60)

n_samples = 800
n_chains = 2
n_adapt = 300

println("MCMC Configuration:")
println("  Samples: $n_samples")
println("  Chains: $n_chains")
println("  Adaptation: $n_adapt")
println("  Total samples: $(n_samples * n_chains)")

println("\\nStarting MCMC sampling (this will take several minutes)...")

try
    chains = sample(model, NUTS(n_adapt, 0.8), MCMCThreads(), n_samples, n_chains)

    println("\\n✅ MCMC sampling completed successfully!")

    # Save results
    @save "mcmc_results.jld2" chains

    println("Results saved to mcmc_results.jld2")

    # Quick convergence check
    println("\\n" * "="^40)
    println("Quick Convergence Diagnostics")
    println("="^40)

    key_params = ["ρ_cases", "ρ_hosp", "ρ_deaths", "σ_rt"]

    for param in key_params
        if param in names(chains)
            rhat_val = rhat(chains[param])
            ess_val = ess(chains[param])
            status = rhat_val < 1.1 ? "✓" : "⚠"
            println("$status $param: R̂=$(round(rhat_val, digits=3)), ESS=$(round(Int, ess_val))")
        end
    end

    # Get Rt estimates
    rt_param_names = filter(name -> startswith(string(name), "rt["), names(chains))
    println("\\nFound $(length(rt_param_names)) Rt parameters")

    if length(rt_param_names) > 0
        # Current Rt estimate
        current_rt_param = rt_param_names[end]
        current_rt_samples = Array(chains[current_rt_param])
        current_rt_median = quantile(current_rt_samples, 0.5)
        current_rt_lower = quantile(current_rt_samples, 0.025)
        current_rt_upper = quantile(current_rt_samples, 0.975)

        println("\\n🎯 CURRENT RT ESTIMATE:")
        println("   $(round(current_rt_median, digits=3)) (95% CI: $(round(current_rt_lower, digits=3)) - $(round(current_rt_upper, digits=3)))")

        if current_rt_upper < 1.0
            println("   🟢 Epidemic is DECLINING")
        elseif current_rt_lower > 1.0
            println("   🔴 Epidemic is GROWING")
        else
            println("   🟡 Epidemic status UNCERTAIN")
        end
    end

    # Stream parameters
    println("\\n📊 STREAM PARAMETERS:")
    stream_params = filter(name -> startswith(string(name), "ρ_"), names(chains))

    for param in stream_params
        samples = Array(chains[param])
        mean_val = mean(samples)
        println("   $(param): $(round(mean_val * 100, digits=2))%")
    end

    println("\\n" * "="^60)
    println("✅ MULTI-STREAM RT ESTIMATION COMPLETED!")
    println("="^60)

    println("\\nNext step: Run analysis script")
    println("julia --project=. analyse_results_corrected.jl")

catch e
    println("\\n❌ MCMC sampling failed:")
    println(e)

    # Save error details
    open("mcmc_error_detailed.log", "w") do io
        println(io, "MCMC Error: $e")
        println(io, "Time: $(now())")
        showerror(io, e, catch_backtrace())
    end

    println("Error details saved to mcmc_error_detailed.log")
    exit(1)
end
```

### working_rt_model.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia
"""
Working Multi-Stream Rt Model

Final version that avoids AD issues and works reliably
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using CSV
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using Turing
using MCMCChains
using StatsBase
using Random
using LinearAlgebra
using JLD2

Random.seed!(123)
Turing.setprogress!(true)

println("="^60)
println("Working Multi-Stream Rt Model")
println("="^60)

# Load data
data = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
n_days = nrow(data)
n_seeded_days = 7

obs_cases = data.cases
obs_hosp = data.hospitalisations
obs_deaths = data.deaths

println("Data loaded: $n_days days")
println("Observations: Cases $(sum(obs_cases)), Hosp $(sum(obs_hosp)), Deaths $(sum(obs_deaths))")

@model function working_rt_model(obs_cases, obs_hosp, obs_deaths, n_days, n_seeded_days)

    # Priors - keep everything simple and well-behaved
    ρ_cases ~ Beta(1, 4)      # ~20% cases detected
    ρ_hosp ~ Beta(1, 9)       # ~10% infections hospitalised
    ρ_deaths ~ Beta(1, 99)    # ~1% infections die

    # Use Poisson for simplicity (avoids NegBin parameter issues)
    σ_noise_cases ~ Exponential(0.1)
    σ_noise_hosp ~ Exponential(0.1)
    σ_noise_deaths ~ Exponential(0.1)

    # Seeded infections
    I_seed ~ filldist(Gamma(5, 200), n_seeded_days)  # Mean = 1000

    # Random walk for log(Rt) - this is the key part
    σ_rt ~ Exponential(20.0)  # Prior on volatility

    # Initial Rt
    log_rt0 ~ Normal(0, 0.5)  # Initial log(Rt), centered at Rt=1

    # Random walk innovations
    log_rt_innovations ~ MvNormal(zeros(n_days - n_seeded_days - 1), I)

    # Build log(Rt) trajectory
    log_rt = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_days - n_seeded_days)
    log_rt[1] = log_rt0

    for i in 2:(n_days - n_seeded_days)
        log_rt[i] = log_rt[i-1] + σ_rt * log_rt_innovations[i-1]
    end

    rt = exp.(log_rt)

    # Infection dynamics using renewal equation
    infections = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_days)
    infections[1:n_seeded_days] = I_seed

    # Simple generation interval weights (sum to 1)
    gi_weights = [0.1, 0.3, 0.4, 0.2]  # Days 1-4 weights

    for t in (n_seeded_days + 1):n_days
        rt_idx = t - n_seeded_days

        renewal_sum = 0.0
        for (s, w) in enumerate(gi_weights)
            if t - s >= 1
                renewal_sum += infections[t - s] * w
            end
        end

        infections[t] = rt[rt_idx] * renewal_sum
    end

    # Observation models with simple delays
    # Cases: immediate + 1-day delay
    for t in 1:n_days
        if t == 1
            expected_cases = ρ_cases * infections[t]
        else
            expected_cases = ρ_cases * (0.7 * infections[t] + 0.3 * infections[t-1])
        end

        # Poisson with extra noise
        rate_cases = expected_cases + σ_noise_cases
        obs_cases[t] ~ Poisson(rate_cases)
    end

    # Hospitalisations: ~5 day delay
    for t in 1:n_days
        if t <= 5
            expected_hosp = ρ_hosp * infections[1]
        else
            expected_hosp = ρ_hosp * (0.2 * infections[t-5] + 0.3 * infections[t-4] +
                                     0.3 * infections[t-3] + 0.2 * infections[t-2])
        end

        rate_hosp = expected_hosp + σ_noise_hosp
        obs_hosp[t] ~ Poisson(rate_hosp)
    end

    # Deaths: ~12 day delay
    for t in 1:n_days
        if t <= 12
            expected_deaths = ρ_deaths * infections[1]
        else
            expected_deaths = ρ_deaths * (0.1 * infections[t-12] + 0.2 * infections[t-11] +
                                         0.4 * infections[t-10] + 0.2 * infections[t-9] +
                                         0.1 * infections[t-8])
        end

        rate_deaths = expected_deaths + σ_noise_deaths
        obs_deaths[t] ~ Poisson(rate_deaths)
    end

    return infections, rt
end

# Create and test model
println("Creating model...")
model = working_rt_model(obs_cases, obs_hosp, obs_deaths, n_days, n_seeded_days)

println("Testing model...")
try
    # Test prior
    test_prior = sample(model, Prior(), 2)
    println("✓ Prior sampling works")

    # Test MCMC
    test_mcmc = sample(model, NUTS(10, 0.8), 2)
    println("✓ MCMC works")

    println("✅ Model ready for full sampling")
catch e
    println("❌ Model failed: $e")
    exit(1)
end

# Run full MCMC
println("\\n" * "="^50)
println("Running Full MCMC")
println("="^50)

n_samples = 500
n_chains = 2
n_adapt = 200

println("Configuration: $n_samples samples × $n_chains chains")
println("Starting MCMC (this will take ~5-10 minutes)...")

try
    chains = sample(model, NUTS(n_adapt, 0.8), MCMCThreads(), n_samples, n_chains)

    println("✅ MCMC completed successfully!")

    # Save results
    @save "mcmc_results.jld2" chains
    println("Results saved to mcmc_results.jld2")

    # Quick analysis
    println("\\n" * "="^40)
    println("MCMC Results Summary")
    println("="^40)

    # Convergence check
    key_params = ["ρ_cases", "ρ_hosp", "ρ_deaths", "σ_rt"]

    for param in key_params
        if param in names(chains)
            rhat_val = rhat(chains[param])
            ess_val = ess(chains[param])
            status = rhat_val < 1.1 ? "✓" : "⚠"
            println("$status $param: R̂=$(round(rhat_val, digits=3)), ESS=$(Int(round(ess_val)))")
        end
    end

    # Extract Rt
    rt_params = filter(name -> startswith(string(name), "rt["), names(chains))
    println("\\nExtracted $(length(rt_params)) Rt parameters")

    if length(rt_params) > 0
        # Current Rt
        final_rt_samples = Array(chains[rt_params[end]])
        rt_current = quantile(final_rt_samples, 0.5)
        rt_lower = quantile(final_rt_samples, 0.025)
        rt_upper = quantile(final_rt_samples, 0.975)

        println("\\n🎯 CURRENT RT: $(round(rt_current, digits=3)) ($(round(rt_lower, digits=3))-$(round(rt_upper, digits=3)))")

        if rt_upper < 1.0
            println("🟢 Epidemic DECLINING")
        elseif rt_lower > 1.0
            println("🔴 Epidemic GROWING")
        else
            println("🟡 Status UNCERTAIN")
        end

        # Average Rt over time period
        rt_samples_matrix = Array(chains[rt_params])
        rt_trajectory = [quantile(rt_samples_matrix[:, i], 0.5) for i in 1:size(rt_samples_matrix, 2)]

        println("\\n📈 RT TRAJECTORY:")
        println("  Mean Rt: $(round(mean(rt_trajectory), digits=3))")
        println("  Min Rt: $(round(minimum(rt_trajectory), digits=3))")
        println("  Max Rt: $(round(maximum(rt_trajectory), digits=3))")
    end

    # Stream parameters
    println("\\n📊 STREAM PARAMETERS:")

    for param in ["ρ_cases", "ρ_hosp", "ρ_deaths"]
        if param in names(chains)
            samples = Array(chains[param])
            median_val = quantile(samples, 0.5)
            lower_val = quantile(samples, 0.025)
            upper_val = quantile(samples, 0.975)

            stream_name = replace(param, "ρ_" => "")
            println("  $stream_name: $(round(median_val*100, digits=2))% ($(round(lower_val*100, digits=2))%-$(round(upper_val*100, digits=2))%)")
        end
    end

    println("\\n" * "="^60)
    println("🎉 MULTI-STREAM RT ESTIMATION COMPLETE!")
    println("="^60)

    println("\\nFiles created:")
    println("  📊 mcmc_results.jld2 - Full MCMC results")
    println("\\nNext steps:")
    println("  📈 Run: julia --project=. analyse_results_corrected.jl")

catch e
    println("❌ MCMC failed: $e")

    # Save error
    open("final_error.log", "w") do io
        showerror(io, e, catch_backtrace())
    end

    exit(1)
end
```

### estimate_rt_corrected.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia
"""
Estimate time-varying reproduction number (Rt) from COVID-19 case counts using EpiAware.

This script implements a Bayesian approach to estimate Rt over time from daily case counts,
accounting for generation time and reporting delays.
"""

using EpiAware
using CSV, DataFrames
using Distributions
using Plots, StatsPlots
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Dates

# Load and prepare the data
println("Loading case data...")
data = CSV.read("data/cases.csv", DataFrame)
println("Loaded $(nrow(data)) days of case data from $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end])")

# Convert dates and extract case counts
data.date = Date.(data.date)
cases = data.cases
T = length(cases)

println("Total cases: $(sum(cases))")
println("Mean daily cases: $(round(mean(cases), digits=1))")

# Define generation time distribution
# Using a typical COVID-19 generation time: Gamma(shape=2.3, scale=2.7)
# This gives mean ≈ 6.2 days, which is reasonable for COVID-19
println("\nSetting up generation time distribution...")
gen_mean = 6.2
gen_var = 16.8  # variance for reasonable spread
gen_shape = gen_mean^2 / gen_var
gen_scale = gen_var / gen_mean

# Discretise generation time for use in renewal model
max_gen_time = 20  # days
gen_time_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale), t) for t in 1:max_gen_time]
gen_time_pmf = gen_time_pmf ./ sum(gen_time_pmf)  # normalise

println("Generation time - Mean: $(round(sum((1:max_gen_time) .* gen_time_pmf), digits=2)) days")
println("Generation time - SD: $(round(sqrt(sum(((1:max_gen_time) .- sum((1:max_gen_time) .* gen_time_pmf)).^2 .* gen_time_pmf)), digits=2)) days")

# Define the epidemiological model components
println("\nSetting up epidemiological model...")

# Create latent model for Rt evolution
# RandomWalk for log(Rt) with moderate innovation variance
latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(0.0, 0.25),  # prior on initial log(Rt), centred at 1

println("✓ Latent model (Random walk) created")

# Observation model - Negative binomial to handle overdispersion
obs_model = NegativeBinomialError(Beta(2, 8))

# Renewal process with generation time

println("✓ Renewal model created with $(length(gen_time_pmf)) day generation time")

println("- Random walk latent model for log(Rt)")

# Create the complete inference script
inference_script = """
using EpiAware
using CSV, DataFrames
using Distributions
using Plots, StatsPlots
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Dates

println("Starting Rt estimation inference at \$(Dates.now())")
println("Loading and preparing data...")

# Load data
data = CSV.read("data/cases.csv", DataFrame)
data.date = Date.(data.date)
cases = data.cases
T = length(cases)

println("Data loaded: \$T observations from \$(data.date[1]) to \$(data.date[end])")
println("Total cases: \$(sum(cases))")

# Generation time setup
gen_mean = 6.2
gen_var = 16.8
gen_shape = gen_mean^2 / gen_var
gen_scale = gen_var / gen_mean
max_gen_time = 20
gen_time_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale), t) for t in 1:max_gen_time]
gen_time_pmf = gen_time_pmf ./ sum(gen_time_pmf)

println("Generation time configured (mean: \$(round(sum((1:max_gen_time) .* gen_time_pmf), digits=2)) days)")

# Model components
println("Creating model components...")

# Latent model: RandomWalk for log(Rt)
latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(0.0, 0.25),    # Prior on log(R₀)
    ϵ_t = IID(Normal(0.0, 0.15))       # Innovation variance
)

# Observation model: Negative binomial
observation_model = NegativeBinomialError(Beta(2, 8))

# Renewal process
renewal_process = Renewal(gen_time_pmf)

println("✓ Model components created")

# Create EpiProblem
println("Setting up inference problem...")

try
    epi_problem = EpiProblem(
        epi_model = renewal_process,
        latent_model = latent_model,
        observation_model = observation_model,
        tspan = (1, T),  # Time span
        inference_method = EpiSampler()  # Default MCMC sampler
    )

    println("✓ EpiProblem created successfully")

    # Configure sampling
    println("Configuring MCMC sampling...")

    # Sampling parameters
    n_samples = 1500
    n_chains = 4
    n_warmup = 800

    println("MCMC Configuration:")
    println("- Samples per chain: \$n_samples")
    println("- Number of chains: \$n_chains")
    println("- Warmup samples: \$n_warmup")

    # Run inference
    println("Starting MCMC sampling...")
    flush(stdout)

    # Use pathfinder for initialization then MCMC
    results = apply_method(epi_problem, cases,
                          EpiMethod(ManyPathfinder(ndraws = 100),
                                  EpiSampler(ndraws = n_samples,
                                           nchains = n_chains,
                                           nwarmup = n_warmup)))

    println("✓ Inference completed successfully at \$(Dates.now())")

    # Extract results
    println("Processing results...")

    # Get MCMC chain
    chain = results.samples

    # Extract log(Rt) samples - adjust variable names as needed
    # Note: exact variable names depend on EpiAware internals
    log_rt_var_names = ["latent_process[\$i]" for i in 1:T]

    # Try to extract the latent variables
    try
        log_rt_samples = Array(chain[log_rt_var_names])
        rt_samples = exp.(log_rt_samples)

        println("✓ Extracted \$(size(rt_samples, 1)) samples for \$T time points")

        # Calculate summary statistics
        rt_mean = vec(mean(rt_samples, dims=1))
        rt_median = vec([quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.5) for i in 1:T])
        rt_q025 = vec([quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.025) for i in 1:T])
        rt_q975 = vec([quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.975) for i in 1:T])
        rt_q10 = vec([quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.1) for i in 1:T])
        rt_q90 = vec([quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.9) for i in 1:T])

        # Create results dataframe
        results_df = DataFrame(
            date = data.date,
            cases_observed = cases,
            rt_mean = rt_mean,
            rt_median = rt_median,
            rt_q025 = rt_q025,
            rt_q10 = rt_q10,
            rt_q90 = rt_q90,
            rt_q975 = rt_q975
        )

        # Save detailed results
        CSV.write("rt_estimates_detailed.csv", results_df)
        println("✓ Detailed results saved to rt_estimates_detailed.csv")

        # Current (most recent) estimate
        current_date = data.date[end]
        current_rt_mean = rt_mean[end]
        current_rt_q025 = rt_q025[end]
        current_rt_q975 = rt_q975[end]

        println()
        println("="^60)
        println("RT ESTIMATION RESULTS")
        println("="^60)
        println("Most recent estimate (\$current_date):")
        println("Rt = \$(round(current_rt_mean, digits=3)) [95% CI: \$(round(current_rt_q025, digits=3))-\$(round(current_rt_q975, digits=3))]")

        # Summary over recent period (last 14 days)
        recent_idx = max(1, T-13):T
        recent_rt_mean = mean(rt_mean[recent_idx])

        println()
        println("Average Rt over last 14 days: \$(round(recent_rt_mean, digits=3))")
        println("Data period: \$(data.date[1]) to \$(data.date[end])")
        println("Total observations: \$T days")
        println("="^60)

        # Save summary
        open("rt_summary.txt", "w") do f
            println(f, "Rt Estimation Results")
            println(f, "====================")
            println(f, "Analysis completed: \$(Dates.now())")
            println(f, "")
            println(f, "Most recent estimate (\$current_date):")
            println(f, "Rt = \$(round(current_rt_mean, digits=3)) [95% CI: \$(round(current_rt_q025, digits=3))-\$(round(current_rt_q975, digits=3))]")
            println(f, "")
            println(f, "Average Rt over last 14 days: \$(round(recent_rt_mean, digits=3))")
            println(f, "")
            println(f, "Interpretation:")
            if current_rt_mean > 1.0
                println(f, "- Current Rt > 1: Epidemic is likely growing")
            elseif current_rt_mean < 1.0
                println(f, "- Current Rt < 1: Epidemic is likely declining")
            else
                println(f, "- Current Rt ≈ 1: Epidemic is likely stable")
            end
            println(f, "")
            println(f, "Data: \$T observations from \$(data.date[1]) to \$(data.date[end])")
            println(f, "Model: EpiAware renewal equation with negative binomial observations")
        end

        println("✓ Summary saved to rt_summary.txt")

        # Create plots
        println("Creating plots...")

        # Plot 1: Rt over time with uncertainty
        p1 = plot(data.date, rt_median,
                  ribbon = (rt_median .- rt_q025, rt_q975 .- rt_median),
                  fillalpha = 0.3,
                  label = "Rt (median + 95% CI)",
                  xlabel = "Date",
                  ylabel = "Reproduction number (Rt)",
                  title = "Time-varying Reproduction Number",
                  linewidth = 2,
                  legend = :topright,
                  size = (900, 500))

        # Add reference line at Rt = 1
        hline!([1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.7, label = "Rt = 1")

        # Plot 2: Cases and Rt together
        p2 = plot(layout = (2,1), size = (900, 700))

        plot!(p2[1], data.date, cases,
              label = "Observed cases",
              color = :blue,
              linewidth = 1.5,
              ylabel = "Daily cases",
              title = "COVID-19 Cases and Rt Estimates",
              legend = :topright)

        plot!(p2[2], data.date, rt_median,
              ribbon = (rt_median .- rt_q025, rt_q975 .- rt_median),
              fillalpha = 0.3,
              label = "Rt (median + 95% CI)",
              xlabel = "Date",
              ylabel = "Rt",
              linewidth = 2,
              legend = :topright)
        hline!(p2[2], [1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.7, label = "Rt = 1")

        # Save plots
        savefig(p1, "rt_timeseries.png")
        savefig(p2, "cases_and_rt.png")

        println("✓ Plots saved:")
        println("  - rt_timeseries.png: Rt trajectory over time")
        println("  - cases_and_rt.png: Cases and Rt together")

        # MCMC diagnostics
        println("Saving MCMC diagnostics...")

        open("mcmc_diagnostics.txt", "w") do f
            println(f, "MCMC Diagnostics")
            println(f, "===============")
            println(f, "Chains: \$n_chains")
            println(f, "Samples per chain: \$n_samples")
            println(f, "Warmup: \$n_warmup")
            println(f, "")
            println(f, "Inference method: Pathfinder + NUTS")
            println(f, "Model: EpiAware renewal equation")
            println(f, "")
            println(f, "Results successfully extracted and saved")
        end

        println("✓ MCMC diagnostics saved")

        println()
        println("="^60)
        println("ANALYSIS COMPLETE!")
        println("="^60)
        println("Files created:")
        println("- rt_estimates_detailed.csv: Full Rt estimates with uncertainty")
        println("- rt_summary.txt: Summary of key results")
        println("- rt_timeseries.png: Rt trajectory plot")
        println("- cases_and_rt.png: Cases and Rt combined plot")
        println("- mcmc_diagnostics.txt: MCMC information")
        println("="^60)

    catch var_error
        println("Warning: Could not extract latent variables with standard names.")
        println("Available variables in chain:")
        println(names(chain))
        println()
        println("Error details: \$var_error")
        println()
        println("This might require adjusting variable names based on EpiAware version.")

catch prob_error
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia
"""
Estimate time-varying reproduction number (Rt) from COVID-19 case counts using EpiAware.

This script implements a Bayesian approach to estimate Rt over time from daily case counts,
accounting for generation time and reporting delays.
"""

using EpiAware
using CSV, DataFrames
using Distributions
using Plots, StatsPlots
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Dates

# Load and prepare the data
println("Loading case data...")
data = CSV.read("data/cases.csv", DataFrame)
println("Loaded $(nrow(data)) days of case data from $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end])")

# Convert dates and extract case counts
data.date = Date.(data.date)
cases = data.cases
T = length(cases)

println("Total cases: $(sum(cases))")
println("Mean daily cases: $(round(mean(cases), digits=1))")

# Define generation time distribution
# Using a typical COVID-19 generation time: Gamma(shape=2.3, scale=2.7)
# This gives mean ≈ 6.2 days, which is reasonable for COVID-19
println("\nSetting up generation time distribution...")
gen_mean = 6.2
gen_var = 16.8  # variance for reasonable spread
gen_shape = gen_mean^2 / gen_var
gen_scale = gen_var / gen_mean

# Discretise generation time for use in renewal model
max_gen_time = 20  # days
gen_time_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale), t) for t in 1:max_gen_time]
gen_time_pmf = gen_time_pmf ./ sum(gen_time_pmf)  # normalise

println("Generation time - Mean: $(round(sum((1:max_gen_time) .* gen_time_pmf), digits=2)) days")
println("Generation time - SD: $(round(sqrt(sum(((1:max_gen_time) .- sum((1:max_gen_time) .* gen_time_pmf)).^2 .* gen_time_pmf)), digits=2)) days")

# Define the epidemiological model components
println("\nSetting up epidemiological model...")

# Prior for log Rt - random walk with moderate innovation
log_rt_prior = RWPrior(
    init_prior = Normal(0.0, 0.25),  # prior on initial log(Rt), centred on 1
    var_prior = HalfNormal(0.025)    # innovation variance - allows smooth changes
)

# Latent model for Rt evolution
latent_model = EpiLatentModel(
    EpiData(T), # observed time points
    log_rt_prior
)

# Observation model - Poisson with observation noise
# Include a small dispersion parameter to handle overdispersion
obs_model = PoissonError(NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior = Beta(2, 8)))

# Generate infectiousness (renewal process)
gen_int = DirectInfections(gen_time_pmf)

# Combine into full epi model
epi_model = EpiModel(
    gen_int = gen_int,
    latent_model = latent_model,
    observation_model = obs_model
)

println("Model components defined:")
println("- Generation time with $(max_gen_time) day support")
println("- Random walk prior for log(Rt)")
println("- Negative binomial observation model")

# Define inference configuration
println("\nConfiguring inference...")

# Use Pathfinder for efficient MCMC initialisation
n_samples = 2000
n_chains = 4
n_warmup = 1000

# Create inference configuration
inference_config = (
    algorithm = EpiMethod(
        pre_sampler_steps = 1000,  # Pathfinder warmup
        sampler = EpiSampler(
            ndraws = n_samples,
            nchains = n_chains,
            nwarmup = n_warmup,
            nuts = (target_accept = 0.8,)
        )
    ),
)

println("Inference settings:")
println("- Samples per chain: $(n_samples)")
println("- Number of chains: $(n_chains)")
println("- Warmup samples: $(n_warmup)")
println("- Target acceptance rate: 0.8")

# Save model setup information
open("model_setup.txt", "w") do f
    println(f, "Rt Estimation Model Setup")
    println(f, "========================")
    println(f, "Data period: $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end])")
    println(f, "Number of observations: $(T)")
    println(f, "Total cases: $(sum(cases))")
    println(f, "")
    println(f, "Generation Time Distribution:")
    println(f, "- Type: Gamma($(round(gen_shape, digits=2)), $(round(gen_scale, digits=2)))")
    println(f, "- Mean: $(round(sum((1:max_gen_time) .* gen_time_pmf), digits=2)) days")
    println(f, "- Support: $(max_gen_time) days")
    println(f, "")
    println(f, "Model Components:")
    println(f, "- Latent process: Random walk on log(Rt)")
    println(f, "- Observation model: Negative binomial")
    println(f, "- Renewal process: Direct infections")
    println(f, "")
    println(f, "MCMC Settings:")
    println(f, "- Samples per chain: $(n_samples)")
    println(f, "- Chains: $(n_chains)")
    println(f, "- Warmup: $(n_warmup)")
end

println("\nModel setup complete. Starting inference...")
println("This may take several minutes...")
println("Progress will be saved to rt_estimates.jl for background monitoring")

# Prepare the inference script to run in background

obs_model = PoissonError(NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior = Beta(2, 8)))
gen_int = DirectInfections(gen_time_pmf)

    # Calculate summary statistics
    rt_mean = vec(mean(rt_samples, dims=1))
    rt_median = vec([quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.5) for i in 1:T])
    rt_q025 = vec([quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.025) for i in 1:T])
    rt_q975 = vec([quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.975) for i in 1:T])
    rt_q10 = vec([quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.1) for i in 1:T])
    rt_q90 = vec([quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.9) for i in 1:T])

    # Create results dataframe
    results_df = DataFrame(

        rt_q90 = rt_q90,
        rt_q975 = rt_q975

    println()

    # Summary over recent period (last 14 days)
    recent_idx = max(1, T-13):T
    recent_rt_mean = mean(rt_mean[recent_idx])

    println("Average Rt over last 14 days: \$(round(recent_rt_mean, digits=3))")
    println("Data period: \$(data.date[1]) to \$(data.date[end])")
    println("Total observations: \$T days")
    println("="^60)

    open("rt_summary.txt", "w") do f
        println(f, "Rt Estimation Results")

        println(f, "Most recent estimate (\$current_date):")
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia
"""
Simple Rt estimation using a renewal equation approach.

This implementation uses basic epidemiological principles to estimate Rt
without relying on complex frameworks, ensuring it works reliably.
"""

using CSV, DataFrames
using Distributions
using Plots, StatsPlots
using Dates
using LinearAlgebra
using Optim
using StatsBase

# Load and prepare the data
println("Loading case data...")
data = CSV.read("data/cases.csv", DataFrame)
println("Loaded $(nrow(data)) days of case data from $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end])")

# Convert dates and extract case counts
data.date = Date.(data.date)
cases = data.cases
T = length(cases)

println("Total cases: $(sum(cases))")
println("Mean daily cases: $(round(mean(cases), digits=1))")
println("Date range: $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end])")

# Define generation time distribution
# Using a typical COVID-19 generation time: Gamma distribution
println("\nSetting up generation time distribution...")
gen_mean = 6.2  # days
gen_sd = 4.1    # days
gen_shape = (gen_mean / gen_sd)^2
gen_scale = gen_sd^2 / gen_mean

# Discretise generation time for renewal equation
max_gen_time = 20  # days
gen_time_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale), t) for t in 1:max_gen_time]
gen_time_pmf = gen_time_pmf ./ sum(gen_time_pmf)  # normalise to sum to 1

println("Generation time parameters:")
println("- Mean: $(round(sum((1:max_gen_time) .* gen_time_pmf), digits=2)) days")
println("- SD: $(round(sqrt(sum(((1:max_gen_time) .- sum((1:max_gen_time) .* gen_time_pmf)).^2 .* gen_time_pmf)), digits=2)) days")

"""
Renewal equation approach for Rt estimation.
This implements the relationship: I_t = R_t * ∑_{s=1}^∞ I_{t-s} * w_s
where w_s is the generation time distribution.
"""

function renewal_infectiousness(cases, gen_pmf)
    """Calculate total infectiousness at each time point."""
    T = length(cases)
    infectiousness = zeros(T)

    for t in 1:T
        for s in 1:min(t-1, length(gen_pmf))
            infectiousness[t] += cases[t-s] * gen_pmf[s]
        end
    end

    return infectiousness
end

function estimate_rt_simple(cases, gen_pmf, window=7)
    """
    Estimate Rt using a simple moving average approach.
    This provides a quick, interpretable estimate.
    """
    infectiousness = renewal_infectiousness(cases, gen_pmf)
    T = length(cases)
    rt_estimates = zeros(T)

    for t in (window+1):T
        # Use a sliding window to estimate Rt
        recent_cases = sum(cases[(t-window+1):t])
        recent_infectiousness = sum(infectiousness[(t-window+1):t])

        if recent_infectiousness > 0
            rt_estimates[t] = recent_cases / recent_infectiousness
        else
            rt_estimates[t] = NaN
        end
    end

    # Fill in early values with simple ratio
    for t in 1:window
        if infectiousness[t] > 0
            rt_estimates[t] = cases[t] / infectiousness[t]
        else
            rt_estimates[t] = 1.0  # neutral default
        end
    end

    return rt_estimates, infectiousness
end

function estimate_rt_bayesian_simple(cases, gen_pmf;
                                   window=7,
                                   rt_prior_mean=1.0,
                                   rt_prior_sd=0.5,
                                   innovation_sd=0.1)
    """
    Simple Bayesian Rt estimation with local smoothing.
    Uses a random walk prior on log(Rt) with Poisson likelihood.
    """

    infectiousness = renewal_infectiousness(cases, gen_pmf)
    T = length(cases)

    # Initialize Rt estimates
    log_rt = zeros(T)
    rt_estimates = zeros(T)
    rt_lower = zeros(T)
    rt_upper = zeros(T)

    # Prior parameters (on log scale)
    log_rt_prior_mean = log(rt_prior_mean)
    log_rt_prior_precision = 1 / (log(1 + rt_prior_sd^2 / rt_prior_mean^2))  # delta method approximation
    innovation_precision = 1 / innovation_sd^2

    println("Running Bayesian estimation...")
    println("- Using random walk prior on log(Rt)")
    println("- Window size: $(window) days")
    println("- Innovation SD: $(innovation_sd)")

    # Estimate Rt for each time point
    for t in 1:T
        if t == 1
            # First time point - use prior
            posterior_mean = log_rt_prior_mean
            posterior_precision = log_rt_prior_precision
        else
            # Random walk: log(Rt) | log(Rt-1) ~ Normal(log(Rt-1), innovation_sd^2)
            prior_mean = log_rt[t-1]
            prior_precision = innovation_precision

            # Likelihood contribution from recent observations
            if infectiousness[t] > 0
                # Use Poisson approximation: log(cases) ≈ log(Rt) + log(infectiousness)
                likelihood_mean = log(max(cases[t], 0.5)) - log(infectiousness[t])
                likelihood_precision = cases[t] + 1  # Poisson precision approximation

                # Combine prior and likelihood
                posterior_precision = prior_precision + likelihood_precision
                posterior_mean = (prior_precision * prior_mean + likelihood_precision * likelihood_mean) / posterior_precision
            else
                # No likelihood information - use prior only
                posterior_mean = prior_mean
                posterior_precision = prior_precision
            end
        end

        # Store results
        log_rt[t] = posterior_mean
        rt_estimates[t] = exp(posterior_mean)

        # Approximate credible intervals (using normal approximation)
        posterior_sd = 1 / sqrt(posterior_precision)
        rt_lower[t] = exp(posterior_mean - 1.96 * posterior_sd)
        rt_upper[t] = exp(posterior_mean + 1.96 * posterior_sd)
    end

    return rt_estimates, rt_lower, rt_upper, infectiousness
end

# Run the estimation
println("\nEstimating Rt...")
println("Method 1: Simple moving average approach")
rt_simple, infectiousness = estimate_rt_simple(cases, gen_time_pmf, 7)

println("Method 2: Bayesian approach with smoothing")
rt_bayes, rt_lower, rt_upper, _ = estimate_rt_bayesian_simple(
    cases, gen_time_pmf,
    window=7,
    rt_prior_mean=1.0,
    rt_prior_sd=0.5,
    innovation_sd=0.12
)

# Create results dataframe
results_df = DataFrame(
    date = data.date,
    cases_observed = cases,
    infectiousness = infectiousness,
    rt_simple = rt_simple,
    rt_bayesian_mean = rt_bayes,
    rt_bayesian_lower = rt_lower,
    rt_bayesian_upper = rt_upper
)

# Save detailed results
CSV.write("rt_estimates_detailed.csv", results_df)
println("✓ Detailed results saved to rt_estimates_detailed.csv")

# Current (most recent) estimates
current_date = data.date[end]
current_rt_simple = rt_simple[end]
current_rt_bayes = rt_bayes[end]
current_rt_lower = rt_lower[end]
current_rt_upper = rt_upper[end]

println("\n" * "="^60)
println("RT ESTIMATION RESULTS")
println("="^60)
println("Most recent estimates ($(current_date)):")
println("Simple method: Rt = $(round(current_rt_simple, digits=3))")
println("Bayesian method: Rt = $(round(current_rt_bayes, digits=3)) [95% CI: $(round(current_rt_lower, digits=3))-$(round(current_rt_upper, digits=3))]")
println()

# Summary statistics over recent period
recent_idx = max(1, T-13):T
recent_rt_mean = mean(rt_bayes[recent_idx])
recent_cases = mean(cases[recent_idx])

println("Average Rt over last 14 days: $(round(recent_rt_mean, digits=3))")
println("Average cases over last 14 days: $(round(recent_cases, digits=1))")
println("Data period: $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end]) ($(T) days)")
println("="^60)

# Save summary
open("rt_summary.txt", "w") do f
    println(f, "Rt Estimation Results")
    println(f, "====================")
    println(f, "Analysis completed: $(Dates.now())")
    println(f, "")
    println(f, "Most recent estimates ($(current_date)):")
    println(f, "Rt = $(round(current_rt_bayes, digits=3)) [95% CI: $(round(current_rt_lower, digits=3))-$(round(current_rt_upper, digits=3))]")
    println(f, "")
    println(f, "Average Rt over last 14 days: $(round(recent_rt_mean, digits=3))")
    println(f, "")
    println(f, "Interpretation:")
    if current_rt_bayes > 1.0 && current_rt_lower > 1.0
        println(f, "- Rt significantly > 1: Epidemic is likely growing")
    elseif current_rt_bayes < 1.0 && current_rt_upper < 1.0
        println(f, "- Rt significantly < 1: Epidemic is likely declining")
    elseif current_rt_bayes > 1.0
        println(f, "- Rt > 1 but CI includes 1: Growth uncertain")
    elseif current_rt_bayes < 1.0
        println(f, "- Rt < 1 but CI includes 1: Decline uncertain")
    else
        println(f, "- Rt ≈ 1: Epidemic appears stable")
    end
    println(f, "")
    println(f, "Data: $(T) observations from $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end])")
    println(f, "Generation time: Gamma distribution (mean ≈ 6.2 days)")
    println(f, "Method: Bayesian renewal equation with random walk prior")
end

println("✓ Summary saved to rt_summary.txt")

# Create plots
println("\nCreating plots...")

# Plot 1: Rt comparison between methods
p1 = plot(size=(900, 500))

# Simple method

      label="Simple method",
```

### estimate_rt_renewal.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia

"""
Estimate time-varying reproduction number (Rt) from COVID-19 case counts
using the renewal equation framework with EpiAware.jl
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using EpiAware
using CSV, DataFrames
using Distributions
using MCMCChains
using Plots, StatsPlots
using Statistics
using Dates

println("=== Rt Estimation using Renewal Equation ===")
println("Loading packages complete")

# Load and examine the case data
println("\n1. Loading case data...")
cases_df = CSV.read("data/cases.csv", DataFrame)
println("Data shape: $(size(cases_df))")
println("Date range: $(minimum(cases_df.date)) to $(maximum(cases_df.date))")
println("Case statistics:")
println("  Mean: $(round(mean(cases_df.cases), digits=1))")
println("  Median: $(round(median(cases_df.cases), digits=1))")
println("  Min: $(minimum(cases_df.cases)), Max: $(maximum(cases_df.cases))")

# Check for any missing or zero values
n_missing = sum(ismissing.(cases_df.cases))
n_zeros = sum(cases_df.cases .== 0)
println("  Missing values: $n_missing")
println("  Zero values: $n_zeros")

# Convert dates and extract case counts
dates = Date.(cases_df.date)
case_counts = cases_df.cases
n_days = length(case_counts)
println("  Total days: $n_days")

# Set up the time span for modelling
tspan = (1, n_days)
println("  Time span: $tspan")

println("\n2. Setting up generation interval...")
# Use a gamma distribution for the generation interval
# Based on literature estimates for COVID-19: mean ~5.2 days, std ~1.7 days
gen_mean = 5.2
gen_std = 1.7
# Convert to shape and rate parameters for Gamma distribution
gen_shape = (gen_mean / gen_std)^2
gen_rate = gen_mean / (gen_std^2)
gen_dist = Gamma(gen_shape, 1/gen_rate)

println("Generation interval distribution:")
println("  Distribution: Gamma($(round(gen_shape, digits=2)), rate=$(round(gen_rate, digits=3)))")
println("  Mean: $(round(mean(gen_dist), digits=2)) days")
println("  Std: $(round(std(gen_dist), digits=2)) days")

# Create EpiData object with discretised generation interval
# The transformation=exp means Rt = exp(Z_t) where Z_t is the latent process
epi_data = EpiData(gen_distribution=gen_dist, transformation=exp)
println("  Discretised generation interval length: $(epi_data.len_gen_int)")
println("  Generation interval PMF sum: $(sum(epi_data.gen_int))")

println("\n3. Defining model components...")

# Infection model: Renewal equation
# Uses Normal() prior for initial incidence (on log scale due to exp transformation)
renewal_model = Renewal(
    data=epi_data,
    initialisation_prior=Normal(log(mean(case_counts[1:7])), 0.2)  # Informed initial incidence
)
println("  Infection model: Renewal with informed initialisation prior")

# Latent model: Random walk for log(Rt)
# This allows Rt to vary smoothly over time
latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior=Normal(0.0, 0.1),  # Initial log(Rt) ≈ 1.0
    ϵ_t=HierarchicalNormal(
        mean=0.0,
        std_prior=truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.03), 0.0, Inf)  # Small daily changes in log(Rt)
    )
)
println("  Latent model: RandomWalk with hierarchical normal innovations")

# Observation model: Account for reporting delays and observation error
# First, add a reporting delay (infection to case report)
# COVID-19 typically has 3-7 days from infection to case report
report_delay_mean = 5.0
report_delay_std = 2.0
report_delay_shape = (report_delay_mean / report_delay_std)^2
report_delay_rate = report_delay_mean / (report_delay_std^2)
report_delay_dist = Gamma(report_delay_shape, 1/report_delay_rate)

# Create observation model with delay and negative binomial error
obs_base = NegativeBinomialError(
    cluster_factor_prior=truncated(Normal(0.05, 0.02), 0.01, 0.2)
)

obs_model = LatentDelay(
    obs_base,
    report_delay_dist,
    D=14,  # Truncate delay at 14 days
    Δd=1.0
)
println("  Observation model: LatentDelay + NegativeBinomialError")
println("  Reporting delay: Gamma($(round(report_delay_shape, digits=2)), rate=$(round(report_delay_rate, digits=3)))")

# Create the full EpiProblem
problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model=renewal_model,
    latent_model=latent_model,
    observation_model=obs_model,
    tspan=tspan
)
println("  EpiProblem created successfully")

println("\n4. Setting up inference method...")
# Use Pathfinder for initialization + NUTS for sampling
pathfinder_method = ManyPathfinder(
    ndraws=50,
    nruns=4,
    maxiters=200
)

nuts_sampler = NUTSampler(
    ndraws=2000,
    nchains=4,
    target_acceptance=0.80
)

inference_method = EpiMethod(
    pre_sampler_steps=[pathfinder_method],
    sampler=nuts_sampler
)
println("  Inference method: ManyPathfinder + NUTS")
println("  MCMC: 4 chains × 500 draws = 2000 total samples")

println("\n5. Running inference...")
println("This may take several minutes...")

# Prepare data
data = (y_t=case_counts,)

# Run inference
try
    result = apply_method(problem, inference_method, data)
    println("  Inference completed successfully!")

    # Save the full result object for later analysis
    # Note: We'll extract results in the next step

    println("\n6. Extracting Rt estimates...")

    # Extract infection trajectories
    I_t_samples = mapreduce(hcat, result.generated) do gen
        gen.I_t
    end

    # Extract latent process Z_t (log Rt for renewal model with exp transformation)
    Z_t_samples = mapreduce(hcat, result.generated) do gen
        gen.Z_t
    end

    # Transform to Rt = exp(Z_t)
    Rt_samples = exp.(Z_t_samples)

    println("  Rt samples matrix size: $(size(Rt_samples))")

    # Calculate posterior summaries
    Rt_median = mapslices(median, Rt_samples, dims=2)[:]
    Rt_mean = mapslices(mean, Rt_samples, dims=2)[:]
    Rt_lower = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.025), Rt_samples, dims=2)[:]
    Rt_upper = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.975), Rt_samples, dims=2)[:]

    # Also calculate infection estimates
    I_median = mapslices(median, I_t_samples, dims=2)[:]
    I_lower = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.025), I_t_samples, dims=2)[:]
    I_upper = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.975), I_t_samples, dims=2)[:]

    println("  Current Rt estimate (final day):")
    final_rt = Rt_median[end]
    final_rt_lower = Rt_lower[end]
    final_rt_upper = Rt_upper[end]
    println("    Rt = $(round(final_rt, digits=3)) (95% CrI: $(round(final_rt_lower, digits=3))-$(round(final_rt_upper, digits=3)))")

    # Check proportion of time Rt > 1
    prop_above_one = mean(Rt_median .> 1.0)
    println("  Proportion of time Rt > 1.0: $(round(prop_above_one, digits=3))")

    println("\n7. Creating plots and saving results...")

    # Create Rt plot
    p1 = plot(dates, Rt_median,
              ribbon=(Rt_median .- Rt_lower, Rt_upper .- Rt_median),
              fillalpha=0.3,
              linewidth=2,
              color=:blue,
              title="Time-varying Reproduction Number (Rt)",
              xlabel="Date",
              ylabel="Rt",
              legend=:topright,
              label="Rt (95% CrI)",
              size=(800, 400))

    # Add horizontal line at Rt = 1
    hline!([1.0], linestyle=:dash, color=:red, alpha=0.7, label="Rt = 1")

    # Create infections plot
    p2 = plot(dates, I_median,
              ribbon=(I_median .- I_lower, I_upper .- I_median),
              fillalpha=0.3,
              linewidth=2,
              color=:green,
              title="Estimated Daily Infections",
              xlabel="Date",
              ylabel="Daily Infections",
              legend=:topright,
              label="Infections (95% CrI)",
              size=(800, 400))

    # Add observed cases for comparison
    plot!(dates, case_counts,
          color=:black,
          linestyle=:dot,
          linewidth=2,
          label="Observed Cases",
          alpha=0.8)

    # Create combined plot
    combined_plot = plot(p1, p2, layout=(2, 1), size=(800, 800))

    # Save plot
    savefig(combined_plot, "rt_estimates_renewal.png")
    println("  Plot saved: rt_estimates_renewal.png")

    # Save detailed results to CSV
    results_df = DataFrame(
        date=dates,
        observed_cases=case_counts,
        rt_median=Rt_median,
        rt_mean=Rt_mean,
        rt_lower=Rt_lower,
        rt_upper=Rt_upper,
        infections_median=I_median,
        infections_lower=I_lower,
        infections_upper=I_upper
    )

    CSV.write("rt_estimates_detailed.csv", results_df)
    println("  Detailed results saved: rt_estimates_detailed.csv")

    # Save summary statistics
    summary_df = DataFrame(
        metric=["Current Rt (median)", "Current Rt (95% CrI lower)", "Current Rt (95% CrI upper)",
                "Mean Rt over period", "Proportion of days Rt > 1",
                "Max Rt", "Min Rt"],
        value=[final_rt, final_rt_lower, final_rt_upper,
               mean(Rt_median), prop_above_one,
               maximum(Rt_median), minimum(Rt_median)]
    )

    CSV.write("rt_summary_statistics.csv", summary_df)
    println("  Summary statistics saved: rt_summary_statistics.csv")

    # Print final summary
    println("\n=== FINAL SUMMARY ===")
    println("✓ Successfully estimated Rt using renewal equation")
    println("✓ Model: Renewal equation with Gamma generation interval")
    println("✓ Latent process: Random walk for log(Rt)")
    println("✓ Observation model: Reporting delay + Negative binomial error")
    println("✓ Inference: $(size(Rt_samples, 2)) posterior samples")
    println()
    println("Key Results:")
    println("  • Current Rt: $(round(final_rt, digits=3)) (95% CrI: $(round(final_rt_lower, digits=3))-$(round(final_rt_upper, digits=3)))")
    println("  • Mean Rt over period: $(round(mean(Rt_median), digits=3))")
    println("  • Days with Rt > 1: $(round(100*prop_above_one, digits=1))%")
    println("  • Rt range: $(round(minimum(Rt_median), digits=3)) - $(round(maximum(Rt_median), digits=3))")
    println()
    println("Output files:")
    println("  • rt_estimates_renewal.png - Time series plots")
    println("  • rt_estimates_detailed.csv - Full results")
    println("  • rt_summary_statistics.csv - Summary statistics")

catch e
    println("ERROR: Inference failed!")
    println("Error details: ", e)

    # Print some diagnostic information
    println("\nDiagnostic information:")
    println("  Data length: $(length(case_counts))")
    println("  Data range: $(minimum(case_counts)) to $(maximum(case_counts))")
    println("  Any missing data: $(any(ismissing.(case_counts)))")
    println("  Generation interval length: $(epi_data.len_gen_int)")

    # Try a simpler version without delay
    println("\nTrying simpler model without reporting delay...")
    try
        simple_obs_model = NegativeBinomialError()
        simple_problem = EpiProblem(
            epi_model=renewal_model,
            latent_model=latent_model,
            observation_model=simple_obs_model,
            tspan=tspan
        )

        # Use fewer samples for the simple version
        simple_nuts = NUTSampler(ndraws=1000, nchains=2)
        simple_method = EpiMethod(
            pre_sampler_steps=[ManyPathfinder(ndraws=20, nruns=2)],
            sampler=simple_nuts
        )

        println("Running simpler model...")
        simple_result = apply_method(simple_problem, simple_method, data)
        println("Simple model succeeded! Check results...")

        # Quick extraction for simple model
        simple_Z = mapreduce(hcat, simple_result.generated) do gen
            gen.Z_t
        end
        simple_Rt = exp.(simple_Z)
        simple_Rt_median = mapslices(median, simple_Rt, dims=2)[:]

        println("Simple model final Rt: $(round(simple_Rt_median[end], digits=3))")

        # Save simple results
        simple_df = DataFrame(
            date=dates,
            rt_median=simple_Rt_median
        )
        CSV.write("rt_estimates_simple.csv", simple_df)
        println("Simple results saved to: rt_estimates_simple.csv")

    catch simple_error
        println("Simple model also failed: ", simple_error)
    end
end

println("\n=== Script completed ===")
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia

"""
Quick Rt estimation test with minimal samples
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using EpiAware, CSV, DataFrames, Distributions, Statistics, Dates

println("=== Quick Rt Estimation Test ===")

# Load data
cases_df = CSV.read("data/cases.csv", DataFrame)
dates = Date.(cases_df.date)
case_counts = cases_df.cases
n_days = length(case_counts)

println("Data: $n_days days, range $(minimum(case_counts))-$(maximum(case_counts)) cases")

# Simplified model setup
gen_dist = Gamma(9.36, 1.799)  # Precomputed values
epi_data = EpiData(gen_distribution=gen_dist, transformation=exp)

# Very simple priors
renewal_model = Renewal(
    data=epi_data,
    initialisation_prior=Normal(7.0, 0.5)  # log of initial cases ≈ 7
)

latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior=Normal(0.0, 0.2),  # log(Rt) starts near 1
    ϵ_t=HierarchicalNormal(std_prior=truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.1), 0.0, 0.5))
)

obs_model = NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior=HalfNormal(0.1))

problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model=renewal_model,
    latent_model=latent_model,
    observation_model=obs_model,
    tspan=(1, n_days)
)

# Minimal inference setup
minimal_method = EpiMethod(
    pre_sampler_steps=[],  # Skip pathfinder
    sampler=NUTSampler(ndraws=200, nchains=1)  # Just 200 samples, 1 chain
)

data = (y_t=case_counts,)

println("\nRunning minimal inference (200 samples, 1 chain)...")

try
    result = apply_method(problem, minimal_method, data)
    println("✓ Inference successful!")

    # Extract basic results
    Z_samples = result.generated[1].Z_t  # Just first chain
    Rt_samples = exp.(Z_samples)

    println("Results extracted:")
    println("  Samples shape: $(size(Rt_samples))")

    # Simple summary
    final_rt = Rt_samples[end]
    mean_rt = mean(Rt_samples)

    println("  Final Rt estimate: $(round(final_rt, digits=3))")
    println("  Mean Rt: $(round(mean_rt, digits=3))")
    println("  Rt range: $(round(minimum(Rt_samples), digits=3)) - $(round(maximum(Rt_samples), digits=3))")

    # Save simple results
    simple_results = DataFrame(
        date=dates,
        rt_estimate=Rt_samples
    )
    CSV.write("rt_simple_test.csv", simple_results)
    println("✓ Results saved to rt_simple_test.csv")

    println("\n✓ Quick test completed successfully!")
    println("The renewal equation model is working. You can now run full inference with more samples.")

catch e
    println("✗ Quick test failed: $e")
    rethrow(e)
end
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia

"""
Run MCMC inference for Rt estimation
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using EpiAware, CSV, DataFrames, Distributions, MCMCChains, Statistics, Dates

println("=== Running MCMC Inference for Rt Estimation ===")

# Load data
cases_df = CSV.read("data/cases.csv", DataFrame)
dates = Date.(cases_df.date)
case_counts = cases_df.cases
n_days = length(case_counts)

# Set up model (same as tested in step-by-step)
gen_dist = Gamma((5.2/1.7)^2, (5.2/1.7^2))
epi_data = EpiData(gen_distribution=gen_dist, transformation=exp)

renewal_model = Renewal(
    data=epi_data,
    initialisation_prior=Normal(log(mean(case_counts[1:7])), 0.2)
)

latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior=Normal(0.0, 0.1),
    ϵ_t=HierarchicalNormal(std_prior=truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.05), 0.0, Inf))
)

obs_model = NegativeBinomialError(
    cluster_factor_prior=truncated(Normal(0.05, 0.02), 0.01, 0.2)
)

problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model=renewal_model,
    latent_model=latent_model,
    observation_model=obs_model,
    tspan=(1, n_days)
)

# Simplified inference method (fewer samples for faster execution)
pathfinder_method = ManyPathfinder(
    ndraws=20,
    nruns=2,
    maxiters=100
)

nuts_sampler = NUTSampler(
    ndraws=800,  # 2 chains × 400 draws
    nchains=2,
    target_acceptance=0.75
)

inference_method = EpiMethod(
    pre_sampler_steps=[pathfinder_method],
    sampler=nuts_sampler
)

data = (y_t=case_counts,)

println("Starting inference with:")
println("  • $(n_days) days of data")
println("  • 2 chains × 400 samples = 800 total samples")
println("  • Pathfinder initialization")
println("\nThis may take 5-15 minutes...")

try
    # Run inference
    result = apply_method(problem, inference_method, data)

    println("\n✓ Inference completed successfully!")

    # Extract results
    I_t_samples = mapreduce(hcat, result.generated) do gen
        gen.I_t
    end

    Z_t_samples = mapreduce(hcat, result.generated) do gen
        gen.Z_t
    end

    Rt_samples = exp.(Z_t_samples)

    println("Sample matrix dimensions: $(size(Rt_samples))")

    # Calculate summaries
    Rt_median = mapslices(median, Rt_samples, dims=2)[:]
    Rt_lower = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.025), Rt_samples, dims=2)[:]
    Rt_upper = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.975), Rt_samples, dims=2)[:]

    I_median = mapslices(median, I_t_samples, dims=2)[:]
    I_lower = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.025), I_t_samples, dims=2)[:]
    I_upper = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.975), I_t_samples, dims=2)[:]

    # Print results summary
    println("\n=== RESULTS SUMMARY ===")
    println("Current Rt (final day): $(round(Rt_median[end], digits=3)) (95% CrI: $(round(Rt_lower[end], digits=3))-$(round(Rt_upper[end], digits=3)))")
    println("Mean Rt over period: $(round(mean(Rt_median), digits=3))")
    println("Proportion of days Rt > 1: $(round(mean(Rt_median .> 1.0), digits=3))")
    println("Rt range: $(round(minimum(Rt_median), digits=3)) - $(round(maximum(Rt_median), digits=3))")

    # Save results
    results_df = DataFrame(
        date=dates,
        observed_cases=case_counts,
        rt_median=Rt_median,
        rt_lower=Rt_lower,
        rt_upper=Rt_upper,
        infections_median=I_median,
        infections_lower=I_lower,
        infections_upper=I_upper
    )

    CSV.write("rt_estimates.csv", results_df)
    println("\n✓ Results saved to: rt_estimates.csv")

    # Create summary statistics
    final_rt = Rt_median[end]
    summary_stats = [
        "Current Rt (median)" => final_rt,
        "Current Rt (95% CrI lower)" => Rt_lower[end],
        "Current Rt (95% CrI upper)" => Rt_upper[end],
        "Mean Rt over period" => mean(Rt_median),
        "Proportion of days Rt > 1" => mean(Rt_median .> 1.0),
        "Max Rt" => maximum(Rt_median),
        "Min Rt" => minimum(Rt_median)
    ]

    println("\n=== DETAILED STATISTICS ===")
    for (stat, value) in summary_stats
        println("  $stat: $(round(value, digits=4))")
    end

    # Save summary
    summary_df = DataFrame(
        metric=[first(x) for x in summary_stats],
        value=[last(x) for x in summary_stats]
    )
    CSV.write("rt_summary.csv", summary_df)
    println("\n✓ Summary saved to: rt_summary.csv")

    println("\n✓ Rt estimation completed successfully!")

catch e
    println("\n✗ Inference failed!")
    println("Error: $e")

    # Print diagnostic info
    println("\nDiagnostic information:")
    println("  Data length: $(length(case_counts))")
    println("  Data range: $(minimum(case_counts)) - $(maximum(case_counts))")
    println("  Missing values: $(sum(ismissing.(case_counts)))")
    println("  Zero values: $(sum(case_counts .== 0))")
    println("  Generation interval length: $(epi_data.len_gen_int)")

    rethrow(e)
end
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia

"""
Direct NUTS sampling for Rt estimation (bypass EpiMethod)
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using EpiAware, CSV, DataFrames, Distributions, Statistics, Dates
using Turing

println("=== Direct NUTS Sampling for Rt ===")

# Load data
cases_df = CSV.read("data/cases.csv", DataFrame)
dates = Date.(cases_df.date)
case_counts = cases_df.cases
n_days = length(case_counts)

println("Data: $n_days days, $(minimum(case_counts))-$(maximum(case_counts)) cases")

# Model setup (same as before)
gen_dist = Gamma(9.36, 1.799)
epi_data = EpiData(gen_distribution=gen_dist, transformation=exp)

renewal_model = Renewal(
    data=epi_data,
    initialisation_prior=Normal(7.0, 0.5)
)

latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior=Normal(0.0, 0.2),
    ϵ_t=HierarchicalNormal(std_prior=truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.1), 0.0, 0.5))
)

obs_model = NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior=HalfNormal(0.1))

# Create the Turing model directly
turing_model = EpiAware.generate_epiaware(
    case_counts, n_days, renewal_model;
    latent_model=latent_model,
    observation_model=obs_model
)

println("✓ Turing model created")

# Sample directly with Turing
println("Running NUTS sampling (400 samples, 1 chain)...")

try
    chains = sample(turing_model, NUTS(0.75), 400; progress=true)

    println("✓ Sampling completed!")
    println("Chains summary:")
    println("  Iterations: $(length(chains))")
    println("  Parameters: $(length(names(chains)))")

    # Extract generated quantities
    generated = generated_quantities(turing_model, chains)

    # Extract Rt samples (first generated quantity should have Z_t)
    first_gen = generated[1]
    if haskey(first_gen, :Z_t)
        Z_t_sample = first_gen.Z_t
        Rt_sample = exp.(Z_t_sample)

        println("✓ Rt extracted successfully")
        println("  Sample length: $(length(Rt_sample))")
        println("  Final Rt: $(round(Rt_sample[end], digits=3))")
        println("  Mean Rt: $(round(mean(Rt_sample), digits=3))")

        # For proper analysis, we need all samples, but let's just use one for now
        results_df = DataFrame(
            date=dates,
            rt_single_sample=Rt_sample
        )

        CSV.write("rt_direct_sample.csv", results_df)
        println("✓ Single sample saved to rt_direct_sample.csv")

        println("\n=== SAMPLE RESULTS ===")
        println("Final day Rt: $(round(Rt_sample[end], digits=3))")
        println("Mean Rt: $(round(mean(Rt_sample), digits=3))")
        println("Days with Rt > 1: $(sum(Rt_sample .> 1.0))/$(length(Rt_sample))")

    else
        println("Generated quantities structure:")
        for key in keys(first_gen)
            println("  $key: $(typeof(first_gen[key]))")
        end
    end

    println("\n✓ Direct sampling successful!")

catch e
    println("✗ Direct sampling failed: $e")

    # Try to get more info about the model
    println("Model parameters:")
    try
        model_params = Turing.VarInfo(turing_model)
        println("Number of parameters: $(length(model_params.metadata))")
    catch
        println("Could not inspect model parameters")
    end

    rethrow(e)
end
```

```julia
# Simpler latent model (less variable)
latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(0, 0.1),
    ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal(std_prior = truncated(Normal(0, 0.02), 0, Inf))
)

# Simplified observation models with delays but no complex ascertainment
case_obs = LatentDelay(
    PoissonError(),  # Simpler than NegativeBinomial for faster computation
    Gamma(4, 1.25),  # Case delay ~5 days
    D = 12
)

hosp_obs = LatentDelay(
    PoissonError(),
    Gamma(6.4, 1.25),  # Hosp delay ~8 days
    D = 15
)

death_obs = LatentDelay(
    PoissonError(),
    Gamma(90, 1/6),  # Death delay ~15 days
    D = 20
)

# Add simple ascertainment (constant rates, no time variation)
case_asc = Ascertainment(
    case_obs,
    FixedIntercept(log(0.15)),  # 15% case ascertainment
    latent_prefix = "case"
)

hosp_asc = Ascertainment(
    hosp_obs,
    FixedIntercept(log(0.04)),  # 4% hospitalisation rate
    latent_prefix = "hosp"
)

death_asc = Ascertainment(
    death_obs,
    FixedIntercept(log(0.008)),  # 0.8% death rate
    latent_prefix = "death"
)

# Stack observation models
observation_model = StackObservationModels(
    (cases = case_asc,
     hospitalisations = hosp_asc,
     deaths = death_asc)
)

# Create problem
epi_problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model = epi_model,
    latent_model = latent_model,
    observation_model = observation_model,
    tspan = (1, n_days)
)

# Faster inference method
inference_method = EpiMethod(
    pre_sampler_steps = [ManyPathfinder(ndraws = 15, nruns = 3, maxiters = 100)],
    sampler = NUTSampler(
        target_acceptance = 0.8,
        ndraws = 800,  # Fewer draws for speed
        nchains = 2,   # Fewer chains
        max_depth = 10
    )
)

# Prepare data
observations = (y_t = (cases = cases,
                      hospitalisations = hospitalisations,
                      deaths = deaths),)

println("\nRunning faster multi-stream inference...")
println("- 3 pathfinder runs for initialisation")
println("- 2 chains × 400 draws each = 800 total draws")

# Run inference
result = apply_method(epi_problem, inference_method, observations)

println("\nFaster multi-stream inference completed!")

# Extract results
chains = result.samples
println("Chains shape: $(size(chains))")

# Extract Rt trajectories
Z_t_samples = mapreduce(hcat, result.generated) do gen
    gen.Z_t
end

Rt_samples = exp.(Z_t_samples)
println("Rt samples shape: $(size(Rt_samples))")

# Calculate summaries
Rt_median = mapslices(median, Rt_samples, dims=2)[:]
Rt_lower = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.025), Rt_samples, dims=2)[:]
Rt_upper = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.975), Rt_samples, dims=2)[:]

# Current Rt
current_rt_median = median(Rt_samples[end, :])
current_rt_lower = quantile(Rt_samples[end, :], 0.025)
current_rt_upper = quantile(Rt_samples[end, :], 0.975)

println("\nResults Summary:")
println("Current Rt: $(round(current_rt_median, digits=3)) [$(round(current_rt_lower, digits=3)), $(round(current_rt_upper, digits=3))]")
println("Days with Rt > 1: $(sum(Rt_median .> 1)) out of $(n_days)")

# Save results
results_df = DataFrame(
    date = df.date,
    Rt_median = Rt_median,
    Rt_lower_95 = Rt_lower,
    Rt_upper_95 = Rt_upper
)

CSV.write("rt_estimates_fast.csv", results_df)
println("Results saved to rt_estimates_fast.csv")

# Create a quick plot
dates = Date.(df.date)

p = plot(dates, Rt_median,
         ribbon = (Rt_median - Rt_lower, Rt_upper - Rt_median),
         fillalpha = 0.3,
         color = :blue,
         linewidth = 2,
         label = "Rt (95% CI)",
         title = "Time-varying Reproduction Number (Rt) - Fast Multi-stream Model",
         xlabel = "Date",
         ylabel = "Rt",
         legend = :topright)

hline!(p, [1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, linewidth = 1, label = "Rt = 1")

# Add final Rt annotation
annotate!(p, dates[end-5], maximum(Rt_upper) * 0.9,
          text("Final Rt: $(round(current_rt_median, digits=2))\n[$(round(current_rt_lower, digits=2)), $(round(current_rt_upper, digits=2))]",
               :right, 9, :black))

savefig(p, "rt_estimates_fast.png")
println("Plot saved as rt_estimates_fast.png")

println("\n" * "="^50)
println("FAST MULTI-STREAM MODEL COMPLETE")
println("="^50)
println("Key Results:")
println("• Final Rt estimate: $(round(current_rt_median, digits=3)) [$(round(current_rt_lower, digits=3)), $(round(current_rt_upper, digits=3))]")
println("• Time period: $(df.date[1]) to $(df.date[end]) ($(n_days) days)")
println("• Model: 3 data streams with stream-specific delays")
println("• Results: rt_estimates_fast.csv, rt_estimates_fast.png")

# Simple trajectory analysis
println("\nRt Trajectory Analysis:")
println("• Initial Rt: $(round(Rt_median[1], digits=3))")
println("• Minimum Rt: $(round(minimum(Rt_median), digits=3)) on day $(argmin(Rt_median))")
println("• Final Rt: $(round(Rt_median[end], digits=3))")

# Count epidemic periods
epidemic_days = sum(Rt_median .> 1)
println("• Epidemic periods (Rt > 1): $(epidemic_days)/$(n_days) days ($(round(100*epidemic_days/n_days, digits=1))%)")
```

### multi_stream_rt_estimation.jl

```julia
using EpiAware
using CSV
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Statistics
using Plots
using StatsPlots

# Load the observational data
data_path = "data/observations.csv"
df = CSV.read(data_path, DataFrame)

println("Data summary:")
println("Time period: $(df.date[1]) to $(df.date[end])")
println("Number of days: $(nrow(df))")
println("\nData streams summary:")
println("Cases: $(minimum(df.cases)) - $(maximum(df.cases))")
println("Hospitalisations: $(minimum(df.hospitalisations)) - $(maximum(df.hospitalisations))")
println("Deaths: $(minimum(df.deaths)) - $(maximum(df.deaths))")

# Extract observations for each stream
cases = df.cases
hospitalisations = df.hospitalisations
deaths = df.deaths
n_days = length(cases)

println("\nSetting up multi-stream model...")

# Define generation interval - COVID-19 serial interval
# Using a Gamma distribution with mean ~6.5 days, SD ~4 days
mean_gen_int = 6.5
std_gen_int = 4.0
shape_gen_int = (mean_gen_int / std_gen_int)^2
scale_gen_int = std_gen_int^2 / mean_gen_int
gen_int_dist = Gamma(shape_gen_int, scale_gen_int)

# Create EpiData with generation interval
epi_data = EpiData(gen_distribution = gen_int_dist,
                   D_gen = 15,  # Truncate at 15 days
                   transformation = exp)  # Use exp transformation for Rt

println("Generation interval mean: $(mean_gen_int) days")
println("Generation interval discretised length: $(epi_data.len_gen_int)")

# Define stream-specific delay distributions

# Cases: shorter delay from infection (mean ~5 days)
case_delay_dist = Gamma(4.0, 1.25)  # mean=5, std=2.5

# Hospitalisations: medium delay (mean ~8 days)
hosp_delay_dist = Gamma(6.4, 1.25)  # mean=8, std=3.16

# Deaths: longer delay (mean ~15 days)
death_delay_dist = Gamma(90.0, 1/6)  # mean=15, std=3.87

println("\nDelay distributions:")
println("Cases delay mean: $(mean(case_delay_dist)) days")
println("Hospitalisations delay mean: $(mean(hosp_delay_dist)) days")
println("Deaths delay mean: $(mean(death_delay_dist)) days")

# Set up the epidemiological model (Renewal process with shared Rt)
epi_model = Renewal(
    data = epi_data,
    initialisation_prior = Normal(log(1000), 1)  # Prior for initial infections
)

# Set up the latent model for Rt (shared across all streams)
# Use a random walk to allow smooth variation in log(Rt) over time
latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(0, 0.1),  # Prior for initial log(Rt)
    ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal(mean = 0, std_prior = truncated(Normal(0, 0.05), 0, Inf))
)

# Set up observation models for each data stream
# Each stream has:
# 1. Delay from infection to observation
# 2. Observation noise (overdispersion)
# 3. Stream-specific ascertainment rate

# Cases observation model
case_obs_model = LatentDelay(
    NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior = HalfNormal(0.1)),
    case_delay_dist,
    D = 21  # Truncate delay at 21 days
)

# Hospitalisations observation model
hosp_obs_model = LatentDelay(
    NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior = HalfNormal(0.1)),
    hosp_delay_dist,
    D = 25  # Truncate delay at 25 days
)

# Deaths observation model
death_obs_model = LatentDelay(
    NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior = HalfNormal(0.1)),
    death_delay_dist,
    D = 30  # Truncate delay at 30 days
)

# Add ascertainment models for each stream
# Cases: time-varying ascertainment (may change due to testing policy)
case_ascertainment_model = Ascertainment(
    case_obs_model,
    RandomWalk(
        init_prior = Normal(log(0.1), 0.5),  # Initial ascertainment ~10%
        ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal(std_prior = truncated(Normal(0, 0.02), 0, Inf))
    ),
    latent_prefix = "case_ascertainment"
)

# Hospitalisations: more stable ascertainment with day-of-week effect
hosp_ascertainment_model = Ascertainment(
    hosp_obs_model,
    CombineLatentModels([
        Intercept(Normal(log(0.05), 0.3)),  # ~5% of infections hospitalised
        broadcast_dayofweek(HierarchicalNormal(std_prior = truncated(Normal(0, 0.1), 0, Inf)))
    ]),
    latent_prefix = "hosp_ascertainment"
)

# Deaths: stable ascertainment rate
death_ascertainment_model = Ascertainment(
    death_obs_model,
    Intercept(Normal(log(0.01), 0.3)),  # ~1% of infections result in death
    latent_prefix = "death_ascertainment"
)

# Stack the observation models to handle multiple data streams
observation_model = StackObservationModels(
    (cases = case_ascertainment_model,
     hospitalisations = hosp_ascertainment_model,
     deaths = death_ascertainment_model)
)

println("\nObservation models configured with delays and ascertainment.")

# Create the EpiProblem
tspan = (1, n_days)
epi_problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model = epi_model,
    latent_model = latent_model,
    observation_model = observation_model,
    tspan = tspan
)

println("EpiProblem created for $(n_days) days.")

# Prepare the observation data as a NamedTuple
observations = (y_t = (cases = cases,
                      hospitalisations = hospitalisations,
                      deaths = deaths),)

println("Data prepared for inference.")

# Set up the inference method
# Use pathfinder for initialisation followed by NUTS sampling
inference_method = EpiMethod(
    pre_sampler_steps = [ManyPathfinder(ndraws = 20, nruns = 6, maxiters = 200)],
    sampler = NUTSampler(
        target_acceptance = 0.8,
        ndraws = 2000,
        nchains = 4,
        max_depth = 12
    )
)

println("\nInference method configured:")
println("- Pathfinder initialisation with 6 runs")
println("- NUTS sampling: 4 chains × 500 draws each = 2000 total draws")
println("\nStarting inference...")
```

### plot_fast_results.jl

```julia
using Plots, StatsPlots
using CSV, DataFrames
using Dates

# Load the results (but handle the numerical issues)
results_df = CSV.read("rt_estimates_fast.csv", DataFrame)
data_df = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)

println("Loaded results with $(nrow(results_df)) time points")
println("Rt range: $(minimum(results_df.Rt_median)) to $(maximum(results_df.Rt_median))")

# Check for numerical issues and cap extreme values
reasonable_max = 10.0  # Cap Rt at 10 to avoid plotting issues

# Find reasonable estimates (first part before numerical explosion)
stable_indices = findall(x -> x < reasonable_max, results_df.Rt_median)
if !isempty(stable_indices)
    last_stable = maximum(stable_indices)
    println("Stable estimates available for first $(last_stable) days")
else
    last_stable = 5  # Use at least first 5 days
    println("No stable estimates found, using first 5 days")
end

# Convert date strings to Date objects for plotting
dates = Date.(results_df.date)

# Create plot focusing on stable period
stable_results = results_df[1:last_stable, :]
stable_dates = dates[1:last_stable]

p_rt = plot(stable_dates, stable_results.Rt_median,
           ribbon = (stable_results.Rt_median - stable_results.Rt_lower_95,
                    stable_results.Rt_upper_95 - stable_results.Rt_median),
           fillalpha = 0.3,
           color = :blue,
           linewidth = 2,
           label = "Rt (95% CI)",
           title = "Time-varying Reproduction Number (Rt) - Stable Period\nFast Multi-stream Model",
           xlabel = "Date",
           ylabel = "Rt",
           legend = :topright,
           ylims = (0, min(5.0, maximum(stable_results.Rt_upper_95))))

hline!(p_rt, [1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, linewidth = 1, label = "Rt = 1")

# Data plot
p_data = plot(dates, data_df.cases,
             color = :green, linewidth = 1.5, label = "Cases",
             title = "Observed Data Streams",
             xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Count",
             legend = :topright)

plot!(p_data, dates, data_df.hospitalisations,
      color = :orange, linewidth = 1.5, label = "Hospitalisations")

plot!(p_data, dates, data_df.deaths,
      color = :red, linewidth = 1.5, label = "Deaths")

# Combined plot
combined_plot = plot(p_rt, p_data, layout = (2, 1), size = (800, 600))

savefig(combined_plot, "rt_estimates_fast_corrected.png")
println("Corrected plot saved as rt_estimates_fast_corrected.png")

# Print summary of stable results
println("\nSummary of stable Rt estimates (first $(last_stable) days):")
println("Initial Rt: $(round(stable_results.Rt_median[1], digits=3))")
if last_stable > 1
    println("Final stable Rt: $(round(stable_results.Rt_median[end], digits=3))")
    println("Days with Rt > 1: $(sum(stable_results.Rt_median .> 1)) out of $(last_stable)")
end

# Save stable results only
stable_output = DataFrame(
    date = stable_results.date,
    Rt_median = stable_results.Rt_median,
    Rt_lower_95 = stable_results.Rt_lower_95,
    Rt_upper_95 = stable_results.Rt_upper_95
)

CSV.write("rt_estimates_stable.csv", stable_output)
println("Stable results saved to rt_estimates_stable.csv")
```

```julia
println("• Days with Rt > 1: $(sum(results_df.Rt_median .> 1)) out of $(length(results_df.Rt_median))")

# Also create a simple table of key dates
key_dates_idx = [1, length(dates)÷4, length(dates)÷2, 3*length(dates)÷4, length(dates)]
println("\nKey time points:")
for i in key_dates_idx
    println("$(dates[i]): Rt = $(round(results_df.Rt_median[i], digits=3)) [$(round(results_df.Rt_lower_95[i], digits=3)), $(round(results_df.Rt_upper_95[i], digits=3))]")
end
```
