### rt_estimation_v2.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia

"""
Structured Rt Estimation with Complex Observation Processes - Robust Version

This script implements a comprehensive model to estimate time-varying reproduction number (Rt)
from daily COVID-19 case counts, accounting for:
- Renewal equation for infection dynamics
- Delays between infection and reporting
- Day-of-week effects
- Time-varying ascertainment
- Overdispersion in observations
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using CSV, DataFrames
using Distributions, StatsBase
using LinearAlgebra, Statistics
using Dates
using Optim

# Define utility functions
logit(p) = log(p / (1 - p))
logistic(x) = 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
safe_log(x) = log(max(x, 1e-10))
safe_exp(x) = exp(min(x, 20.0))

println("Loading and preprocessing data...")

# Load the data
data = CSV.read("data/cases_dow.csv", DataFrame)
println("Loaded $(nrow(data)) days of data from $(minimum(data.date)) to $(maximum(data.date))")

# Convert date column and sort
data.date = Date.(data.date)
sort!(data, :date)

# Basic data summary
println("Data summary:")
println("  Total cases: $(sum(data.cases))")
println("  Mean daily cases: $(round(mean(data.cases), digits=1))")
println("  Date range: $(minimum(data.date)) to $(maximum(data.date))")

# Check day-of-week encoding
println("\nDay of week distribution:")
for dow in 1:7
    n_days = sum(data.day_of_week .== dow)
    mean_cases = mean(data.cases[data.day_of_week .== dow])
    println("  Day $dow: $n_days days, mean cases = $(round(mean_cases, digits=1))")
end

# Prepare data vectors
n_days = nrow(data)
cases_obs = data.cases
day_of_week = data.day_of_week

println("\nSetting up epidemiological model components...")

# 1. Generation interval distribution
gen_mean = 5.2
gen_std = 1.7
gen_shape = (gen_mean / gen_std)^2
gen_scale = gen_std^2 / gen_mean

max_gen_days = 20
gen_interval_cont = Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale)
gen_pmf = [pdf(gen_interval_cont, i) for i in 1:max_gen_days]
gen_pmf = gen_pmf ./ sum(gen_pmf)

println("Generation interval: mean = $(round(sum((1:max_gen_days) .* gen_pmf), digits=2)) days")

# 2. Delay from infection to reporting
delay_mean = 8.0
delay_std = 4.0
delay_shape = (delay_mean / delay_std)^2
delay_scale = delay_std^2 / delay_mean

max_delay_days = 30
delay_interval_cont = Gamma(delay_shape, delay_scale)
delay_pmf = [pdf(delay_interval_cont, i) for i in 1:max_delay_days]
delay_pmf = delay_pmf ./ sum(delay_pmf)

println("Reporting delay: mean = $(round(sum((1:max_delay_days) .* delay_pmf), digits=2)) days")

println("\nImplementing robust likelihood-based Rt estimation...")

# Simplified but robust model structure
struct RtModelData
    cases::Vector{Int}
    day_of_week::Vector{Int}
    n_days::Int
    gen_pmf::Vector{Float64}
    delay_pmf::Vector{Float64}
    mean_cases::Float64
end

model_data = RtModelData(
    cases_obs,
    day_of_week,
    n_days,
    gen_pmf,
    delay_pmf,
    mean(cases_obs)
)

function robust_negative_log_likelihood(params, data)
    try
        # Unpack parameters
        log_rt_raw = params[1:data.n_days]
        dow_effects_raw = params[data.n_days .+ (1:6)]
        log_phi = params[end]

        # Apply smoothing to Rt to ensure stability
        rt_smooth_param = 0.3  # Smoothing parameter
        log_rt_smoothed = similar(log_rt_raw)
        log_rt_smoothed[1] = log_rt_raw[1]

        for t in 2:data.n_days
            log_rt_smoothed[t] = rt_smooth_param * log_rt_raw[t] +
                                (1 - rt_smooth_param) * log_rt_smoothed[t-1]
        end

        rt_trajectory = safe_exp.(log_rt_smoothed)

        # Day-of-week effects (Sunday as reference = 0)
        dow_effects = [1.0; safe_exp.(dow_effects_raw)]

        # Overdispersion parameter
        phi = safe_exp(log_phi)
        phi = max(phi, 1.0)  # Ensure phi >= 1

        # Simple ascertainment (constant for stability)
        ascertainment = 0.3

        # Initial infections - use data-driven approach
        init_infections = data.mean_cases / (2.0 * ascertainment)
        initial_infections = fill(init_infections, length(data.gen_pmf))

        # Forward simulation
        infections = Vector{Float64}(undef, data.n_days + length(data.gen_pmf))
        infections[1:length(data.gen_pmf)] = initial_infections

        # Renewal equation with bounds checking
        for t in (length(data.gen_pmf) + 1):(data.n_days + length(data.gen_pmf))
            renewal_sum = 0.0
            for s in 1:length(data.gen_pmf)
                if t - s > 0
                    renewal_sum += infections[t - s] * data.gen_pmf[s]
                end
            end

            rt_idx = t - length(data.gen_pmf)
            infections[t] = max(rt_trajectory[rt_idx] * renewal_sum, 1e-6)
        end

        infections_period = infections[(length(data.gen_pmf) + 1):end]

        # Apply delays
        expected_reports = Vector{Float64}(undef, data.n_days)
        for t in 1:data.n_days
            expected_reports[t] = 0.0
            for d in 1:min(length(data.delay_pmf), t)
                if t - d + 1 > 0 && t - d + 1 <= length(infections_period)
                    expected_reports[t] += infections_period[t - d + 1] * data.delay_pmf[d]
                end
            end
        end

        # Apply ascertainment and day-of-week effects
        mu = expected_reports .* ascertainment .* dow_effects[data.day_of_week]

        # Ensure positive means
        mu = max.(mu, 1.0)

        # Compute negative binomial log-likelihood
        ll = 0.0
        for t in 1:data.n_days
            # Use alternative parameterisation: r = phi, p = phi/(phi + mu)
            r = phi
            p = phi / (phi + mu[t])
            p = min(max(p, 1e-10), 1.0 - 1e-10)  # Ensure valid probability

            # Manual NB log-likelihood to avoid domain errors
            k = data.cases[t]
            ll += loggamma(k + r) - loggamma(r) - loggamma(k + 1) +
                  r * safe_log(p) + k * safe_log(1 - p)
        end

        # Add smooth priors
        prior_ll = 0.0
        # Prior on Rt evolution (smooth changes)
        for t in 2:data.n_days
            prior_ll -= 0.5 * (log_rt_smoothed[t] - log_rt_smoothed[t-1])^2 / 0.1^2
        end

        # Prior on DoW effects (mild regularisation)
        for i in 1:6
            prior_ll -= 0.5 * dow_effects_raw[i]^2 / 0.2^2
        end

        return -(ll + prior_ll)

    catch e
        println("Error in likelihood computation: $e")
        return 1e10  # Large penalty for invalid parameters
    end
end

# Robust initial parameter values
println("Setting up optimisation...")

n_params = n_days + 6 + 1  # Rt + dow_effects + phi
initial_params = [
    fill(log(0.8), n_days);           # log Rt (declining trend)
    zeros(6);                         # DoW effects
    log(5.0)                          # log phi
]

println("Running optimisation (this may take several minutes)...")

# Use more robust optimisation
options = Optim.Options(
    iterations = 2000,
    show_trace = false,
    g_tol = 1e-6,
    f_tol = 1e-8
)

result = optimize(
    p -> robust_negative_log_likelihood(p, model_data),
    initial_params,
    LBFGS(),
    options
)

println("Optimisation completed!")
println("  Converged: $(Optim.converged(result))")
println("  Iterations: $(Optim.iterations(result))")
println("  Final objective: $(round(Optim.minimum(result), digits=2))")

# Extract results
opt_params = Optim.minimizer(result)

# Apply same smoothing as in likelihood
log_rt_raw = opt_params[1:n_days]
rt_smooth_param = 0.3
log_rt_smoothed = similar(log_rt_raw)
log_rt_smoothed[1] = log_rt_raw[1]

for t in 2:n_days
    log_rt_smoothed[t] = rt_smooth_param * log_rt_raw[t] +
                        (1 - rt_smooth_param) * log_rt_smoothed[t-1]
end

rt_estimates = safe_exp.(log_rt_smoothed)
dow_raw = opt_params[n_days .+ (1:6)]
dow_estimates = [1.0; safe_exp.(dow_raw)]
phi_estimate = safe_exp(opt_params[end])

# Fixed ascertainment rate for this simplified model
ascertainment_estimates = fill(0.3, n_days)

println("\nResults Summary:")
println("===============")

# Current (most recent) Rt estimate
current_rt = rt_estimates[end]
println("Current Rt estimate: $(round(current_rt, digits=3))")

# Rt trajectory summary
println("\nRt trajectory:")
println("  Minimum: $(round(minimum(rt_estimates), digits=3))")
println("  Maximum: $(round(maximum(rt_estimates), digits=3))")
println("  Mean: $(round(mean(rt_estimates), digits=3))")
println("  Initial: $(round(rt_estimates[1], digits=3))")
println("  Final: $(round(rt_estimates[end], digits=3))")

# Day-of-week effects
println("\nDay-of-week effects (multiplicative, Sunday=1.0):")
day_names = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]
for i in 1:7
    println("  $(day_names[i]): $(round(dow_estimates[i], digits=3))")
end

# Ascertainment summary (fixed in this version)
println("\nAscertainment rate: $(round(ascertainment_estimates[1]*100, digits=1))% (assumed constant)")

println("\nOverdispersion parameter (φ): $(round(phi_estimate, digits=2))")

# Model fit assessment
println("\nModel fit assessment:")
expected_total = sum(cases_obs) * mean(rt_estimates) * ascertainment_estimates[1]
println("  Observed total cases: $(sum(cases_obs))")
println("  Model implied cases: $(round(expected_total, digits=0))")

# Save results
println("\nSaving results...")
mkpath("results")

results_df = DataFrame(
    date = data.date,
    observed_cases = cases_obs,
    rt_estimate = rt_estimates,
    ascertainment = ascertainment_estimates,
    day_of_week = day_of_week
)

CSV.write("results/rt_estimates.csv", results_df)

# Day-of-week effects
dow_df = DataFrame(
    day_of_week = 1:7,
    day_name = day_names,
    effect = dow_estimates
)

CSV.write("results/day_of_week_effects.csv", dow_df)

# Model parameters
params_df = DataFrame(
    parameter = ["phi", "ascertainment_rate"],
    value = [phi_estimate, ascertainment_estimates[1]]
)

CSV.write("results/model_parameters.csv", params_df)

println("Results saved to:")
println("  - results/rt_estimates.csv")
println("  - results/day_of_week_effects.csv")
println("  - results/model_parameters.csv")

# Simple text-based visualisation
println("\n" * "="^60)
println("RT TRAJECTORY VISUALISATION")
println("="^60)

# Create simple ASCII plot of Rt over time
rt_min, rt_max = extrema(rt_estimates)
scale_factor = 40.0 / (rt_max - rt_min)

for (i, rt) in enumerate(rt_estimates)
    date_str = string(data.date[i])
    bar_length = max(1, round(Int, (rt - rt_min) * scale_factor))
    bar = "█" ^ bar_length
    rt_str = lpad(round(rt, digits=3), 5)
    println("$date_str: $rt_str |$bar")

    # Add reference line at Rt=1 occasionally
    if i % 7 == 1 && rt_min < 1.0 < rt_max
        ref_length = round(Int, (1.0 - rt_min) * scale_factor)
        ref_line = " " ^ 17 * "|" * " " ^ (ref_length - 1) * "┤ Rt=1.0"
        println(ref_line)
    end
end

println("\n" * "="^60)
println("DAY-OF-WEEK EFFECTS")
println("="^60)

for i in 1:7
    effect = dow_estimates[i]
    day = day_names[i]
    effect_str = lpad(round(effect, digits=3), 5)
    bar_length = max(1, round(Int, effect * 20))
    bar = "█" ^ bar_length
    println("$day: $effect_str |$bar")
end

# Final comprehensive summary
println("\n" * "="^60)
println("COMPREHENSIVE ANALYSIS SUMMARY")
println("="^60)

println("\n📊 DATASET CHARACTERISTICS:")
println("  • Time span: $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end]) ($(n_days) days)")
println("  • Total cases: $(sum(cases_obs))")
println("  • Daily average: $(round(mean(cases_obs), digits=1)) cases")
println("  • Peak day: $(data.date[argmax(cases_obs)]) ($(maximum(cases_obs)) cases)")

println("\n🦠 REPRODUCTION NUMBER ANALYSIS:")
println("  • Current Rt: $(round(current_rt, digits=3))")
if current_rt > 1.0
    println("  • Epidemic status: GROWING (Rt > 1.0)")
    growth_rate = (current_rt - 1.0) * 100
    println("  • Implied growth: +$(round(growth_rate, digits=1))% per generation")
else
    println("  • Epidemic status: DECLINING (Rt < 1.0)")
    decline_rate = (1.0 - current_rt) * 100
    println("  • Implied decline: -$(round(decline_rate, digits=1))% per generation")
end

println("  • Rt range: $(round(minimum(rt_estimates), digits=3)) - $(round(maximum(rt_estimates), digits=3))")

# Calculate trend
rt_trend = rt_estimates[end] - rt_estimates[1]
if abs(rt_trend) > 0.1
    trend_direction = rt_trend > 0 ? "INCREASING" : "DECREASING"
    println("  • Overall trend: $trend_direction (Δ = $(round(rt_trend, digits=3)))")
else
    println("  • Overall trend: STABLE (Δ = $(round(rt_trend, digits=3)))")
end

println("\n📅 REPORTING PATTERNS:")
max_dow_idx = argmax(dow_estimates)
min_dow_idx = argmin(dow_estimates)
println("  • Highest reporting: $(day_names[max_dow_idx]) ($(round(dow_estimates[max_dow_idx], digits=2))×)")
println("  • Lowest reporting: $(day_names[min_dow_idx]) ($(round(dow_estimates[min_dow_idx], digits=2))×)")

weekend_effect = (dow_estimates[1] + dow_estimates[7]) / 2  # Sun + Sat
weekday_effect = mean(dow_estimates[2:6])  # Mon-Fri
println("  • Weekend effect: $(round(weekend_effect, digits=3))× vs weekday $(round(weekday_effect, digits=3))×")

println("\n🔬 MODEL CHARACTERISTICS:")
println("  • Ascertainment rate: $(round(ascertainment_estimates[1]*100, digits=1))% (assumed constant)")
println("  • Overdispersion (φ): $(round(phi_estimate, digits=2))")
println("  • Generation interval: $(round(sum((1:max_gen_days) .* gen_pmf), digits=1)) days")
println("  • Reporting delay: $(round(sum((1:max_delay_days) .* delay_pmf), digits=1)) days")

println("\n✅ ESTIMATION QUALITY:")
println("  • Optimisation converged: $(Optim.converged(result) ? "YES" : "NO")")
println("  • Final log-likelihood: $(round(-Optim.minimum(result), digits=1))")
println("  • Iterations required: $(Optim.iterations(result))")

println("\n" * "="^60)
println("ANALYSIS COMPLETE")
println("="^60)
println("All results have been saved to the results/ directory.")
println("Key files:")
println("  • rt_estimates.csv - Daily Rt estimates")
println("  • day_of_week_effects.csv - Reporting patterns")
println("  • model_parameters.csv - Model configuration")
println("="^60)
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia

"""
Structured Rt Estimation with Complex Observation Processes - Working Version

This script implements a comprehensive model to estimate time-varying reproduction number (Rt)
from daily COVID-19 case counts, accounting for all required observation processes.
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using CSV, DataFrames
using Distributions, StatsBase
using LinearAlgebra, Statistics
using Dates
using Optim

println("=== COVID-19 Rt Estimation with Complex Observation Model ===\n")

# Load and process data
println("📊 Loading data...")
data = CSV.read("data/cases_dow.csv", DataFrame)
data.date = Date.(data.date)
sort!(data, :date)

n_days = nrow(data)
cases_obs = data.cases
day_of_week = data.day_of_week

println("Dataset: $(n_days) days from $(minimum(data.date)) to $(maximum(data.date))")
println("Total cases: $(sum(cases_obs)), Daily mean: $(round(mean(cases_obs), digits=1))")

# Show observed day-of-week patterns
println("\n📅 Raw day-of-week patterns in data:")
day_names = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]
for dow in 1:7
    cases_dow = cases_obs[day_of_week .== dow]
    if length(cases_dow) > 0
        mean_cases = mean(cases_dow)
        pct_vs_average = round((mean_cases / mean(cases_obs) - 1) * 100, digits=1)
        println("  $(day_names[dow]): $(round(mean_cases, digits=1)) cases/day ($pct_vs_average% vs average)")
    end
end

println("\n🧮 Setting up epidemiological model components...")

# Generation interval distribution (COVID-19 parameters)
gen_mean, gen_std = 5.2, 1.7
gen_shape = (gen_mean / gen_std)^2
gen_scale = gen_std^2 / gen_mean
max_gen_days = 15

gen_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale), i) for i in 1:max_gen_days]
gen_pmf ./= sum(gen_pmf)

println("Generation interval: mean = $(round(sum((1:max_gen_days) .* gen_pmf), digits=2)) days")

# Reporting delay distribution (infection to case report)
delay_mean, delay_std = 8.0, 4.0
delay_shape = (delay_mean / delay_std)^2
delay_scale = delay_std^2 / delay_mean
max_delay_days = 25

delay_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(delay_shape, delay_scale), i) for i in 1:max_delay_days]
delay_pmf ./= sum(delay_pmf)

println("Reporting delay: mean = $(round(sum((1:max_delay_days) .* delay_pmf), digits=2)) days")

# Robust negative log-likelihood function
function negative_log_likelihood(params)
    try
        # Parameter structure:
        # 1-n_days: log Rt values
        # n_days+1 to n_days+6: day-of-week effects (Mon-Sat, Sun=reference)
        # n_days+7: log overdispersion parameter
        # n_days+8: log mean initial infections

        log_rt_raw = params[1:n_days]
        dow_effects_raw = params[n_days+1:n_days+6]  # Mon-Sat
        log_phi = params[n_days+7]
        log_init_infections = params[n_days+8]

        # Apply smoothing to Rt trajectory
        alpha = 0.8  # Smoothing parameter
        log_rt = similar(log_rt_raw)
        log_rt[1] = log_rt_raw[1]

        for t in 2:n_days
            log_rt[t] = alpha * log_rt[t-1] + (1 - alpha) * log_rt_raw[t]
        end

        rt_trajectory = exp.(clamp.(log_rt, -5.0, 2.0))  # Reasonable bounds

        # Day-of-week effects (Sunday = 1.0 as reference)
        dow_effects = [1.0; exp.(clamp.(dow_effects_raw, -2.0, 2.0))]

        # Overdispersion and initial infections
        phi = exp(clamp(log_phi, -2.0, 5.0))
        phi = max(phi, 1.0)  # Ensure phi >= 1
        init_infections = exp(clamp(log_init_infections, 0.0, 15.0))

        # Time-varying ascertainment (simplified: linearly decreasing)
        ascertainment_start = 0.4
        ascertainment_end = 0.2
        ascertainment = [ascertainment_start - (ascertainment_start - ascertainment_end) * (t-1) / (n_days-1) for t in 1:n_days]

        # Forward simulation using renewal equation
        infections = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_days + max_gen_days)
        infections[1:max_gen_days] .= init_infections

        for t in (max_gen_days + 1):(n_days + max_gen_days)
            rt_index = t - max_gen_days
            infectivity = sum(infections[t-s] * gen_pmf[s] for s in 1:max_gen_days)
            infections[t] = max(rt_trajectory[rt_index] * infectivity, 0.1)
        end

        # Extract infections for observation period
        infections_period = infections[(max_gen_days+1):end]

        # Apply reporting delay
        expected_reports = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_days)
        for t in 1:n_days
            expected_reports[t] = 0.0
            for d in 1:min(max_delay_days, t)
                if t-d+1 >= 1
                    expected_reports[t] += infections_period[t-d+1] * delay_pmf[d]
                end
            end
            expected_reports[t] = max(expected_reports[t], 0.1)
        end

        # Apply ascertainment and day-of-week effects
        mu = expected_reports .* ascertainment .* dow_effects[day_of_week]
        mu = max.(mu, 1.0)  # Ensure positive expected values

        # Negative binomial likelihood (using built-in distribution)
        ll = 0.0
        for t in 1:n_days
            try
                # Use mean-overdispersion parameterisation
                p = phi / (phi + mu[t])
                p = clamp(p, 1e-10, 1-1e-10)
                ll += logpdf(NegativeBinomial(phi, p), cases_obs[t])
            catch
                ll -= 100  # Penalty for invalid parameters
            end
        end

        # Priors for regularisation
        rt_prior = -0.5 * sum(diff(log_rt).^2) / 0.1^2  # Smooth Rt evolution
        dow_prior = -0.5 * sum(dow_effects_raw.^2) / 0.5^2  # Moderate DoW effects

        total_ll = ll + rt_prior + dow_prior

        return -total_ll

    catch e
        return 1e8  # Large penalty for any errors
    end
end

println("🔍 Fitting model via maximum likelihood estimation...")

# Initial parameter values
n_total_params = n_days + 6 + 1 + 1  # Rt + DoW + phi + init_infections

init_params = [
    fill(log(0.8), n_days);      # log Rt (slightly declining)
    zeros(6);                     # DoW effects (neutral start)
    log(10.0);                   # log phi (moderate overdispersion)
    log(1000.0)                  # log initial infections
]

println("Optimising $(length(init_params)) parameters...")
println("This may take several minutes...")

# Optimization with robust settings
result = optimize(
    negative_log_likelihood,
    init_params,
    LBFGS(),
    Optim.Options(
        iterations = 1000,
        show_trace = false,
        g_tol = 1e-5
    )
)

converged = Optim.converged(result)
n_iterations = Optim.iterations(result)
final_nll = Optim.minimum(result)

println("✅ Optimisation complete!")
println("   Converged: $(converged ? "Yes" : "No")")
println("   Iterations: $n_iterations")
println("   Final -log likelihood: $(round(final_nll, digits=2))")

if !converged
    println("⚠️  Warning: Optimisation may not have fully converged")
end

# Extract and process results
opt_params = Optim.minimizer(result)

# Reconstruct smoothed Rt trajectory
log_rt_raw = opt_params[1:n_days]
alpha = 0.8
log_rt = similar(log_rt_raw)
log_rt[1] = log_rt_raw[1]

for t in 2:n_days
    log_rt[t] = alpha * log_rt[t-1] + (1 - alpha) * log_rt_raw[t]
end

rt_estimates = exp.(clamp.(log_rt, -5.0, 2.0))

# Day-of-week effects

# Other parameters

# Reconstruct ascertainment
ascertainment_start = 0.4
ascertainment_end = 0.2
ascertainment_estimates = [ascertainment_start - (ascertainment_start - ascertainment_end) * (t-1) / (n_days-1) for t in 1:n_days]

println("\n" * "="*60)
println("📈 RESULTS SUMMARY")
println("="*60)

current_rt = rt_estimates[end]
initial_rt = rt_estimates[1]
min_rt = minimum(rt_estimates)
max_rt = maximum(rt_estimates)
mean_rt = mean(rt_estimates)

println("\n🦠 REPRODUCTION NUMBER (Rt):")
println("   Current estimate: $(round(current_rt, digits=3))")
println("   Initial estimate: $(round(initial_rt, digits=3))")
println("   Range: $(round(min_rt, digits=3)) - $(round(max_rt, digits=3))")
println("   Mean: $(round(mean_rt, digits=3))")

rt_trend = current_rt - initial_rt
println("   Overall trend: $(rt_trend > 0.05 ? "↗️ Increasing" : rt_trend < -0.05 ? "↘️ Decreasing" : "➡️ Stable") (Δ = $(round(rt_trend, digits=3)))")

if current_rt > 1.1
    status = "🔴 High growth - epidemic expanding rapidly"
elseif current_rt > 1.0
    status = "🟡 Moderate growth - epidemic expanding slowly"
elseif current_rt > 0.9

else
    status = "🔵 Strong decline - epidemic shrinking"
end
println("   Status: $status")

println("\n📅 DAY-OF-WEEK REPORTING EFFECTS:")
for i in 1:7
```

### rt_estimation.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia

"""
Structured Rt Estimation with Complex Observation Processes

This script implements a comprehensive model to estimate time-varying reproduction number (Rt)
from daily COVID-19 case counts, accounting for:
- Renewal equation for infection dynamics
- Delays between infection and reporting
- Day-of-week effects
- Time-varying ascertainment
- Overdispersion in observations
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using CSV, DataFrames
using Distributions, StatsBase
using EpiAware
using MCMCChains
using Plots, StatsPlots
using Pathfinder
using LinearAlgebra, Statistics
using Dates

println("Loading and preprocessing data...")

# Load the data
data = CSV.read("data/cases_dow.csv", DataFrame)
println("Loaded $(nrow(data)) days of data from $(minimum(data.date)) to $(maximum(data.date))")

# Convert date column and sort
data.date = Date.(data.date)
sort!(data, :date)

# Basic data summary
println("Data summary:")
println("  Total cases: $(sum(data.cases))")
println("  Mean daily cases: $(round(mean(data.cases), digits=1))")
println("  Date range: $(minimum(data.date)) to $(maximum(data.date))")

# Check day-of-week encoding
println("\nDay of week distribution:")
for dow in 1:7
    n_days = sum(data.day_of_week .== dow)
    mean_cases = mean(data.cases[data.day_of_week .== dow])
    println("  Day $dow: $n_days days, mean cases = $(round(mean_cases, digits=1))")
end

# Prepare data vectors
n_days = nrow(data)
cases_obs = data.cases
day_of_week = data.day_of_week

println("\nSetting up epidemiological model components...")

# 1. Generation interval distribution
# Using a Gamma distribution with mean ~5.2 days, std ~1.7 days (COVID-19 literature)
gen_mean = 5.2
gen_std = 1.7
gen_shape = (gen_mean / gen_std)^2
gen_scale = gen_std^2 / gen_mean

# Discretise generation interval for first 20 days
max_gen_days = 20
gen_interval_cont = Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale)
gen_pmf = [pdf(gen_interval_cont, i) for i in 1:max_gen_days]
gen_pmf = gen_pmf ./ sum(gen_pmf)  # Normalise to sum to 1

println("Generation interval: mean = $(round(sum((1:max_gen_days) .* gen_pmf), digits=2)) days")

# 2. Delay from infection to reporting
# Using a Gamma distribution with mean ~8 days, std ~4 days
delay_mean = 8.0
delay_std = 4.0
delay_shape = (delay_mean / delay_std)^2
delay_scale = delay_std^2 / delay_mean

# Discretise delay distribution for first 30 days
max_delay_days = 30
delay_interval_cont = Gamma(delay_shape, delay_scale)
delay_pmf = [pdf(delay_interval_cont, i) for i in 1:max_delay_days]
delay_pmf = delay_pmf ./ sum(delay_pmf)

println("Reporting delay: mean = $(round(sum((1:max_delay_days) .* delay_pmf), digits=2)) days")

println("\nConstructing Bayesian model...")

# Create EpiAware model components
# This will be a custom implementation using EpiAware's flexible framework

# Define the observation model with day-of-week effects, time-varying ascertainment, and overdispersion
function create_rt_model(cases_obs, day_of_week, gen_pmf, delay_pmf)
    n_days = length(cases_obs)

    # Priors
    # Initial Rt value
    log_rt_init ~ Normal(log(1.0), 0.2)

    # Random walk innovation for Rt evolution
    rt_rw_sd ~ truncated(Normal(0, 0.1), 0, Inf)

    # Day-of-week effects (multiplicative, Sunday as reference)
    dow_effects_raw ~ filldist(Normal(0, 0.2), 6)  # 6 effects (Monday-Saturday)
    dow_effects = [0.0; dow_effects_raw]  # Sunday = 0 (reference)

    # Time-varying ascertainment (logit scale, smoothly varying)
    ascertainment_rw_sd ~ truncated(Normal(0, 0.1), 0, Inf)
    logit_ascertainment_init ~ Normal(logit(0.3), 0.5)  # Initial ~30% ascertainment

    # Overdispersion parameter
    phi ~ truncated(Normal(10, 5), 1, Inf)  # Negative binomial dispersion

    # Initial seeding infections
    log_initial_infections ~ filldist(Normal(log(100), 1.0), max_gen_days)
    initial_infections = exp.(log_initial_infections)

    # Generate Rt trajectory (random walk on log scale)
    log_rt = Vector{eltype(log_rt_init)}(undef, n_days)
    log_rt[1] = log_rt_init

    for t in 2:n_days
        log_rt[t] ~ Normal(log_rt[t-1], rt_rw_sd)
    end

    rt_trajectory = exp.(log_rt)

    # Generate ascertainment trajectory (random walk on logit scale)
    logit_ascertainment = Vector{eltype(logit_ascertainment_init)}(undef, n_days)
    logit_ascertainment[1] = logit_ascertainment_init

    for t in 2:n_days
        logit_ascertainment[t] ~ Normal(logit_ascertainment[t-1], ascertainment_rw_sd)
    end

    ascertainment_trajectory = logistic.(logit_ascertainment)

    # Forward simulation using renewal equation
    infections = Vector{eltype(initial_infections[1])}(undef, n_days + max_gen_days)

    # Set initial infections
    infections[1:max_gen_days] = initial_infections

    # Renewal equation: I_t = R_t * sum(I_{t-s} * g_s)
    for t in (max_gen_days + 1):(n_days + max_gen_days)
        renewal_sum = sum(infections[t - s] * gen_pmf[s] for s in 1:max_gen_days)
        rt_idx = t - max_gen_days
        infections[t] = rt_trajectory[rt_idx] * renewal_sum
    end

    # Extract infections for the observation period
    infections_obs_period = infections[(max_gen_days + 1):(n_days + max_gen_days)]

    # Apply delay distribution to get expected cases by report date
    expected_reports = Vector{eltype(infections_obs_period[1])}(undef, n_days)

    for t in 1:n_days
        expected_reports[t] = 0.0
        for d in 1:min(max_delay_days, t)
            if t - d + 1 > 0
                expected_reports[t] += infections_obs_period[t - d + 1] * delay_pmf[d]
            end
        end
    end

    # Apply time-varying ascertainment
    expected_reports_ascertained = expected_reports .* ascertainment_trajectory

    # Apply day-of-week effects
    expected_reports_dow = expected_reports_ascertained .* exp.(dow_effects[day_of_week])

    # Observation model with overdispersion (negative binomial)
    for t in 1:n_days
        p = phi / (phi + expected_reports_dow[t])
        cases_obs[t] ~ NegativeBinomial(phi, p)
    end

    # Return key quantities for post-processing
    return (
        rt_trajectory = rt_trajectory,
        ascertainment_trajectory = ascertainment_trajectory,
        dow_effects = exp.(dow_effects),
        infections = infections_obs_period,
        expected_reports = expected_reports_dow
    )
end

# For now, let's implement a simpler version that we can actually run
# This uses a more straightforward approach with known packages

println("Implementing simplified Bayesian model for Rt estimation...")

# Create a simple but complete model structure
struct RtModelData
    cases::Vector{Int}
    day_of_week::Vector{Int}
    n_days::Int
    gen_pmf::Vector{Float64}
    delay_pmf::Vector{Float64}
end

model_data = RtModelData(
    cases_obs,
    day_of_week,
    n_days,
    gen_pmf,
    delay_pmf
)

# Simple implementation using maximum likelihood estimation as a starting point
println("Fitting model using optimization approach...")

using Optim

# Define logit and logistic functions
logit(p) = log(p / (1 - p))
logistic(x) = 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

function negative_log_likelihood(params, data)
    # Parameter unpacking
    n_rt_params = data.n_days
    n_dow_params = 6  # Monday-Saturday (Sunday reference)
    n_asc_params = data.n_days

    rt_trajectory = exp.(params[1:n_rt_params])
    dow_effects_raw = params[n_rt_params .+ (1:n_dow_params)]
    dow_effects = [0.0; dow_effects_raw]  # Sunday = 0
    ascertainment_logit = params[n_rt_params + n_dow_params .+ (1:n_asc_params)]
    ascertainment = 1 ./ (1 .+ exp.(-ascertainment_logit))
    phi = exp(params[end])  # Overdispersion

    # Initial infections (simple assumption)
    initial_infections = fill(mean(data.cases) / 5, length(data.gen_pmf))

    # Forward simulation
    infections = zeros(data.n_days + length(data.gen_pmf))
    infections[1:length(data.gen_pmf)] = initial_infections

    # Renewal equation
    for t in (length(data.gen_pmf) + 1):(data.n_days + length(data.gen_pmf))
        renewal_sum = sum(infections[t - s] * data.gen_pmf[s] for s in 1:length(data.gen_pmf))
        rt_idx = t - length(data.gen_pmf)
        infections[t] = rt_trajectory[rt_idx] * renewal_sum
    end

    infections_period = infections[(length(data.gen_pmf) + 1):end]

    # Apply delays
    expected_reports = zeros(data.n_days)
    for t in 1:data.n_days
        for d in 1:min(length(data.delay_pmf), t)
            if t - d + 1 > 0
                expected_reports[t] += infections_period[t - d + 1] * data.delay_pmf[d]
            end
        end
    end

    # Apply ascertainment and day-of-week effects
    mu = expected_reports .* ascertainment .* exp.(dow_effects[data.day_of_week])

    # Negative binomial log-likelihood
    ll = 0.0
    for t in 1:data.n_days
        if mu[t] > 0 && phi > 0
            p = phi / (phi + mu[t])
            ll += logpdf(NegativeBinomial(phi, p), data.cases[t])
        else
            ll += -1e10  # Penalise invalid parameters
        end
    end

    return -ll
end

# Initial parameter values
n_params = n_days + 6 + n_days + 1  # Rt + dow_effects + ascertainment + phi
initial_params = [
    fill(log(0.8), n_days);           # log Rt
    fill(0.0, 6);                     # DoW effects
    fill(logit(0.3), n_days);         # logit ascertainment
    log(10.0)                         # log phi
]

println("Running optimization (this may take a few minutes)...")

# Simple optimization
result = optimize(p -> negative_log_likelihood(p, model_data),
                 initial_params,
                 BFGS(),
                 Optim.Options(iterations = 1000, show_trace = false))

if Optim.converged(result)
    println("Optimization converged successfully!")
else
    println("Warning: Optimization may not have converged fully")
end

# Extract results
opt_params = Optim.minimizer(result)
rt_estimates = exp.(opt_params[1:n_days])
dow_raw = opt_params[n_days .+ (1:6)]
dow_estimates = [1.0; exp.(dow_raw)]  # Sunday = 1.0 (reference)
ascertainment_estimates = 1 ./ (1 .+ exp.(-opt_params[n_days + 6 .+ (1:n_days)]))
phi_estimate = exp(opt_params[end])

println("\nResults Summary:")
println("===============")

# Current (most recent) Rt estimate
current_rt = rt_estimates[end]
println("Current Rt estimate: $(round(current_rt, digits=3))")

# Rt trajectory summary
println("\nRt trajectory:")
println("  Minimum: $(round(minimum(rt_estimates), digits=3))")
println("  Maximum: $(round(maximum(rt_estimates), digits=3))")
println("  Mean: $(round(mean(rt_estimates), digits=3))")

# Day-of-week effects
println("\nDay-of-week effects (multiplicative, Sunday=1.0):")
day_names = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]
for i in 1:7
    println("  $(day_names[i]): $(round(dow_estimates[i], digits=3))")
end

# Ascertainment summary
println("\nAscertainment rate:")
println("  Initial: $(round(ascertainment_estimates[1]*100, digits=1))%")
println("  Final: $(round(ascertainment_estimates[end]*100, digits=1))%")
println("  Mean: $(round(mean(ascertainment_estimates)*100, digits=1))%")

println("\nOverdispersion parameter (phi): $(round(phi_estimate, digits=2))")

# Save results
results_df = DataFrame(
    date = data.date,
    observed_cases = cases_obs,
    rt_estimate = rt_estimates,
    ascertainment = ascertainment_estimates,
    day_of_week = day_of_week
)

CSV.write("results/rt_estimates.csv", results_df)

# Day-of-week effects
dow_df = DataFrame(
    day_of_week = 1:7,
    day_name = day_names,
    effect = dow_estimates
)

CSV.write("results/day_of_week_effects.csv", dow_df)

println("\nResults saved to:")
println("  - results/rt_estimates.csv")
println("  - results/day_of_week_effects.csv")

# Create visualisation
println("\nCreating visualisation...")

# Set up plots
gr()  # Use GR backend

# Rt trajectory plot
p1 = plot(data.date, rt_estimates,
         title="Reproduction Number (Rt) Over Time",
         xlabel="Date", ylabel="Rt",
         linewidth=2, color=:blue,
         legend=false)
hline!([1.0], color=:red, linestyle=:dash, alpha=0.7)

# Cases and day-of-week pattern
p2 = scatter(data.date, cases_obs,
            title="Observed Cases",
            xlabel="Date", ylabel="Daily Cases",
            color=:orange, alpha=0.7,
            legend=false)

# Day-of-week effects
p3 = bar(day_names, dow_estimates,
        title="Day-of-Week Effects",
        xlabel="Day", ylabel="Multiplicative Effect",
        color=:green, alpha=0.7,
        legend=false)
hline!([1.0], color=:red, linestyle=:dash)

# Ascertainment over time
p4 = plot(data.date, ascertainment_estimates .* 100,
         title="Ascertainment Rate Over Time",
         xlabel="Date", ylabel="Ascertainment (%)",
         linewidth=2, color=:purple,
         legend=false)

# Combined plot
final_plot = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4, layout=(2,2), size=(800,600))

# Save plot
mkpath("results")
savefig(final_plot, "results/rt_analysis.png")

println("Plot saved to: results/rt_analysis.png")

# Summary statistics for final report
println("\n" * "="^50)
println("FINAL SUMMARY")
println("="^50)

println("\n📊 DATA OVERVIEW:")
println("  • Time period: $(minimum(data.date)) to $(maximum(data.date))")
println("  • Total days: $(n_days)")
println("  • Total cases: $(sum(cases_obs))")

println("\n🦠 CURRENT RT ESTIMATE:")

println("\n📈 RT TRAJECTORY:")
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia

"""
Estimate time-varying reproduction number (Rt) using renewal equation framework
Simple implementation using basic renewal equation and Bayesian inference
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using CSV
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Plots
using StatsPlots
using Dates
using Printf
using LinearAlgebra
using Random

Random.seed!(123)  # For reproducibility

println("Loading packages completed")

# Load and preprocess the COVID-19 case data
println("Loading case data...")
cases_df = CSV.read("data/cases.csv", DataFrame)

# Convert date string to Date type
cases_df.date = Date.(cases_df.date)

# Sort by date to ensure chronological order
sort!(cases_df, :date)

println("Data loaded: $(nrow(cases_df)) days from $(cases_df.date[1]) to $(cases_df.date[end])")
println("Case range: $(minimum(cases_df.cases)) to $(maximum(cases_df.cases))")

# Extract case counts as vector
case_counts = cases_df.cases
dates = cases_df.date
n_days = length(case_counts)

println("Total days: $n_days")

# Define generation interval
# Using a discretised gamma distribution for COVID-19 generation interval
# Mean ~5.2 days, SD ~1.7 days based on literature
mean_gi = 5.2
sd_gi = 1.7
shape_gi = (mean_gi / sd_gi)^2
scale_gi = sd_gi^2 / mean_gi

# Create discretised generation interval up to 20 days
max_gi = 20
gi_continuous = Gamma(shape_gi, scale_gi)
gi_pmf = [pdf(gi_continuous, i) for i in 1:max_gi]
gi_pmf = gi_pmf ./ sum(gi_pmf)  # Normalise to sum to 1

println("Generation interval parameters:")
println("  Mean: $mean_gi days")
println("  SD: $sd_gi days")
println("  Max support: $max_gi days")
println("  PMF sum: $(sum(gi_pmf))")

# Define delay from infection to case observation
# Combined incubation + reporting delay: mean ~7 days
mean_delay = 7.0
sd_delay = 3.0
max_delay = 21

# Create delay PMF
delay_continuous = Gamma((mean_delay / sd_delay)^2, sd_delay^2 / mean_delay)
delay_pmf = [pdf(delay_continuous, i) for i in 1:max_delay]
delay_pmf = delay_pmf ./ sum(delay_pmf)

println("Delay distribution parameters:")
println("  Mean delay: $mean_delay days")
println("  SD delay: $sd_delay days")
println("  Max delay: $max_delay days")

# Simple renewal equation implementation
# I_t = R_t * sum_{s=1}^{S} I_{t-s} * g_s
# where I_t are infections and g_s is generation interval

function compute_infectiousness(infections, gi_pmf)
    """Compute infectiousness at each time point"""
    n_days = length(infections)
    max_gi = length(gi_pmf)
    infectiousness = zeros(n_days)

    for t in 1:n_days
        for s in 1:min(max_gi, t-1)
            infectiousness[t] += infections[t-s] * gi_pmf[s]
        end
    end

    return infectiousness
end

function infections_to_cases(infections, delay_pmf)
    """Convert infections to observed cases using delay distribution"""
    n_inf = length(infections)
    max_delay = length(delay_pmf)
    n_cases = n_inf + max_delay
    cases = zeros(n_cases)

    for t in 1:n_inf
        for d in 1:max_delay
            if t + d - 1 <= n_cases
                cases[t + d - 1] += infections[t] * delay_pmf[d]
            end
        end
    end

    return cases[1:n_inf]  # Return same length as input
end

# Bayesian inference using log-likelihood
function log_likelihood(rt_log, case_counts, gi_pmf, delay_pmf, initial_infections_log)
    """Compute log-likelihood for Rt estimates"""
    n_days = length(case_counts)
    max_gi = length(gi_pmf)

    # Transform to natural scale
    rt = exp.(rt_log)
    initial_infections = exp.(initial_infections_log)

    # Initialize infections
    infections = zeros(n_days)

    # Set initial infections for first few days
    n_seed = min(max_gi, length(initial_infections))
    infections[1:n_seed] = initial_infections[1:n_seed]

    # Compute infections using renewal equation
    for t in (n_seed + 1):n_days
        infectiousness = 0.0
        for s in 1:min(max_gi, t-1)
            infectiousness += infections[t-s] * gi_pmf[s]
        end
        infections[t] = rt[t] * infectiousness
    end

    # Convert infections to expected cases
    expected_cases = infections_to_cases(infections, delay_pmf)

    # Negative binomial likelihood to handle overdispersion
    # Using fixed overdispersion parameter
    r = 10.0  # Overdispersion parameter (higher = less overdispersion)

    ll = 0.0
    for t in 1:n_days
        if expected_cases[t] > 0
            # NegativeBinomial parametrised by mean and overdispersion
            p = r / (r + expected_cases[t])
            ll += logpdf(NegativeBinomial(r, p), case_counts[t])
        else
            # If no expected cases, use small number to avoid issues
            p = r / (r + 1e-6)
            ll += logpdf(NegativeBinomial(r, p), case_counts[t])
        end
    end

    return ll
end

function log_prior(rt_log, initial_infections_log)
    """Compute log-prior for parameters"""
    # Random walk prior for log(Rt)
    lp = 0.0

    # Prior for first Rt value
    lp += logpdf(Normal(log(1.0), 0.2), rt_log[1])

    # Random walk for subsequent values
    for t in 2:length(rt_log)
        lp += logpdf(Normal(rt_log[t-1], 0.1), rt_log[t])
    end

    # Prior for initial infections
    for i_init in initial_infections_log
        lp += logpdf(Normal(log(1000), 1.0), i_init)
    end

    return lp
end

function log_posterior(params, case_counts, gi_pmf, delay_pmf)
    """Compute log-posterior"""
    n_days = length(case_counts)
    n_seed = min(max_gi, 7)  # Seed first 7 days

    rt_log = params[1:n_days]
    initial_infections_log = params[(n_days+1):(n_days+n_seed)]

    lp = log_prior(rt_log, initial_infections_log)
    ll = log_likelihood(rt_log, case_counts, gi_pmf, delay_pmf, initial_infections_log)

    return lp + ll
end

# Set up MCMC using simple Metropolis-Hastings
println("Setting up Bayesian inference...")

n_seed = min(max_gi, 7)
n_params = n_days + n_seed

# Initialize parameters
rt_init = log(0.8) .* ones(n_days)  # Start with Rt = 0.8
initial_inf_init = log(1000) .* ones(n_seed)
params_init = vcat(rt_init, initial_inf_init)

println("Starting MCMC inference...")
println("Parameters: $n_params (Rt: $n_days, initial infections: $n_seed)")

# Simple Metropolis-Hastings sampler
function mcmc_sample(n_samples, params_init, step_size = 0.02)
    n_params = length(params_init)
    samples = zeros(n_samples, n_params)
    current_params = copy(params_init)
    current_lp = log_posterior(current_params, case_counts, gi_pmf, delay_pmf)

    n_accept = 0

    for i in 1:n_samples
        # Propose new parameters
        proposal = current_params + step_size * randn(n_params)

        # Compute log-posterior for proposal
        try
            proposal_lp = log_posterior(proposal, case_counts, gi_pmf, delay_pmf)

            # Accept/reject
            if log(rand()) < (proposal_lp - current_lp)
                current_params = proposal
                current_lp = proposal_lp
                n_accept += 1
            end
        catch
            # If proposal leads to error, reject
            nothing
        end

        samples[i, :] = current_params

        if i % 1000 == 0
            accept_rate = n_accept / i
            println("Iteration $i, acceptance rate: $(@sprintf("%.2f", accept_rate))")
        end
    end

    accept_rate = n_accept / n_samples
    println("Final acceptance rate: $(@sprintf("%.2f", accept_rate))")

    return samples
end

# Run MCMC
n_samples = 10000
n_burnin = 2000

println("Running MCMC with $n_samples samples ($n_burnin burnin)...")
all_samples = mcmc_sample(n_samples, params_init)

# Remove burn-in
samples = all_samples[(n_burnin+1):end, :]
println("Using $(size(samples, 1)) post-burnin samples")

# Extract Rt samples (transform back to natural scale)
rt_samples = exp.(samples[:, 1:n_days])

println("Computing summary statistics...")

# Compute summary statistics
rt_mean = vec(mean(rt_samples, dims=1))
rt_q025 = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.025) for i in 1:n_days]
rt_q975 = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.975) for i in 1:n_days]
rt_q25 = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.25) for i in 1:n_days]
rt_q75 = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.75) for i in 1:n_days]

# Create results DataFrame
results_df = DataFrame(
    date = dates,
    rt_mean = rt_mean,
    rt_q025 = rt_q025,
    rt_q25 = rt_q25,
    rt_q75 = rt_q75,
    rt_q975 = rt_q975,
    observed_cases = case_counts
)

# Save results
CSV.write("rt_estimates.csv", results_df)
println("Results saved to rt_estimates.csv")

# Current (most recent) Rt estimate
current_rt_mean = rt_mean[end]
current_rt_lower = rt_q025[end]
current_rt_upper = rt_q975[end]

println("\n=== CURRENT RT ESTIMATE ===")
println("Date: $(dates[end])")
println("Rt estimate: $(@sprintf("%.2f", current_rt_mean)) (95% CI: $(@sprintf("%.2f", current_rt_lower)) - $(@sprintf("%.2f", current_rt_upper)))")

# Create summary plot
println("Creating visualisation...")

p = plot(dates, rt_mean,
         ribbon = (rt_mean .- rt_q025, rt_q975 .- rt_mean),
         fillalpha = 0.3,
         label = "Rt (95% CI)",
         xlabel = "Date",
         ylabel = "Reproduction number (Rt)",
         title = "Time-varying Reproduction Number (Rt)",
         legend = :topright,
         linewidth = 2,
         color = :blue)

# Add horizontal line at Rt = 1
hline!([1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.7, label = "Rt = 1")

# Add interquartile range
plot!(dates, rt_mean,
      ribbon = (rt_mean .- rt_q25, rt_q75 .- rt_mean),
      fillalpha = 0.5,
      label = "Rt (IQR)",
      color = :blue)

# Format x-axis
plot!(xticks = dates[1:7:end], xrotation = 45)

savefig(p, "rt_timeseries.png")
println("Plot saved to rt_timeseries.png")

# Create a secondary plot with cases
p2 = plot(layout = (2, 1), size = (800, 600))

# Top panel: Rt
plot!(p2[1], dates, rt_mean,
      ribbon = (rt_mean .- rt_q025, rt_q975 .- rt_mean),
      fillalpha = 0.3,
      label = "Rt (95% CI)",
      ylabel = "Rt",
      title = "Reproduction Number and Case Counts",
      legend = :topright,
      linewidth = 2,
      color = :blue)
hline!(p2[1], [1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.7, label = "Rt = 1")

# Bottom panel: Cases
plot!(p2[2], dates, case_counts,
      label = "Observed cases",
      xlabel = "Date",
      ylabel = "Daily cases",
      color = :orange,
      linewidth = 2)

# Format both x-axes
plot!(p2[1], xticks = dates[1:7:end], xformatter = x -> "")
plot!(p2[2], xticks = dates[1:7:end], xrotation = 45)

savefig(p2, "rt_and_cases.png")
println("Combined plot saved to rt_and_cases.png")

# Print summary statistics
println("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===")
println("Mean Rt over period: $(@sprintf("%.2f", mean(rt_mean)))")
println("Range: $(@sprintf("%.2f", minimum(rt_mean))) - $(@sprintf("%.2f", maximum(rt_mean)))")
println("Days with Rt > 1: $(sum(rt_mean .> 1))/$(length(rt_mean))")
println("Days with Rt < 1: $(sum(rt_mean .< 1))/$(length(rt_mean))")

# Days with significant evidence for Rt > 1 (lower CI > 1)
sig_above_1 = sum(rt_q025 .> 1)
sig_below_1 = sum(rt_q975 .< 1)
println("Days with 95% CI above 1: $sig_above_1/$(length(rt_mean))")
println("Days with 95% CI below 1: $sig_below_1/$(length(rt_mean))")

# Save summary to file
summary_text = """
Rt Estimation Results Summary
============================

Analysis period: $(dates[1]) to $(dates[end])

Current Rt estimate ($(dates[end])):
- Point estimate: $(@sprintf("%.2f", current_rt_mean))

Overall statistics:

- Range: $(@sprintf("%.2f", minimum(rt_mean))) - $(@sprintf("%.2f", maximum(rt_mean)))
- Days with Rt > 1: $(sum(rt_mean .> 1))/$(length(rt_mean)) ($(@sprintf("%.1f", 100 * sum(rt_mean .> 1)/length(rt_mean)))%)
- Days with Rt < 1: $(sum(rt_mean .< 1))/$(length(rt_mean)) ($(@sprintf("%.1f", 100 * sum(rt_mean .< 1)/length(rt_mean)))%)
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia

"""
Estimate time-varying reproduction number (Rt) using renewal equation framework
"""

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using CSV
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using EpiAware
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Plots
using StatsPlots
using Dates

println("Loading packages completed")

# Load and preprocess the COVID-19 case data
println("Loading case data...")
cases_df = CSV.read("data/cases.csv", DataFrame)

# Convert date string to Date type
cases_df.date = Date.(cases_df.date)

# Sort by date to ensure chronological order
sort!(cases_df, :date)

println("Data loaded: $(nrow(cases_df)) days from $(cases_df.date[1]) to $(cases_df.date[end])")
println("Case range: $(minimum(cases_df.cases)) to $(maximum(cases_df.cases))")

# Extract case counts as vector
case_counts = cases_df.cases
dates = cases_df.date
n_days = length(case_counts)

println("Total days: $n_days")

# Define generation interval
# Using a discretised gamma distribution for COVID-19 generation interval
# Mean ~5.2 days, SD ~1.7 days based on literature
mean_gi = 5.2
sd_gi = 1.7
shape_gi = (mean_gi / sd_gi)^2
scale_gi = sd_gi^2 / mean_gi

# Create discretised generation interval up to 20 days
max_gi = 20
gi_continuous = Gamma(shape_gi, scale_gi)
gi_pmf = [pdf(gi_continuous, i) for i in 1:max_gi]
gi_pmf = gi_pmf ./ sum(gi_pmf)  # Normalise to sum to 1

println("Generation interval parameters:")
println("  Mean: $mean_gi days")
println("  SD: $sd_gi days")
println("  Max support: $max_gi days")

# Define incubation period and reporting delay
# Incubation period: mean ~5 days, SD ~2 days
mean_inc = 5.0
sd_inc = 2.0
shape_inc = (mean_inc / sd_inc)^2
scale_inc = sd_inc^2 / mean_inc
incubation_dist = Gamma(shape_inc, scale_inc)

# Reporting delay: mean ~2 days, SD ~1 day
mean_rep = 2.0
sd_rep = 1.0
shape_rep = (mean_rep / sd_rep)^2
scale_rep = sd_rep^2 / mean_rep
reporting_dist = Gamma(shape_rep, scale_rep)

# Combined delay from infection to case reporting
max_delay = 20
delay_pmf = zeros(max_delay)
for inc_delay in 1:max_delay
    for rep_delay in 1:(max_delay - inc_delay + 1)
        total_delay = inc_delay + rep_delay - 1  # -1 for 0-indexing
        if total_delay <= max_delay && total_delay > 0
            prob = pdf(incubation_dist, inc_delay) * pdf(reporting_dist, rep_delay)
            delay_pmf[total_delay] += prob
        end
    end
end
delay_pmf = delay_pmf ./ sum(delay_pmf)  # Normalise

println("Delay distribution parameters:")
println("  Incubation mean: $mean_inc days")
println("  Reporting mean: $mean_rep days")
println("  Combined max delay: $max_delay days")

# Now define the renewal equation model using EpiAware
println("Setting up renewal equation model...")

# Define the latent process for Rt (using random walk)
# We'll use a second-order random walk for smoothness
rw_init_scale = 0.1  # Initial variance
rw_step_scale = 0.1  # Innovation variance

# Create the latent Rt process
latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(0.0, rw_init_scale),
    step_prior = Normal(0.0, rw_step_scale)
)

# Transform to positive Rt values using exponential
transform_model = ExpTransform()

# Define the observation model (negative binomial to handle overdispersion)
obs_model = NegativeBinomialError(
    cluster_factor_prior = HalfNormal(0.1)  # Overdispersion parameter
)

# Create the EpiModel
epi_model = EpiAware.EpiModel(
    gen_int = gi_pmf,
    delay_int = delay_pmf,
    latent = latent_model,
    observation = obs_model
)

println("Model setup completed")

# Set up inference
println("Preparing for inference...")

# Define priors for initial infections
# We need to seed the initial infections for the first few days
seed_days = max_gi + max_delay  # Need enough days for convolution
initial_infections_prior = truncated(Normal(log(1000), 1), -Inf, Inf)  # Log scale

# Create inference configuration
inference_config = (
    algorithm = Pathfinder(ndraws = 4000),  # Using Pathfinder for faster inference
    warmup = 1000
)

println("Starting model fitting...")
println("This may take several minutes...")

# Fit the model
try
    # Prepare data for EpiAware
    epi_data = (
        y_t = case_counts,
        gen_int = gi_pmf,
        delay_int = delay_pmf
    )

    # Run inference
    posterior_samples = epimodel_inference(
        epi_model,
        case_counts,
        inference_config
    )

    println("Model fitting completed successfully!")

    # Extract Rt estimates
    # The posterior samples contain the latent Rt process
    rt_samples = exp.(posterior_samples[:rt_t])  # Transform back to Rt scale

    # Compute summary statistics
    rt_mean = mean(rt_samples, dims=1)[1, :]
    rt_q025 = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.025) for i in 1:size(rt_samples, 2)]
    rt_q975 = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.975) for i in 1:size(rt_samples, 2)]
    rt_q25 = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.25) for i in 1:size(rt_samples, 2)]
    rt_q75 = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.75) for i in 1:size(rt_samples, 2)]

    # Create results DataFrame
    results_df = DataFrame(
        date = dates,
        rt_mean = rt_mean,
        rt_q025 = rt_q025,
        rt_q25 = rt_q25,
        rt_q75 = rt_q75,
        rt_q975 = rt_q975,
        observed_cases = case_counts
    )

    # Save results
    CSV.write("rt_estimates.csv", results_df)
    println("Results saved to rt_estimates.csv")

    # Current (most recent) Rt estimate
    current_rt_mean = rt_mean[end]
    current_rt_lower = rt_q025[end]
    current_rt_upper = rt_q975[end]

    println("\n=== CURRENT RT ESTIMATE ===")
    println("Date: $(dates[end])")
    println("Rt estimate: $(@sprintf("%.2f", current_rt_mean)) (95% CI: $(@sprintf("%.2f", current_rt_lower)) - $(@sprintf("%.2f", current_rt_upper)))")

    # Create summary plot
    println("Creating visualisation...")

    p = plot(dates, rt_mean,
             ribbon = (rt_mean .- rt_q025, rt_q975 .- rt_mean),
             fillalpha = 0.3,
             label = "Rt (95% CI)",
             xlabel = "Date",
             ylabel = "Reproduction number (Rt)",
             title = "Time-varying Reproduction Number (Rt)",
             legend = :topright,
             linewidth = 2)

    # Add horizontal line at Rt = 1
    hline!([1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.7, label = "Rt = 1")

    # Add interquartile range
    plot!(dates, rt_mean,
          ribbon = (rt_mean .- rt_q25, rt_q75 .- rt_mean),
          fillalpha = 0.5,
          label = "Rt (IQR)",
          color = :blue)

    # Format x-axis
    plot!(xticks = dates[1:7:end], xrotation = 45)

    savefig(p, "rt_timeseries.png")
    println("Plot saved to rt_timeseries.png")

    # Create a secondary plot with cases
    p2 = plot(layout = (2, 1), size = (800, 600))

    # Top panel: Rt
    plot!(p2[1], dates, rt_mean,
          ribbon = (rt_mean .- rt_q025, rt_q975 .- rt_mean),
          fillalpha = 0.3,
          label = "Rt (95% CI)",
          ylabel = "Rt",
          title = "Reproduction Number and Case Counts",
          legend = :topright,
          linewidth = 2)
    hline!(p2[1], [1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.7, label = "Rt = 1")

    # Bottom panel: Cases
    plot!(p2[2], dates, case_counts,
          label = "Observed cases",
          xlabel = "Date",
          ylabel = "Daily cases",
          color = :orange,
          linewidth = 2)

    # Format both x-axes
    plot!(p2[1], xticks = dates[1:7:end], xformatter = x -> "")
    plot!(p2[2], xticks = dates[1:7:end], xrotation = 45)

    savefig(p2, "rt_and_cases.png")
    println("Combined plot saved to rt_and_cases.png")

    # Print summary statistics
    println("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===")
    println("Mean Rt over period: $(@sprintf("%.2f", mean(rt_mean)))")
    println("Range: $(@sprintf("%.2f", minimum(rt_mean))) - $(@sprintf("%.2f", maximum(rt_mean)))")
    println("Days with Rt > 1: $(sum(rt_mean .> 1))/$(length(rt_mean))")
    println("Days with Rt < 1: $(sum(rt_mean .< 1))/$(length(rt_mean))")

    # Save summary to file
    summary_text = """
    Rt Estimation Results Summary
    ============================

    Analysis period: $(dates[1]) to $(dates[end])
    Total days: $(length(dates))

    Current Rt estimate ($(dates[end])):
    - Point estimate: $(@sprintf("%.2f", current_rt_mean))
    - 95% Credible interval: $(@sprintf("%.2f", current_rt_lower)) - $(@sprintf("%.2f", current_rt_upper))

    Overall statistics:
    - Mean Rt: $(@sprintf("%.2f", mean(rt_mean)))
    - Range: $(@sprintf("%.2f", minimum(rt_mean))) - $(@sprintf("%.2f", maximum(rt_mean)))
    - Days with Rt > 1: $(sum(rt_mean .> 1))/$(length(rt_mean)) ($(@sprintf("%.1f", 100 * sum(rt_mean .> 1)/length(rt_mean)))%)
    - Days with Rt < 1: $(sum(rt_mean .< 1))/$(length(rt_mean)) ($(@sprintf("%.1f", 100 * sum(rt_mean .< 1)/length(rt_mean)))%)

    Model parameters:
    - Generation interval mean: $mean_gi days
    - Incubation period mean: $mean_inc days
    - Reporting delay mean: $mean_rep days
    - Total delay mean: $(sum(1:max_delay .* delay_pmf)) days

    Files generated:
    - rt_estimates.csv: Full Rt estimates with credible intervals
    - rt_timeseries.png: Rt over time
    - rt_and_cases.png: Rt and case counts
    """

    open("rt_summary.txt", "w") do f
        write(f, summary_text)
    end

    println("\nSummary saved to rt_summary.txt")
    println("Analysis completed successfully!")

catch e
    println("Error during model fitting: $e")
    println("This might be due to model complexity or data issues.")
    println("Consider simplifying the model or checking the data.")
    rethrow(e)
end
```

### multi_stream_rt_estimation.jl

```julia
# Multi-stream time-varying Rt estimation using EpiAware.jl
# Estimates joint Rt from cases, hospitalisations, and deaths with stream-specific delays and ascertainment

using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using CSV, DataFrames
using Distributions
using EpiAware
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Plots
using StatsPlots
using Statistics
using Dates

println("📊 Starting multi-stream Rt estimation...")

# ============================================================================
# 1. Load and prepare data
# ============================================================================

println("📈 Loading observations data...")
data = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)

# Extract the observation vectors
cases = data.cases
hospitalisations = data.hospitalisations
deaths = data.deaths
dates = data.date

n_days = length(cases)
println("Data loaded: $(n_days) days from $(dates[1]) to $(dates[end])")

# Show summary statistics
println("\nSummary statistics:")
println("Cases: mean=$(round(mean(cases), digits=1)), max=$(maximum(cases))")
println("Hospitalisations: mean=$(round(mean(hospitalisations), digits=1)), max=$(maximum(hospitalisations))")
println("Deaths: mean=$(round(mean(deaths), digits=1)), max=$(maximum(deaths))")

# ============================================================================
# 2. Set up epidemiological parameters
# ============================================================================

println("\n🦠 Setting up epidemiological parameters...")

# Generation interval (COVID-19 serial interval from literature)
# Using a Gamma distribution with mean ~4.8 days, std ~2.3 days
gen_int_dist = Gamma(4.0, 1.2)  # shape, scale parameterisation
println("Generation interval: Gamma(4.0, 1.2) with mean $(round(mean(gen_int_dist), digits=2)) days")

# Create EpiData with generation interval
epi_data = EpiData(gen_distribution = gen_int_dist, D_gen = 15, transformation = exp)
println("Generation interval discretised over $(length(epi_data.gen_int)) days")

# ============================================================================
# 3. Define delay distributions for each data stream
# ============================================================================

println("\n⏰ Setting up delay distributions...")

# Delay from infection to case confirmation (shorter delay)
# Incubation ~5 days + testing/reporting ~2 days = ~7 days total
case_delay_dist = Gamma(3.5, 2.0)  # mean ~7 days, std ~3.7 days
println("Case delay: mean $(round(mean(case_delay_dist), digits=1)) days")

# Delay from infection to hospitalisation (medium delay)
# Incubation ~5 days + symptom onset to hospital ~5-7 days = ~10-12 days
hosp_delay_dist = Gamma(4.0, 2.5)  # mean ~10 days, std ~5 days
println("Hospitalisation delay: mean $(round(mean(hosp_delay_dist), digits=1)) days")

# Delay from infection to death (longest delay)
# Incubation ~5 days + illness ~10-15 days + reporting = ~18-20 days
death_delay_dist = Gamma(6.0, 3.0)  # mean ~18 days, std ~7.3 days
println("Death delay: mean $(round(mean(death_delay_dist), digits=1)) days")

# ============================================================================
# 4. Create the shared epidemiological model
# ============================================================================

println("\n🔄 Creating shared Renewal model with time-varying Rt...")

# RandomWalk latent model for log(Rt) with hierarchical normal innovations
# This allows Rt to vary smoothly over time
rw_latent = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(0.0, 0.2),  # Prior for initial log(Rt)
    ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.05), 0, Inf))  # Small daily changes
)

# Shared renewal model - all streams share the same underlying infection process
renewal_model = Renewal(
    data = epi_data,
    initialisation_prior = Normal(8.0, 1.0)  # Prior for initial infections (log scale)
)

println("Shared Renewal model created with RandomWalk latent process")

# ============================================================================
# 5. Create stream-specific observation models
# ============================================================================

println("\n🎯 Setting up stream-specific observation models...")

# Base observation error model with overdispersion
base_error = NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior = HalfNormal(0.1))

# Stream-specific models with delays and ascertainment
case_model = LatentDelay(
    Ascertainment(
        base_error,
        FixedIntercept(0.0),  # Baseline ascertainment (will be modified by stream-specific factor)
        transform = (x, y) -> x .* exp(y[1]),  # Multiplicative ascertainment
        latent_prefix = "case_ascertainment"
    ),
    case_delay_dist,
    D = 20
)

hosp_model = LatentDelay(
    Ascertainment(
        base_error,
        FixedIntercept(0.0),
        transform = (x, y) -> x .* exp(y[1]),
        latent_prefix = "hosp_ascertainment"
    ),
    hosp_delay_dist,
    D = 25
)

death_model = LatentDelay(
    Ascertainment(
        base_error,
        FixedIntercept(0.0),
        transform = (x, y) -> x .* exp(y[1]),
        latent_prefix = "death_ascertainment"
    ),
    death_delay_dist,
    D = 30
)

# Stack all observation models together
obs_model = StackObservationModels(
    (cases = case_model, hospitalisations = hosp_model, deaths = death_model)
)

println("Stream-specific observation models created:")
println("- Cases: delay + ascertainment + negative binomial error")
println("- Hospitalisations: delay + ascertainment + negative binomial error")
println("- Deaths: delay + ascertainment + negative binomial error")

# ============================================================================
# 6. Create the full EpiProblem
# ============================================================================

println("\n🧩 Creating EpiProblem...")

# Define the time span
tspan = (1, n_days)

# Create the full problem
epi_problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model = renewal_model,
    latent_model = rw_latent,
    observation_model = obs_model,
    tspan = tspan
)

println("EpiProblem created for $(n_days) time steps")

# ============================================================================
# 7. Set up data for inference
# ============================================================================

println("\n📊 Preparing data for inference...")

# Prepare observations as named tuple
y_data = (
    cases = cases,
    hospitalisations = hospitalisations,
    deaths = deaths
)

println("Observation data prepared with $(length(cases)) case observations, $(length(hospitalisations)) hospitalisation observations, and $(length(deaths)) death observations")

# ============================================================================
# 8. Set up inference method
# ============================================================================

println("\n⚙️ Setting up inference method...")

# Use pathfinder for initialisation
pathfinder_method = ManyPathfinder(
    ndraws = 10,
    nruns = 4,
    maxiters = 200
)

# NUTS sampler for posterior sampling
nuts_method = NUTSampler(
    ndraws = 2000,
    nchains = 4,
    target_acceptance = 0.8
)

# Combined method
inference_method = EpiMethod(
    pre_sampler_steps = AbstractEpiOptMethod[pathfinder_method],
    sampler = nuts_method
)

println("Inference method set up: Pathfinder + NUTS (2000 draws, 4 chains)")

# ============================================================================
# 9. Run inference
# ============================================================================

println("\n🎯 Starting inference... This may take several minutes.")
println("$(Dates.now()): Beginning model fitting")

# Create data input
data_input = (y_t = y_data,)

# Fix some parameters to help with identifiability
fix_params = (
    # Fix one of the ascertainment factors to aid identifiability
    case_ascertainment_intercept = 0.0,  # Cases as reference stream
)

println("Running inference with fixed parameters: case ascertainment = baseline")

# Run the inference
result = apply_method(epi_problem, inference_method, data_input, fix_parameters = fix_params)

println("$(Dates.now()): Inference completed!")

# ============================================================================
# 10. Extract results
# ============================================================================

println("\n📈 Extracting results...")

# Extract infection trajectories
I_t_samples = mapreduce(hcat, result.generated) do gen
    gen.I_t
end

# Extract latent process (log Rt)
Z_t_samples = mapreduce(hcat, result.generated) do gen
    gen.Z_t
end

# Transform to get Rt
Rt_samples = exp.(Z_t_samples)

println("Extracted $(size(Rt_samples, 2)) posterior samples for $(size(Rt_samples, 1)) time points")

# Compute summary statistics
Rt_median = mapslices(median, Rt_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]
Rt_lower = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.025), Rt_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]
Rt_upper = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.975), Rt_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]

I_t_median = mapslices(median, I_t_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]
I_t_lower = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.025), I_t_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]
I_t_upper = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.975), I_t_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]

# Current (most recent) Rt estimate
current_rt = Rt_median[end]
current_rt_lower = Rt_lower[end]
current_rt_upper = Rt_upper[end]

println("\n🎉 RESULTS SUMMARY")
println("="^50)
println("Current Rt estimate: $(round(current_rt, digits=3)) (95% CI: $(round(current_rt_lower, digits=3))-$(round(current_rt_upper, digits=3)))")
println("Time period: $(dates[1]) to $(dates[end])")
println("Rt range: $(round(minimum(Rt_median), digits=3)) to $(round(maximum(Rt_median), digits=3))")

# ============================================================================
# 11. Extract stream-specific parameters
# ============================================================================

println("\n🔍 Extracting stream-specific parameters...")

# Extract parameter samples from chains
chains = result.samples

# Extract ascertainment factors (relative to cases)
try
    hosp_ascertainment_samples = Array(chains[:hosp_ascertainment_intercept])
    death_ascertainment_samples = Array(chains[:death_ascertainment_intercept])

    hosp_ascertainment = exp(median(hosp_ascertainment_samples))
    death_ascertainment = exp(median(death_ascertainment_samples))

    println("Ascertainment rates (relative to cases = 1.0):")
    println("- Hospitalisations: $(round(hosp_ascertainment, digits=3))")
    println("- Deaths: $(round(death_ascertainment, digits=3))")
catch e
    println("Could not extract ascertainment parameters: $e")
end

# Extract overdispersion parameters
try
    case_cluster = median(Array(chains[:cases_cluster_factor]))
    hosp_cluster = median(Array(chains[:hospitalisations_cluster_factor]))
    death_cluster = median(Array(chains[:deaths_cluster_factor]))

    println("\nOverdispersion parameters (cluster factors):")
    println("- Cases: $(round(case_cluster, digits=4))")
    println("- Hospitalisations: $(round(hosp_cluster, digits=4))")
    println("- Deaths: $(round(death_cluster, digits=4))")
catch e
    println("Could not extract overdispersion parameters: $e")
end

# ============================================================================
# 12. Create and save results
# ============================================================================

println("\n💾 Saving results...")

# Create results dataframe
results_df = DataFrame(
    date = dates,
    Rt_median = Rt_median,
    Rt_lower = Rt_lower,
    Rt_upper = Rt_upper,
    infections_median = I_t_median,
    infections_lower = I_t_lower,
    infections_upper = I_t_upper,
    cases = cases,
    hospitalisations = hospitalisations,
    deaths = deaths
)

# Save results
CSV.write("rt_estimates.csv", results_df)
println("✅ Results saved to rt_estimates.csv")

# Save raw samples for further analysis
rt_samples_df = DataFrame(Rt_samples, :auto)
rt_samples_df.time_point = 1:size(Rt_samples, 1)
CSV.write("rt_samples.csv", rt_samples_df)
println("✅ Raw Rt samples saved to rt_samples.csv")

# ============================================================================
# 13. Create plots
# ============================================================================

println("\n📊 Creating visualisations...")

# Plot 1: Rt over time
p1 = plot(dates, Rt_median,
    ribbon = (Rt_median .- Rt_lower, Rt_upper .- Rt_median),
    label = "Rt estimate",
    title = "Time-varying Reproduction Number (Rt)",
    xlabel = "Date",
    ylabel = "Rt",
    linewidth = 2,
    fillalpha = 0.3)

# Add Rt = 1 reference line
hline!([1.0], line=(:dash, :red, 2), label = "Rt = 1")

# Plot 2: Inferred infections vs observations
p2 = plot(dates, I_t_median,
    ribbon = (I_t_median .- I_t_lower, I_t_upper .- I_t_median),
    label = "Inferred infections",
    title = "Inferred Infections vs Observed Data",
    xlabel = "Date",
    ylabel = "Count",
    linewidth = 2,
    fillalpha = 0.3)

plot!(dates, cases, label = "Cases", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7)
plot!(dates, hospitalisations, label = "Hospitalisations", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7)
plot!(dates, deaths .* 20, label = "Deaths × 20", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7)  # Scale deaths for visibility

# Combine plots
combined_plot = plot(p1, p2, layout = (2, 1), size = (800, 600))

# Save plot
savefig(combined_plot, "rt_results.png")
println("✅ Visualisation saved to rt_results.png")

# Plot convergence diagnostics
p3 = plot(chains[:rw_std], title = "Random Walk Standard Deviation Traces")
p4 = plot(chains[:init_incidence], title = "Initial Incidence Traces")

diagnostics_plot = plot(p3, p4, layout = (2, 1), size = (800, 400))
savefig(diagnostics_plot, "convergence_diagnostics.png")
println("✅ Convergence diagnostics saved to convergence_diagnostics.png")

# ============================================================================
# Summary
# ============================================================================

println("\n" * "="^60)
println("🎯 MULTI-STREAM Rt ESTIMATION COMPLETE")
println("="^60)
println("✅ Estimated time-varying Rt using joint renewal equation")
println("✅ Incorporated 3 data streams with different delays:")
println("   - Cases: ~$(round(mean(case_delay_dist), digits=1)) day delay")
println("   - Hospitalisations: ~$(round(mean(hosp_delay_dist), digits=1)) day delay")
println("   - Deaths: ~$(round(mean(death_delay_dist), digits=1)) day delay")
println("✅ Accounted for stream-specific ascertainment rates")
println("✅ Modelled overdispersion with negative binomial errors")
println("✅ Applied smoothness constraint on Rt via random walk")

println("\n📋 FILES CREATED:")
println("   - rt_estimates.csv: Rt estimates with credible intervals")
println("   - rt_samples.csv: Raw posterior samples")
println("   - rt_results.png: Rt trajectory and inferred infections")
println("   - convergence_diagnostics.png: MCMC diagnostics")

println("\n📊 FINAL Rt ESTIMATE:")
println("   Current Rt: $(round(current_rt, digits=3)) (95% CI: $(round(current_rt_lower, digits=3))-$(round(current_rt_upper, digits=3)))")

if current_rt > 1.0
    println("   🚨 Rt > 1: Epidemic likely growing")
elseif current_rt < 1.0
    println("   📉 Rt < 1: Epidemic likely declining")
else
    println("   ⚖️  Rt ≈ 1: Epidemic at approximate steady state")
end
```

```julia
# Simplified multi-stream Rt estimation
using Pkg

using CSV, DataFrames

using EpiAware
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Plots
using StatsPlots
using Statistics
using Dates

println("📊 Simplified multi-stream Rt estimation...")

# Load data
data = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
cases = data.cases
hospitalisations = data.hospitalisations
deaths = data.deaths
dates = data.date
n_days = length(cases)

println("Data: $(n_days) days from $(dates[1]) to $(dates[end])")
println("Cases: mean=$(round(mean(cases), digits=1))")
println("Hospitalisations: mean=$(round(mean(hospitalisations), digits=1))")
println("Deaths: mean=$(round(mean(deaths), digits=1))")

# Setup epidemiological parameters
gen_int_dist = Gamma(4.0, 1.2)
epi_data = EpiData(gen_distribution = gen_int_dist, D_gen = 15, transformation = exp)

# Latent model for log(Rt) - simplified with less variance
rw_latent = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(0.0, 0.1),
    ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.025), 0, Inf))
)

# Renewal model
renewal_model = Renewal(
    data = epi_data,
    initialisation_prior = Normal(log(mean(cases[1:7])), 0.3)
)

# Simplified observation models with different delays but simpler structure
case_delay_dist = Gamma(3.5, 2.0)     # ~7 days
hosp_delay_dist = Gamma(4.0, 2.5)     # ~10 days
death_delay_dist = Gamma(5.5, 2.8)    # ~15.4 days (shortened for computational efficiency)

# Create observation models with delays only (no complex ascertainment)
base_error = NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior = HalfNormal(0.08))

case_obs = LatentDelay(base_error, case_delay_dist, D = 15)
hosp_obs = LatentDelay(base_error, hosp_delay_dist, D = 18)
death_obs = LatentDelay(base_error, death_delay_dist, D = 25)

# Stack observation models
obs_model = StackObservationModels(
    (cases = case_obs, hospitalisations = hosp_obs, deaths = death_obs)
)

println("Multi-stream observation model created with simplified delays")

# Create problem
epi_problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model = renewal_model,
    latent_model = rw_latent,
    observation_model = obs_model,
    tspan = (1, n_days)
)

println("EpiProblem created for multi-stream analysis")

# Reduced inference settings for faster completion
pathfinder_method = ManyPathfinder(
    ndraws = 15,
    nruns = 2,
    maxiters = 80
)

nuts_method = NUTSampler(
    ndraws = 800,
    nchains = 2,
    target_acceptance = 0.75
)

inference_method = EpiMethod(
    pre_sampler_steps = AbstractEpiOptMethod[pathfinder_method],
    sampler = nuts_method
)

println("$(Dates.now()): Starting multi-stream inference...")

# Prepare multi-stream data
y_data = (
    cases = cases,
    hospitalisations = hospitalisations,
    deaths = deaths
)

data_input = (y_t = y_data,)

# Run inference
result = apply_method(epi_problem, inference_method, data_input)

println("$(Dates.now()): Multi-stream inference completed!")

# Extract results
I_t_samples = mapreduce(hcat, result.generated) do gen
    gen.I_t
end

Z_t_samples = mapreduce(hcat, result.generated) do gen
    gen.Z_t
end

Rt_samples = exp.(Z_t_samples)

# Summary statistics
Rt_median = mapslices(median, Rt_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]
Rt_lower = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.025), Rt_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]
Rt_upper = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.975), Rt_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]

I_t_median = mapslices(median, I_t_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]
I_t_lower = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.025), I_t_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]
I_t_upper = mapslices(x -> quantile(x, 0.975), I_t_samples, dims=2)[:, 1]

current_rt = Rt_median[end]
current_rt_lower = Rt_lower[end]
current_rt_upper = Rt_upper[end]

println("\n🎉 MULTI-STREAM RESULTS")
println("="^50)
println("Current Rt: $(round(current_rt, digits=3)) (95% CI: $(round(current_rt_lower, digits=3))-$(round(current_rt_upper, digits=3)))")
println("Rt range: $(round(minimum(Rt_median), digits=3)) to $(round(maximum(Rt_median), digits=3))")

# Extract stream-specific parameters
chains = result.samples

try
    case_cluster = median(Array(chains[:cases_cluster_factor]))
    hosp_cluster = median(Array(chains[:hospitalisations_cluster_factor]))
    death_cluster = median(Array(chains[:deaths_cluster_factor]))

    println("\nOverdispersion parameters (cluster factors):")
    println("- Cases: $(round(case_cluster, digits=4))")
    println("- Hospitalisations: $(round(hosp_cluster, digits=4))")
    println("- Deaths: $(round(death_cluster, digits=4))")
catch e
    println("Note: Stream-specific parameters not extracted: $e")
end

# Save results
results_df = DataFrame(
    date = dates,
    Rt_median = Rt_median,
    Rt_lower = Rt_lower,
    Rt_upper = Rt_upper,
    infections_median = I_t_median,
    infections_lower = I_t_lower,
    infections_upper = I_t_upper,
    cases = cases,
    hospitalisations = hospitalisations,
    deaths = deaths
)

CSV.write("multi_stream_rt.csv", results_df)
println("✅ Results saved to multi_stream_rt.csv")

# Create plots
p1 = plot(dates, Rt_median,
    ribbon = (Rt_median .- Rt_lower, Rt_upper .- Rt_median),
    label = "Multi-stream Rt",
    title = "Time-varying Reproduction Number (Multi-stream)",
    xlabel = "Date",
    ylabel = "Rt",
    linewidth = 2,

hline!([1.0], line=(:dash, :red, 2), label = "Rt = 1")

# Compare with single-stream if available
if isfile("single_stream_rt.csv")

end

p2 = plot(dates, I_t_median,

println("   - Hospitalisations: ~$(round(mean(hosp_delay_dist), digits=1)) day delay")
```
