```julia
dow_effects = zeros(6)
asc = fill(0.3, n_days)
phi = 5.0

# Storage
rt_samples = zeros(n_days, n_samples)
dow_samples = zeros(6, n_samples)
asc_samples = zeros(n_days, n_samples)
phi_samples = zeros(n_samples)

accepted, total = 0, 0

for iter in 1:(n_samples + n_burn)
    if iter % 300 == 0
        println("  Iteration $(iter), acceptance: $(round(100*accepted/max(total,1), digits=1))%")
    end

    # Update parameters (simplified single-component updates)

    # Update Rt
    t = rand(1:n_days)
    log_rt_new = copy(log_rt)
    log_rt_new[t] += randn() * 0.03

    infections = renewal_infections(log_rt, gen_pmf)
    infections_new = renewal_infections(log_rt_new, gen_pmf)

    expected_old = expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, asc, dow_effects, day_of_week)
    expected_new = expected_cases(infections_new, delay_pmf, asc, dow_effects, day_of_week)

    ll_old = sum([nb_logpdf(cases[i], expected_old[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])
    ll_new = sum([nb_logpdf(cases[i], expected_new[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])

    prior_old = -0.5 * log_rt[t]^2 / 0.2^2
    prior_new = -0.5 * log_rt_new[t]^2 / 0.2^2

    if t > 1
        prior_old += -0.5 * (log_rt[t] - log_rt[t-1])^2 / 0.02^2
        prior_new += -0.5 * (log_rt_new[t] - log_rt[t-1])^2 / 0.02^2
    end

    log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

    total += 1
    if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
        log_rt = log_rt_new
        accepted += 1
    end

    # Update day-of-week effect
    d = rand(1:6)
    dow_new = copy(dow_effects)
    dow_new[d] += randn() * 0.08

    infections = renewal_infections(log_rt, gen_pmf)
    expected_old = expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, asc, dow_effects, day_of_week)
    expected_new = expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, asc, dow_new, day_of_week)

    ll_old = sum([nb_logpdf(cases[i], expected_old[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])
    ll_new = sum([nb_logpdf(cases[i], expected_new[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])

    log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (-0.5 * dow_new[d]^2 / 0.3^2) - (-0.5 * dow_effects[d]^2 / 0.3^2)

    total += 1
    if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
        dow_effects = dow_new
        accepted += 1
    end

    # Update ascertainment
    t = rand(1:n_days)
    asc_new = copy(asc)
    asc_new[t] = clamp(asc_new[t] + randn() * 0.02, 0.01, 0.99)

    infections = renewal_infections(log_rt, gen_pmf)
    expected_old = expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, asc, dow_effects, day_of_week)
    expected_new = expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, asc_new, dow_effects, day_of_week)

    ll_old = sum([nb_logpdf(cases[i], expected_old[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])
    ll_new = sum([nb_logpdf(cases[i], expected_new[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])

    log_ratio = ll_new - ll_old

    total += 1
    if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
        asc = asc_new
        accepted += 1
    end

    # Update phi
    phi_new = max(phi + randn() * 1.0, 0.1)

    infections = renewal_infections(log_rt, gen_pmf)
    expected_obs = expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, asc, dow_effects, day_of_week)

    ll_old = sum([nb_logpdf(cases[i], expected_obs[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])
    ll_new = sum([nb_logpdf(cases[i], expected_obs[i], phi_new) for i in 1:n_days])

    log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (-4.0 * log(phi_new) - 0.1/phi_new) - (-4.0 * log(phi) - 0.1/phi)

    total += 1
    if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
        phi = phi_new
        accepted += 1
    end

    # Store samples
    if iter > n_burn
        idx = iter - n_burn
        rt_samples[:, idx] = exp.(log_rt)
        dow_samples[:, idx] = dow_effects
        asc_samples[:, idx] = asc
        phi_samples[idx] = phi
    end
end

println("MCMC completed! Final acceptance rate: $(round(100*accepted/total, digits=1))%")

# Process results
println("Processing results...")

# Safe statistics functions
safe_mean(x) = mean(filter(isfinite, x))
safe_std(x) = std(filter(isfinite, x))
safe_quantile(x, p) = quantile(filter(isfinite, x), p)

# Rt summary
rt_mean = [safe_mean(rt_samples[i, :]) for i in 1:n_days]
rt_std = [safe_std(rt_samples[i, :]) for i in 1:n_days]
rt_q025 = [safe_quantile(rt_samples[i, :], 0.025) for i in 1:n_days]
rt_median = [safe_quantile(rt_samples[i, :], 0.5) for i in 1:n_days]
rt_q975 = [safe_quantile(rt_samples[i, :], 0.975) for i in 1:n_days]

rt_df = DataFrame(
    date = dates,
    mean = rt_mean,
    std = rt_std,
    q025 = rt_q025,
    median = rt_median,
    q975 = rt_q975
)

CSV.write("results/rt_estimates.csv", rt_df)

# Day-of-week effects
dow_names = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]
dow_mult_median = [exp(safe_quantile(dow_samples[i, :], 0.5)) for i in 1:6]
dow_mult_q025 = [exp(safe_quantile(dow_samples[i, :], 0.025)) for i in 1:6]
dow_mult_q975 = [exp(safe_quantile(dow_samples[i, :], 0.975)) for i in 1:6]

dow_df = DataFrame(
    day = dow_names,
    multiplier_median = dow_mult_median,
    multiplier_q025 = dow_mult_q025,
    multiplier_q975 = dow_mult_q975
)

CSV.write("results/day_of_week_effects.csv", dow_df)

# Ascertainment
asc_mean = [safe_mean(asc_samples[i, :]) for i in 1:n_days]
asc_median = [safe_quantile(asc_samples[i, :], 0.5) for i in 1:n_days]
asc_q025 = [safe_quantile(asc_samples[i, :], 0.025) for i in 1:n_days]
asc_q975 = [safe_quantile(asc_samples[i, :], 0.975) for i in 1:n_days]

asc_df = DataFrame(
    date = dates,
    mean = asc_mean,
    median = asc_median,
    q025 = asc_q025,
    q975 = asc_q975
)

CSV.write("results/ascertainment_estimates.csv", asc_df)

# Overdispersion
phi_mean = safe_mean(phi_samples)
phi_median = safe_quantile(phi_samples, 0.5)
phi_q025 = safe_quantile(phi_samples, 0.025)
phi_q975 = safe_quantile(phi_samples, 0.975)

overdispersion_df = DataFrame(
    parameter = ["phi"],
    mean = [phi_mean],
    median = [phi_median],
    q025 = [phi_q025],
    q975 = [phi_q975]
)

CSV.write("results/overdispersion.csv", overdispersion_df)

# Key results
println("\n=== RESULTS SUMMARY ===")

current_rt = rt_median[end]
current_ci = [rt_q025[end], rt_q975[end]]

println("\nCURRENT RT ESTIMATE ($(dates[end])):")
println("  Rt = $(round(current_rt, digits=3)) [$(round(current_ci[1], digits=3)), $(round(current_ci[2], digits=3))]")

if current_rt > 1.0
    println("  ⚠️  Rt > 1: epidemic is growing")
else
    println("  ✅ Rt < 1: epidemic is declining")
end

println("\nDAY-OF-WEEK EFFECTS (multipliers):")
for i in 1:6
    day = dow_df.day[i]
    mult = dow_df.multiplier_median[i]
    ci_low = dow_df.multiplier_q025[i]
    ci_high = dow_df.multiplier_q975[i]
    println("  $(day): $(round(mult, digits=3))x [$(round(ci_low, digits=3)), $(round(ci_high, digits=3))]")
end
println("  Sunday: 1.000x (reference)")

println("\nASCERTAINMENT:")
println("  Initial ($(dates[1])): $(round(asc_median[1]*100, digits=1))%")
println("  Current ($(dates[end])): $(round(asc_median[end]*100, digits=1))%")

println("\nOVERDISPERSION:")
println("  φ = $(round(phi_median, digits=2)) [$(round(phi_q025, digits=2)), $(round(phi_q975, digits=2))]")
println("  (Higher φ means less overdispersion)")

# Create plots
println("\nCreating visualisation...")

try
    p1 = plot(dates, rt_median, ribbon=(rt_median - rt_q025, rt_q975 - rt_median),
              title="Time-varying Reproduction Number", xlabel="Date", ylabel="Rt",
              label="Rt estimate", linewidth=2, alpha=0.3)
    hline!([1.0], linestyle=:dash, color=:red, label="Rt = 1")

    hline!([1.0], linestyle=:dash, color=:red)

    savefig(combined_plot, "results/rt_analysis_summary.png")

    println("Plots saved to results/rt_analysis_summary.png")
catch e
    println("Could not create plots: $e")
end

println("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===")
println("Results saved in results/ directory:")
println("- rt_estimates.csv: Rt trajectory with uncertainty")
println("- day_of_week_effects.csv: Day-of-week multiplicative effects")
println("- ascertainment_estimates.csv: Time-varying ascertainment rates")
println("- overdispersion.csv: Overdispersion parameter")
println("- rt_analysis_summary.png: Summary plots")

println("\nCompleted at $(now())")
```

### final_working_analysis.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.

using CSV, DataFrames, Distributions, Statistics, Random, Plots, SpecialFunctions, Dates

Random.seed!(42)

println("=== Complete Rt Estimation with Structured Observation Processes ===")

# Load data
data = CSV.read("data/cases_dow.csv", DataFrame)
sort!(data, :date)

cases = data.cases
day_of_week = data.day_of_week
dates = data.date
n_days = length(cases)

println("Loaded $(n_days) days: $(dates[1]) to $(dates[end])")
println("Total cases: $(sum(cases))")

# Epidemiological parameters
gen_shape = (5.5/2.1)^2
gen_scale = (2.1^2)/5.5
gen_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale), t) for t in 1:15]
gen_pmf ./= sum(gen_pmf)

delay_shape = (7.0/3.0)^2
delay_scale = (3.0^2)/7.0
delay_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(delay_shape, delay_scale), t) for t in 1:15]
delay_pmf ./= sum(delay_pmf)

println("Generation interval: $(round(sum([i*gen_pmf[i] for i in 1:15]), digits=2)) days")
println("Reporting delay: $(round(sum([i*delay_pmf[i] for i in 1:15]), digits=2)) days")

# Renewal equation
function compute_infections(rt_values)
    n_t = length(rt_values)
    seed_days = 15
    I_total = zeros(n_t + seed_days)
    I_total[1:seed_days] .= 1000.0

    for t in (seed_days + 1):(n_t + seed_days)
        t_obs = t - seed_days
        Rt = clamp(rt_values[t_obs], 0.1, 5.0)

        infectiousness = sum([I_total[t-s] * gen_pmf[s] for s in 1:15])
        I_total[t] = Rt * infectiousness
    end

    return I_total[(seed_days + 1):end]
end

# Observation model
function compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_multipliers)
    n_t = length(infections)
    expected = zeros(n_t)

    for t in 1:n_t
        delayed_infections = sum([t-d+1 >= 1 ? infections[t-d+1] * delay_pmf[d] : 0.0 for d in 1:min(15, t)])
        reported_infections = delayed_infections * clamp(ascertainment[t], 0.05, 0.95)

        dow = day_of_week[t]
        dow_effect = dow <= 6 ? dow_multipliers[dow] : 1.0

        expected[t] = max(reported_infections * dow_effect, 1.0)
    end

    return expected
end

# Likelihood
function negbin_ll(observed, expected, phi)
    ll = 0.0
    for i in 1:length(observed)
        k = observed[i]
        μ = max(expected[i], 1e-6)
        r = max(phi, 0.1)
        p = r / (r + μ)

        if 0 < p < 1
            ll += loggamma(k + r) - loggamma(r) - loggamma(k + 1) + r*log(p) + k*log(1-p)
        else
            ll -= 1000
        end
    end
    return ll
end

# MCMC
println("Running MCMC...")

n_iter = 1500
n_burn = 500
n_samples = n_iter - n_burn

# Parameters
rt = ones(n_days)
dow_log_effects = zeros(6)
ascertainment = fill(0.3, n_days)
phi = 5.0

# Storage
rt_samples = zeros(n_days, n_samples)
dow_samples = zeros(6, n_samples)
asc_samples = zeros(n_days, n_samples)
phi_samples = zeros(n_samples)

accept_count = 0
total_count = 0

for iter in 1:n_iter
    if iter % 300 == 0
        println("  Iteration $(iter), acceptance: $(round(100*accept_count/max(total_count,1), digits=1))%")
    end

    # Update Rt
    for t in 1:n_days
        rt_new = copy(rt)
        rt_new[t] *= exp(randn() * 0.05)
        rt_new[t] = clamp(rt_new[t], 0.1, 5.0)

        infections = compute_infections(rt)
        infections_new = compute_infections(rt_new)

        dow_mults = exp.([dow_log_effects; 0.0])
        expected = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_mults)
        expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections_new, ascertainment, dow_mults)

        ll_old = negbin_ll(cases, expected, phi)
        ll_new = negbin_ll(cases, expected_new, phi)

        log_rt_prior_old = -0.5 * (log(rt[t]))^2 / 0.3^2
        log_rt_prior_new = -0.5 * (log(rt_new[t]))^2 / 0.3^2

        if t > 1
            log_rt_prior_old += -0.5 * (log(rt[t]) - log(rt[t-1]))^2 / 0.05^2
            log_rt_prior_new += -0.5 * (log(rt_new[t]) - log(rt[t-1]))^2 / 0.05^2
        end

        log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (log_rt_prior_new - log_rt_prior_old)

        total_count += 1
        if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
            rt = rt_new
            accept_count += 1
        end
    end

    # Update day-of-week effects
    for d in 1:6
        dow_new = copy(dow_log_effects)
        dow_new[d] += randn() * 0.1

        infections = compute_infections(rt)
        dow_mults_old = exp.([dow_log_effects; 0.0])
        dow_mults_new = exp.([dow_new; 0.0])

        expected_old = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_mults_old)
        expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_mults_new)

        ll_old = negbin_ll(cases, expected_old, phi)
        ll_new = negbin_ll(cases, expected_new, phi)

        prior_old = -0.5 * dow_log_effects[d]^2 / 0.3^2
        prior_new = -0.5 * dow_new[d]^2 / 0.3^2

        log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

        total_count += 1
        if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
            dow_log_effects = dow_new
            accept_count += 1
        end
    end

    # Update ascertainment
    for t in 1:n_days
        asc_new = copy(ascertainment)
        asc_new[t] += randn() * 0.03
        asc_new[t] = clamp(asc_new[t], 0.05, 0.95)

        infections = compute_infections(rt)
        dow_mults = exp.([dow_log_effects; 0.0])

        expected_old = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_mults)
        expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections, asc_new, dow_mults)

        ll_old = negbin_ll(cases, expected_old, phi)
        ll_new = negbin_ll(cases, expected_new, phi)

        log_ratio = ll_new - ll_old  # Simple prior for now

        total_count += 1
        if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
            ascertainment = asc_new
            accept_count += 1
        end
    end

    # Update phi
    phi_new = max(phi + randn() * 1.5, 0.1)

    infections = compute_infections(rt)
    dow_mults = exp.([dow_log_effects; 0.0])
    expected = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_mults)

    ll_old = negbin_ll(cases, expected, phi)
    ll_new = negbin_ll(cases, expected, phi_new)

    prior_old = -4.0*log(phi) - 0.1/phi
    prior_new = -4.0*log(phi_new) - 0.1/phi_new

    log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

    total_count += 1
    if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
        phi = phi_new
        accept_count += 1
    end

    # Store samples
    if iter > n_burn
        sample_idx = iter - n_burn
        rt_samples[:, sample_idx] = rt
        dow_samples[:, sample_idx] = dow_log_effects
        asc_samples[:, sample_idx] = ascertainment
        phi_samples[sample_idx] = phi
    end
end

println("MCMC completed! Acceptance rate: $(round(100*accept_count/total_count, digits=1))%")

# Process results
safe_quantile(x, q) = quantile(filter(isfinite, x), q)

# Save results
rt_summary = DataFrame(
    date = dates,
    mean = [mean(rt_samples[i,:]) for i in 1:n_days],
    median = [safe_quantile(rt_samples[i,:], 0.5) for i in 1:n_days],
    q025 = [safe_quantile(rt_samples[i,:], 0.025) for i in 1:n_days],
    q975 = [safe_quantile(rt_samples[i,:], 0.975) for i in 1:n_days]
)

CSV.write("results/rt_estimates.csv", rt_summary)

dow_summary = DataFrame(
    day = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"],
    multiplier_median = [exp(safe_quantile(dow_samples[i,:], 0.5)) for i in 1:6],
    multiplier_q025 = [exp(safe_quantile(dow_samples[i,:], 0.025)) for i in 1:6],
    multiplier_q975 = [exp(safe_quantile(dow_samples[i,:], 0.975)) for i in 1:6]
)

CSV.write("results/day_of_week_effects.csv", dow_summary)

asc_summary = DataFrame(
    date = dates,
    median = [safe_quantile(asc_samples[i,:], 0.5) for i in 1:n_days],
    q025 = [safe_quantile(asc_samples[i,:], 0.025) for i in 1:n_days],
    q975 = [safe_quantile(asc_samples[i,:], 0.975) for i in 1:n_days]
)

CSV.write("results/ascertainment_estimates.csv", asc_summary)

phi_summary = DataFrame(
    parameter = ["phi"],
    median = [safe_quantile(phi_samples, 0.5)],
    q025 = [safe_quantile(phi_samples, 0.025)],
    q975 = [safe_quantile(phi_samples, 0.975)]

CSV.write("results/overdispersion.csv", phi_summary)

println("Results saved to CSV files")

# Key results
current_rt = rt_summary.median[end]
current_rt_ci = [rt_summary.q025[end], rt_summary.q975[end]]

println("\n" * "="^60)
println("KEY RESULTS")
println("="^60)

println("\nCURRENT RT ESTIMATE ($(dates[end])):")
println("  Rt = $(round(current_rt, digits=3)) [$(round(current_rt_ci[1], digits=3)), $(round(current_rt_ci[2], digits=3))]")

if current_rt > 1.0
    println("  Status: Epidemic is growing (Rt > 1)")
else
    println("  Status: Epidemic is declining (Rt < 1)")
end

println("\nDAY-OF-WEEK EFFECTS:")
for i in 1:6
    day = dow_summary.day[i]
    mult = dow_summary.multiplier_median[i]
    ci = [dow_summary.multiplier_q025[i], dow_summary.multiplier_q975[i]]
    println("  $(day): $(round(mult, digits=3))x [$(round(ci[1], digits=3)), $(round(ci[2], digits=3))]")
end
println("  Sunday: 1.000x (reference)")

println("\nASCERTAINMENT:")
println("  Initial: $(round(asc_summary.median[1]*100, digits=1))%")
println("  Current: $(round(asc_summary.median[end]*100, digits=1))%")

println("\nOVERDISPERSION:")
println("  φ = $(round(phi_summary.median[1], digits=2)) [$(round(phi_summary.q025[1], digits=2)), $(round(phi_summary.q975[1], digits=2))]")

# Create plots
try
    p1 = plot(dates, rt_summary.median,
             ribbon=(rt_summary.median - rt_summary.q025, rt_summary.q975 - rt_summary.median),
             title="Time-varying Rt", ylabel="Rt", label="Rt estimate", fillalpha=0.3)
    hline!([1.0], color=:red, linestyle=:dash, label="Rt = 1")

    p2 = bar(dow_summary.day, dow_summary.multiplier_median,
            yerror=(dow_summary.multiplier_median - dow_summary.multiplier_q025,
                   dow_summary.multiplier_q975 - dow_summary.multiplier_median),
            title="Day-of-Week Effects", ylabel="Multiplier", xrotation=45, legend=false)
    hline!([1.0], color=:red, linestyle=:dash)

    combined = plot(p1, p2, layout=(2,1), size=(800,600))
    savefig(combined, "results/rt_analysis_summary.png")

catch e

end

println("ANALYSIS COMPLETE!")

println("✅ Day-of-week effects estimated")
```

### functional_rt_analysis.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.

using CSV, DataFrames, Distributions, Statistics, Random, Plots, SpecialFunctions, Dates

function run_rt_analysis()
    Random.seed!(42)

    println("=== Structured Rt Estimation with Complex Observation Processes ===")
    println("Starting at $(now())")

    # Load data
    data = CSV.read("data/cases_dow.csv", DataFrame)
    sort!(data, :date)

    cases = data.cases
    day_of_week = data.day_of_week
    dates = data.date
    n_days = length(cases)

    println("Loaded $(n_days) days from $(dates[1]) to $(dates[end])")
    println("Total cases: $(sum(cases))")

    # Show day-of-week patterns
    dow_names = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
    println("\nDay-of-week patterns:")
    for d in 1:7
        avg_cases = mean(cases[day_of_week .== d])
        println("  $(dow_names[d]): $(round(avg_cases, digits=1)) cases/day")
    end

    # Epidemiological parameters
    println("\nSetting up epidemiological model...")

    # Generation interval (time from infection to infectiousness)
    gen_shape = (5.5/2.1)^2
    gen_scale = (2.1^2)/5.5
    gen_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale), t) for t in 1:15]
    gen_pmf = gen_pmf ./ sum(gen_pmf)

    # Reporting delay (infection to case report)
    delay_shape = (7.0/3.0)^2
    delay_scale = (3.0^2)/7.0
    delay_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(delay_shape, delay_scale), t) for t in 1:15]
    delay_pmf = delay_pmf ./ sum(delay_pmf)

    actual_gen_mean = sum([i * gen_pmf[i] for i in 1:15])
    actual_delay_mean = sum([i * delay_pmf[i] for i in 1:15])

    println("Generation interval: $(round(actual_gen_mean, digits=2)) days")
    println("Reporting delay: $(round(actual_delay_mean, digits=2)) days")

    # Core model functions
    function renewal_infections(rt_values, gen_pmf)
        n_t = length(rt_values)
        seed_days = length(gen_pmf)
        infections = zeros(n_t + seed_days)

        # Seed initial infections
        infections[1:seed_days] .= 2000.0

        # Renewal equation: I_t = R_t * sum(I_{t-s} * g_s)
        for t in (seed_days + 1):(n_t + seed_days)
            t_obs = t - seed_days
            Rt = clamp(rt_values[t_obs], 0.2, 3.0)

            infectiousness = sum([infections[t-s] * gen_pmf[s] for s in 1:seed_days])
            infections[t] = Rt * infectiousness
        end

        return infections[(seed_days + 1):end]
    end

    function compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week, delay_pmf)
        n_t = length(infections)
        expected = zeros(n_t)

        for t in 1:n_t
            # Apply reporting delay
            delayed_infections = sum([
                t - d + 1 >= 1 ? infections[t - d + 1] * delay_pmf[d] : 0.0
                for d in 1:min(length(delay_pmf), t)
            ])

            # Apply ascertainment
            asc_rate = clamp(ascertainment[t], 0.1, 0.8)
            reported = delayed_infections * asc_rate

            # Apply day-of-week effect
            dow = day_of_week[t]
            dow_mult = dow <= 6 ? exp(clamp(dow_effects[dow], -0.7, 0.7)) : 1.0

            expected[t] = max(reported * dow_mult, 10.0)
        end

        return expected
    end

    function negbin_logpdf(k, μ, φ)
        μ = max(μ, 1.0)
        φ = max(φ, 0.5)

        if k < 0 || !isfinite(μ) || !isfinite(φ)
            return -Inf
        end

        r = φ
        p = r / (r + μ)

        if p <= 0 || p >= 1
            return -Inf
        end

        return loggamma(k + r) - loggamma(r) - loggamma(k + 1) + r * log(p) + k * log(1 - p)
    end

    # MCMC implementation
    println("\nRunning MCMC inference...")

    n_iter = 2000
    n_burn = 800
    n_samples = n_iter - n_burn

    # Initialize parameters
    rt = ones(n_days) * 0.9  # Start slightly below 1
    dow_effects = zeros(6)   # Mon-Sat effects (Sun = 0 reference)
    ascertainment = fill(0.4, n_days)  # 40% ascertainment
    phi = 8.0  # Overdispersion

    # Storage
    rt_samples = zeros(n_days, n_samples)
    dow_samples = zeros(6, n_samples)
    asc_samples = zeros(n_days, n_samples)
    phi_samples = zeros(n_samples)

    n_accepted = 0
    n_total = 0

    for iter in 1:n_iter
        if iter % 400 == 0
            acc_rate = n_accepted / max(n_total, 1) * 100
            println("  Iteration $(iter), acceptance: $(round(acc_rate, digits=1))%")
        end

        # Update Rt values
        for t in 1:n_days
            rt_new = copy(rt)
            rt_new[t] += randn() * 0.04
            rt_new[t] = clamp(rt_new[t], 0.2, 3.0)

            # Likelihood
            infections = renewal_infections(rt, gen_pmf)
            infections_new = renewal_infections(rt_new, gen_pmf)

            expected = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week, delay_pmf)
            expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections_new, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week, delay_pmf)

            ll_old = sum([negbin_logpdf(cases[i], expected[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])
            ll_new = sum([negbin_logpdf(cases[i], expected_new[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])

            # Prior (smoothness)
            prior_old = -0.5 * (rt[t] - 1.0)^2 / 0.5^2  # Centered at 1
            prior_new = -0.5 * (rt_new[t] - 1.0)^2 / 0.5^2

            if t > 1
                prior_old += -0.5 * (rt[t] - rt[t-1])^2 / 0.1^2
                prior_new += -0.5 * (rt_new[t] - rt[t-1])^2 / 0.1^2
            end

            log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

            n_total += 1
            if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
                rt = rt_new
                n_accepted += 1
            end
        end

        # Update day-of-week effects
        for d in 1:6
            dow_new = copy(dow_effects)
            dow_new[d] += randn() * 0.06

            infections = renewal_infections(rt, gen_pmf)

            expected_old = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week, delay_pmf)
            expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_new, day_of_week, delay_pmf)

            ll_old = sum([negbin_logpdf(cases[i], expected_old[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])
            ll_new = sum([negbin_logpdf(cases[i], expected_new[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])

            # Prior
            prior_old = -0.5 * dow_effects[d]^2 / 0.3^2
            prior_new = -0.5 * dow_new[d]^2 / 0.3^2

            log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

            n_total += 1
            if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
                dow_effects = dow_new
                n_accepted += 1
            end
        end

        # Update ascertainment
        for t in 1:n_days
            asc_new = copy(ascertainment)
            asc_new[t] += randn() * 0.02
            asc_new[t] = clamp(asc_new[t], 0.1, 0.8)

            infections = renewal_infections(rt, gen_pmf)

            expected_old = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week, delay_pmf)
            expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections, asc_new, dow_effects, day_of_week, delay_pmf)

            ll_old = sum([negbin_logpdf(cases[i], expected_old[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])
            ll_new = sum([negbin_logpdf(cases[i], expected_new[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])

            log_ratio = ll_new - ll_old

            n_total += 1
            if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
                ascertainment = asc_new
                n_accepted += 1
            end
        end

        # Update overdispersion
        phi_new = phi + randn() * 1.0
        phi_new = max(phi_new, 0.5)

        infections = renewal_infections(rt, gen_pmf)
        expected = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week, delay_pmf)

        ll_old = sum([negbin_logpdf(cases[i], expected[i], phi) for i in 1:n_days])
        ll_new = sum([negbin_logpdf(cases[i], expected[i], phi_new) for i in 1:n_days])

        # IG(3, 0.2) prior
        prior_old = -4.0 * log(phi) - 0.2 / phi
        prior_new = -4.0 * log(phi_new) - 0.2 / phi_new

        log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

        n_total += 1
        if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
            phi = phi_new
            n_accepted += 1
        end

        # Store samples
        if iter > n_burn
            sample_idx = iter - n_burn
            rt_samples[:, sample_idx] = rt
            dow_samples[:, sample_idx] = dow_effects
            asc_samples[:, sample_idx] = ascertainment
            phi_samples[sample_idx] = phi
        end
    end

    final_acceptance = n_accepted / n_total * 100
    println("MCMC completed! Final acceptance rate: $(round(final_acceptance, digits=1))%")

    # Process results
    println("\nProcessing results...")

    function safe_quantile(x, q)
        valid_x = x[isfinite.(x)]
        return length(valid_x) > 0 ? quantile(valid_x, q) : NaN
    end

    # Rt estimates
    rt_summary = DataFrame(
        date = dates,
        mean = [mean(rt_samples[i, :]) for i in 1:n_days],
        std = [std(rt_samples[i, :]) for i in 1:n_days],
        q025 = [safe_quantile(rt_samples[i, :], 0.025) for i in 1:n_days],
        median = [safe_quantile(rt_samples[i, :], 0.5) for i in 1:n_days],
        q975 = [safe_quantile(rt_samples[i, :], 0.975) for i in 1:n_days]
    )

    CSV.write("results/rt_estimates.csv", rt_summary)

    # Day-of-week effects
    dow_summary = DataFrame(
        day = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"],
        log_effect_median = [safe_quantile(dow_samples[i, :], 0.5) for i in 1:6],
        multiplier_median = [exp(safe_quantile(dow_samples[i, :], 0.5)) for i in 1:6],
        multiplier_q025 = [exp(safe_quantile(dow_samples[i, :], 0.025)) for i in 1:6],
        multiplier_q975 = [exp(safe_quantile(dow_samples[i, :], 0.975)) for i in 1:6]
    )

    CSV.write("results/day_of_week_effects.csv", dow_summary)

    # Ascertainment
    asc_summary = DataFrame(
        date = dates,
        mean = [mean(asc_samples[i, :]) for i in 1:n_days],
        median = [safe_quantile(asc_samples[i, :], 0.5) for i in 1:n_days],
        q025 = [safe_quantile(asc_samples[i, :], 0.025) for i in 1:n_days],
        q975 = [safe_quantile(asc_samples[i, :], 0.975) for i in 1:n_days]
    )

    CSV.write("results/ascertainment_estimates.csv", asc_summary)

    # Overdispersion
    phi_summary = DataFrame(
        parameter = ["phi"],
        mean = [mean(phi_samples)],
        median = [safe_quantile(phi_samples, 0.5)],
        q025 = [safe_quantile(phi_samples, 0.025)],
        q975 = [safe_quantile(phi_samples, 0.975)]
    )

    CSV.write("results/overdispersion.csv", phi_summary)

    println("All results saved to CSV files")

    # Print key results
    current_rt = rt_summary.median[end]
    current_ci = [rt_summary.q025[end], rt_summary.q975[end]]

    println("\n" * "="^60)
    println("FINAL RESULTS")
    println("="^60)

    println("\n🎯 CURRENT RT ESTIMATE ($(dates[end])):")
    println("   Rt = $(round(current_rt, digits=3)) [$(round(current_ci[1], digits=3)), $(round(current_ci[2], digits=3))]")

    if current_rt > 1.05
        println("   📈 Epidemic is growing (Rt significantly > 1)")
    elseif current_rt < 0.95
        println("   📉 Epidemic is declining (Rt significantly < 1)")
    else
        println("   ⚖️  Epidemic is approximately stable (Rt ≈ 1)")
    end

    println("\n📊 RT TRAJECTORY:")
    println("   Initial Rt ($(dates[1])): $(round(rt_summary.median[1], digits=3))")
    println("   Final Rt ($(dates[end])): $(round(current_rt, digits=3))")
    println("   Overall change: $(round(current_rt - rt_summary.median[1], digits=3))")

    println("\n📅 DAY-OF-WEEK EFFECTS:")
    for i in 1:6
        day = dow_summary.day[i]
        mult = dow_summary.multiplier_median[i]
        ci_low = dow_summary.multiplier_q025[i]
        ci_high = dow_summary.multiplier_q975[i]

        effect_desc = mult > 1.1 ? "higher reporting" : mult < 0.9 ? "lower reporting" : "similar reporting"

        println("   $(day): $(round(mult, digits=3))x [$(round(ci_low, digits=3)), $(round(ci_high, digits=3))] ($(effect_desc))")
    end
    println("   Sunday: 1.000x (reference)")

    println("\n🔍 ASCERTAINMENT RATES:")
    initial_asc = asc_summary.median[1] * 100
    final_asc = asc_summary.median[end] * 100
    println("   Initial: $(round(initial_asc, digits=1))% of infections reported")
    println("   Final: $(round(final_asc, digits=1))% of infections reported")
    println("   Change: $(round(final_asc - initial_asc, digits=1)) percentage points")

    println("\n📈 OVERDISPERSION:")
    phi_med = phi_summary.median[1]
    phi_ci = [phi_summary.q025[1], phi_summary.q975[1]]
    println("   φ = $(round(phi_med, digits=2)) [$(round(phi_ci[1], digits=2)), $(round(phi_ci[2], digits=2))]")
    println("   (Higher φ indicates less overdispersion)")

    # Create plots
    try
        p1 = plot(dates, rt_summary.median,
                 ribbon=(rt_summary.median - rt_summary.q025, rt_summary.q975 - rt_summary.median),
                 fillalpha=0.3, linewidth=2,
                 title="Time-varying Reproduction Number",
                 xlabel="Date", ylabel="Rt",
                 label="Rt estimate", legend=:topright)
        hline!([1.0], color=:red, linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2, label="Rt = 1")

        p2 = bar(dow_summary.day, dow_summary.multiplier_median,
                yerror=(dow_summary.multiplier_median - dow_summary.multiplier_q025,
                       dow_summary.multiplier_q975 - dow_summary.multiplier_median),
                title="Day-of-Week Reporting Effects",
                xlabel="Day", ylabel="Reporting Multiplier",
                legend=false, xrotation=45)
        hline!([1.0], color=:red, linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)

        p3 = plot(dates, asc_summary.median * 100,
                 ribbon=(asc_summary.median - asc_summary.q025, asc_summary.q975 - asc_summary.median) * 100,
                 fillalpha=0.3, linewidth=2,
                 title="Time-varying Ascertainment",
                 xlabel="Date", ylabel="Ascertainment (%)",
                 label="Ascertainment rate", color=:green)

        # Model fit comparison
        final_infections = renewal_infections(rt_summary.median, gen_pmf)
        dow_mults = vcat(dow_summary.multiplier_median, [1.0])  # Add Sunday
        model_expected = compute_expected_cases(final_infections, asc_summary.median,
                                              log.(dow_mults[1:6]), day_of_week, delay_pmf)

        p4 = scatter(dates, cases, label="Observed", alpha=0.7, color=:black,
                    title="Model Fit", xlabel="Date", ylabel="Daily Cases")
        plot!(dates, model_expected, label="Model", linewidth=2, color=:red)

        combined_plot = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4, layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800))
        savefig(combined_plot, "results/rt_analysis_summary.png")

        println("\n📊 Plots saved: results/rt_analysis_summary.png")

    catch e
        println("\n⚠️  Could not create plots: $(e)")
    end

    println("\n" * "="^60)
    println("✅ ANALYSIS COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!")
    println("="^60)

    println("\n📁 Results saved in 'results/' directory:")
    println("   📊 rt_estimates.csv - Complete Rt trajectory with uncertainty")
    println("   📅 day_of_week_effects.csv - Day-of-week reporting effects")
    println("   🔍 ascertainment_estimates.csv - Time-varying ascertainment rates")
    println("   📈 overdispersion.csv - Overdispersion parameter")
    println("   📸 rt_analysis_summary.png - Summary visualisation")

    println("\n🔬 Successfully implemented:")
    println("   ✅ Renewal equation for infection dynamics")
    println("   ✅ Day-of-week reporting effects")
    println("   ✅ Time-varying ascertainment rates")
    println("   ✅ Overdispersion via negative binomial")
    println("   ✅ Infection-to-reporting delays")

    println("\nCompleted: $(now())")
end

# Run the analysis
run_rt_analysis()
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.

"""
Robust Rt estimation with structured observation processes

This version includes better numerical stability and error handling.
"""

using CSV
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using LinearAlgebra
using Random
using Plots
using StatsPlots
using Dates
using SpecialFunctions
using Statistics

println("=== Robust Rt Estimation with Complex Observation Processes ===")
println("Starting analysis at $(now())")

Random.seed!(42)

# Load data
println("\n1. Loading and preprocessing data...")
data = CSV.read("data/cases_dow.csv", DataFrame)
sort!(data, :date)

n_days = nrow(data)
cases = data.cases
day_of_week = data.day_of_week
dates = data.date

println("   Data: $(n_days) days, $(sum(cases)) total cases")

# Show day-of-week pattern
dow_names = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
for d in 1:7
    mean_cases = mean(cases[day_of_week .== d])
    println("   $(dow_names[d]): $(round(mean_cases, digits=1)) avg cases")
end

# Epidemiological parameters
println("\n2. Setting up model parameters...")

# Generation interval
gen_mean, gen_sd = 5.5, 2.1
max_gen = 15  # Reduced for numerical stability
gen_shape = (gen_mean / gen_sd)^2
gen_scale = gen_sd^2 / gen_mean
gen_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale), i) for i in 1:max_gen]
gen_pmf ./= sum(gen_pmf)

# Reporting delay
delay_mean, delay_sd = 7.0, 3.0
max_delay = 15  # Reduced for numerical stability
delay_shape = (delay_mean / delay_sd)^2
delay_scale = delay_sd^2 / delay_mean
delay_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(delay_shape, delay_scale), i) for i in 1:max_delay]
delay_pmf ./= sum(delay_pmf)

println("   Generation interval: $(round(sum((1:max_gen) .* gen_pmf), digits=2)) days")
println("   Reporting delay: $(round(sum((1:max_delay) .* delay_pmf), digits=2)) days")

# Simple implementation of renewal equation with observation model
println("\n3. Implementing streamlined Bayesian model...")

function safe_logistic(x)
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-clamp(x, -10.0, 10.0)))
end

function compute_renewal_infections(log_rt, gen_pmf, initial_infections=1000.0)
    n_t = length(log_rt)
    seed_days = length(gen_pmf)

    infections = zeros(n_t + seed_days)
    infections[1:seed_days] .= initial_infections

    for t in (seed_days + 1):(n_t + seed_days)
        t_idx = t - seed_days
        Rt = exp(clamp(log_rt[t_idx], -3.0, 3.0))  # Clamp for numerical stability

        infectiousness = 0.0
        for s in 1:min(seed_days, t-1)
            infectiousness += infections[t - s] * gen_pmf[s]
        end

        infections[t] = max(Rt * infectiousness, 1e-10)  # Prevent negative/zero
    end

    return infections[(seed_days + 1):end]
end

function compute_expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, ascertainment_rates, dow_effects, day_of_week)
    n_t = length(infections)
    expected_cases = zeros(n_t)

    for t in 1:n_t
        # Apply reporting delay
        delayed_infections = 0.0
        for d in 1:min(length(delay_pmf), t)
            if t - d + 1 >= 1
                delayed_infections += infections[t - d + 1] * delay_pmf[d]
            end
        end

        # Apply observation processes
        dow = day_of_week[t]
        dow_mult = dow <= 6 ? exp(clamp(dow_effects[dow], -1.0, 1.0)) : 1.0
        ascertainment = clamp(ascertainment_rates[t], 0.01, 0.99)

        expected_cases[t] = max(delayed_infections * ascertainment * dow_mult, 1e-6)
    end

    return expected_cases
end

function negative_binomial_logpdf(k, μ, φ)
    # Robust negative binomial log pdf
    μ = max(μ, 1e-8)
    φ = max(φ, 0.1)

    if k < 0 || !isfinite(μ) || !isfinite(φ)
        return -Inf
    end

    r = φ
    p = r / (r + μ)

    if p <= 0.0 || p >= 1.0
        return -Inf
    end

    return loggamma(k + r) - loggamma(r) - loggamma(k + 1) + r * log(p) + k * log(1 - p)
end

# Simplified MCMC with better numerical handling
println("   Running MCMC estimation...")

function robust_mcmc_estimation(cases, day_of_week, gen_pmf, delay_pmf;
                               n_samples=800, n_burn=400)

    n_t = length(cases)

    # Initialize parameters
    log_rt = zeros(n_t)
    dow_effects = zeros(6)  # Mon-Sat, Sunday = reference
    ascertainment = fill(0.3, n_t)
    phi = 5.0

    # Parameter storage
    rt_samples = zeros(n_t, n_samples)
    dow_samples = zeros(6, n_samples)
    asc_samples = zeros(n_t, n_samples)
    phi_samples = zeros(n_samples)
    ll_samples = zeros(n_samples)

    # Proposal standard deviations
    rt_sd = 0.03
    dow_sd = 0.08
    asc_sd = 0.02
    phi_sd = 1.0

    accepted = 0
    total = 0

    for iter in 1:(n_samples + n_burn)
        if iter % 200 == 0
            acc_rate = accepted / max(total, 1) * 100
            println("     Iteration $(iter), acceptance: $(round(acc_rate, digits=1))%")
        end

        # Update Rt with smoothness constraint
        for t in 1:n_t
            log_rt_new = copy(log_rt)
            log_rt_new[t] += randn() * rt_sd

            # Compute log likelihood
            infections = compute_renewal_infections(log_rt, gen_pmf)
            expected_cases = compute_expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week)

            ll_old = sum([negative_binomial_logpdf(cases[i], expected_cases[i], phi) for i in 1:n_t])

            infections_new = compute_renewal_infections(log_rt_new, gen_pmf)
            expected_cases_new = compute_expected_cases(infections_new, delay_pmf, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week)

            ll_new = sum([negative_binomial_logpdf(cases[i], expected_cases_new[i], phi) for i in 1:n_t])

            # Priors
            prior_old = -0.5 * log_rt[t]^2 / 0.2^2
            prior_new = -0.5 * log_rt_new[t]^2 / 0.2^2

            if t > 1
                prior_old += -0.5 * (log_rt[t] - log_rt[t-1])^2 / 0.02^2
                prior_new += -0.5 * (log_rt_new[t] - log_rt[t-1])^2 / 0.02^2
            end

            log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

            total += 1
            if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
                log_rt = log_rt_new
                accepted += 1
            end
        end

        # Update day-of-week effects
        for d in 1:6
            dow_new = copy(dow_effects)
            dow_new[d] += randn() * dow_sd

            infections = compute_renewal_infections(log_rt, gen_pmf)
            expected_old = compute_expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week)
            expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, ascertainment, dow_new, day_of_week)

            ll_old = sum([negative_binomial_logpdf(cases[i], expected_old[i], phi) for i in 1:n_t])
            ll_new = sum([negative_binomial_logpdf(cases[i], expected_new[i], phi) for i in 1:n_t])

            prior_old = -0.5 * dow_effects[d]^2 / 0.3^2
            prior_new = -0.5 * dow_new[d]^2 / 0.3^2

            log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

            total += 1
            if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
                dow_effects = dow_new
                accepted += 1
            end
        end

        # Update ascertainment with smoothness
        for t in 1:n_t
            asc_new = copy(ascertainment)
            asc_new[t] = clamp(asc_new[t] + randn() * asc_sd, 0.01, 0.99)

            infections = compute_renewal_infections(log_rt, gen_pmf)
            expected_old = compute_expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week)
            expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, asc_new, dow_effects, day_of_week)

            ll_old = sum([negative_binomial_logpdf(cases[i], expected_old[i], phi) for i in 1:n_t])
            ll_new = sum([negative_binomial_logpdf(cases[i], expected_new[i], phi) for i in 1:n_t])

            # Smoothness prior
            prior_old = -0.5 * (ascertainment[t] - 0.3)^2 / 0.2^2
            prior_new = -0.5 * (asc_new[t] - 0.3)^2 / 0.2^2

            if t > 1
                prior_old += -0.5 * (ascertainment[t] - ascertainment[t-1])^2 / 0.01^2
                prior_new += -0.5 * (asc_new[t] - ascertainment[t-1])^2 / 0.01^2
            end

            log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

            total += 1
            if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
                ascertainment = asc_new
                accepted += 1
            end
        end

        # Update overdispersion
        phi_new = max(phi + randn() * phi_sd, 0.1)

        infections = compute_renewal_infections(log_rt, gen_pmf)
        expected = compute_expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week)

        ll_old = sum([negative_binomial_logpdf(cases[i], expected[i], phi) for i in 1:n_t])
        ll_new = sum([negative_binomial_logpdf(cases[i], expected[i], phi_new) for i in 1:n_t])

        # Inverse Gamma prior
        prior_old = -4.0 * log(phi) - 0.1 / phi
        prior_new = -4.0 * log(phi_new) - 0.1 / phi_new

        log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

        total += 1
        if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
            phi = phi_new
            accepted += 1
        end

        # Store samples after burn-in
        if iter > n_burn
            sample_idx = iter - n_burn
            rt_samples[:, sample_idx] = exp.(log_rt)
            dow_samples[:, sample_idx] = dow_effects
            asc_samples[:, sample_idx] = ascertainment
            phi_samples[sample_idx] = phi

            infections = compute_renewal_infections(log_rt, gen_pmf)
            expected = compute_expected_cases(infections, delay_pmf, ascertainment, dow_effects, day_of_week)
            ll_samples[sample_idx] = sum([negative_binomial_logpdf(cases[i], expected[i], phi) for i in 1:n_t])
        end
    end

    final_acc = accepted / total * 100
    println("     MCMC completed! Final acceptance rate: $(round(final_acc, digits=1))%")

    return (
        rt_samples = rt_samples,
        dow_samples = dow_samples,
        asc_samples = asc_samples,
        phi_samples = phi_samples,
        log_likelihood = ll_samples
    )
end

# Run the analysis
samples = robust_mcmc_estimation(cases, day_of_week, gen_pmf, delay_pmf)

println("\n4. Computing results and creating outputs...")

# Compute summary statistics safely
function safe_quantiles(x, probs=[0.025, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.975])
    valid_x = x[isfinite.(x)]
    if length(valid_x) == 0
        return fill(NaN, length(probs))
    end
    return quantile(valid_x, probs)
end

# Rt summary

end
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.

"""
Structured Rt Estimation with Complex Observation Processes

This script implements a sophisticated epidemiological model to estimate
time-varying reproduction number (Rt) from daily COVID-19 case counts,
accounting for:
- Renewal equation dynamics
- Delays between infection and reporting
- Day-of-week effects
- Time-varying ascertainment
- Overdispersion in observations
"""

using CSV
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using EpiAware
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Plots
using StatsPlots

println("Loading and preprocessing data...")

# Load the data
data = CSV.read("data/cases_dow.csv", DataFrame)
println("Loaded $(nrow(data)) days of data from $(minimum(data.date)) to $(maximum(data.date))")

# Sort by date to ensure chronological order
sort!(data, :date)

# Basic data exploration
println("\nData summary:")
println("Total cases: $(sum(data.cases))")
println("Daily cases range: $(minimum(data.cases)) - $(maximum(data.cases))")
println("Day-of-week pattern:")
for dow in 1:7
    days = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
    subset = data[data.day_of_week .== dow, :]
    avg_cases = round(mean(subset.cases), digits=1)
    println("  $(days[dow]): $(avg_cases) cases on average")
end

# Extract key variables
n_days = nrow(data)
cases = data.cases
day_of_week = data.day_of_week

println("\nSetting up epidemiological model components...")

# Generation interval (time from infection to infectiousness)
# Using typical values for COVID-19: gamma distribution with mean ~5.5 days
gen_interval_mean = 5.5
gen_interval_sd = 2.1
gen_interval_shape = (gen_interval_mean / gen_interval_sd)^2
gen_interval_scale = gen_interval_sd^2 / gen_interval_mean

# Discretise the generation interval
max_gen_interval = 20
gen_interval_pmf = zeros(max_gen_interval)
gen_dist = Gamma(gen_interval_shape, gen_interval_scale)
for i in 1:max_gen_interval
    gen_interval_pmf[i] = cdf(gen_dist, i) - cdf(gen_dist, i-1)
end
gen_interval_pmf ./= sum(gen_interval_pmf)  # Normalise

println("Generation interval: mean = $(round(sum(1:max_gen_interval .* gen_interval_pmf), digits=2)) days")

# Reporting delay (time from infection to case reporting)
# COVID-19 typically has ~6-8 days from infection to positive test
report_delay_mean = 7.0
report_delay_sd = 3.0
max_report_delay = 21

# Create reporting delay PMF
report_delay_shape = (report_delay_mean / report_delay_sd)^2
report_delay_scale = report_delay_sd^2 / report_delay_mean
report_delay_pmf = zeros(max_report_delay)
delay_dist = Gamma(report_delay_shape, report_delay_scale)
for i in 1:max_report_delay
    report_delay_pmf[i] = cdf(delay_dist, i) - cdf(delay_dist, i-1)
end
report_delay_pmf ./= sum(report_delay_pmf)  # Normalise

println("Reporting delay: mean = $(round(sum(1:max_report_delay .* report_delay_pmf), digits=2)) days")

println("\nBuilding EpiAware model...")

# Create the EpiAware model
# We need to handle the complex observation process with day-of-week effects,
# time-varying ascertainment, and overdispersion

# Set up the time series length including padding for delays
padding_days = max_gen_interval + max_report_delay
total_days = n_days + padding_days

# Create generation interval object for EpiAware
gi = DiscreteGenerationInterval(gen_interval_pmf, max_gen_interval)

# Create delay distribution for EpiAware
delay_int = DiscreteDelayInterval(report_delay_pmf, max_report_delay)

println("Setting up Bayesian model structure...")

# Create a structured observation model that accounts for:
# 1. Day-of-week effects (multiplicative)
# 2. Time-varying ascertainment (smooth)
# 3. Overdispersion (negative binomial)

# Prior specifications
rt_prior = Normal(1.0, 0.5)  # Rt around 1 with moderate uncertainty
ascertainment_prior = Normal(logit(0.3), 0.5)  # ~30% ascertainment on logit scale
dow_prior = Normal(0.0, 0.3)  # Day-of-week effects (log scale)
overdispersion_prior = InverseGamma(3, 0.1)  # Overdispersion parameter

# Model structure using EpiAware framework
# We'll need to create custom observation and latent processes

println("Implementing renewal equation with structured observation...")

# For the renewal equation, we need to set up:
# 1. Latent infection process following renewal equation
# 2. Observation process with delays, day-of-week effects, ascertainment, and overdispersion

# This is a complex model that requires careful implementation
# Let me create a comprehensive structure

function create_structured_rt_model(cases, day_of_week, gi, delay_int, n_days)

    # Random walk prior for log Rt
    rt_process = RandomWalk(
        init_prior = Normal(0.0, 0.1),  # log(Rt) starts near 0 (Rt ≈ 1)
        var_prior = InverseGamma(2, 0.01)  # Small daily variations
    )

    # Smooth random walk for time-varying ascertainment (logit scale)
    ascertainment_process = RandomWalk(
        init_prior = Normal(logit(0.3), 0.3),
        var_prior = InverseGamma(2, 0.001)  # Very smooth changes
    )

    # Day-of-week effects (fixed effects)
    # We'll model 6 effects (using Sunday as reference)
    dow_effects = fill(Normal(0.0, 0.3), 6)

    # Overdispersion parameter
    overdispersion = InverseGamma(3, 0.1)

    # Create the latent infection model using renewal equation
    latent_model = RenewalLatentModel(
        gen_int = gi,
        log_rt_prior = rt_process,
        init_prior = Normal(8.0, 1.0)  # Initial log infections
    )

    # Create observation model with structured effects
    observation_model = NegativeBinomialObservationModel(
        delay_int = delay_int,
        cluster_factor_prior = overdispersion
    )

    # Combine into full EpiAware model
    epi_model = EpiModel(
        latent = latent_model,
        observation = observation_model,
        data = cases
    )

    return epi_model, rt_process, ascertainment_process, dow_effects
end

println("Creating the epidemiological model...")

# Create the model
epi_model, rt_process, ascertainment_process, dow_effects = create_structured_rt_model(
    cases, day_of_week, gi, delay_int, n_days
)

println("Model created successfully!")
println("Components:")
println("- Renewal equation with $(length(gi.pmf)) day generation interval")
println("- Reporting delay with $(length(delay_int.pmf)) day maximum")
println("- Random walk Rt process")
println("- Day-of-week effects (6 parameters)")
println("- Time-varying ascertainment")
println("- Negative binomial overdispersion")

println("\nPreparing for MCMC sampling...")

# We'll run this in the background since it will take time
println("Note: MCMC sampling will be run in background due to computational time")

println("\nModel setup complete. Ready for inference...")
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.

"""
Main inference script for structured Rt estimation

This script runs the full Bayesian inference for the complex epidemiological model.
It will be run in the background due to computational requirements.
"""

using CSV
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using EpiAware
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Plots
using StatsPlots
using LinearAlgebra
using Random

println("Starting Rt inference with complex observation processes")
println("Timestamp: $(now())")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
Random.seed!(123)

# Load the data
data = CSV.read("data/cases_dow.csv", DataFrame)
sort!(data, :date)

n_days = nrow(data)
cases = data.cases
day_of_week = data.day_of_week
dates = data.date

println("Loaded $(n_days) days of data")
println("Date range: $(minimum(dates)) to $(maximum(dates))")
println("Total cases: $(sum(cases))")

# Set up epidemiological parameters
gen_interval_mean = 5.5
gen_interval_sd = 2.1
max_gen_interval = 20

report_delay_mean = 7.0
report_delay_sd = 3.0
max_report_delay = 21

# Create generation interval PMF
gen_shape = (gen_interval_mean / gen_interval_sd)^2
gen_scale = gen_interval_sd^2 / gen_interval_mean
gen_dist = Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale)

gen_pmf = zeros(max_gen_interval)
for i in 1:max_gen_interval
    gen_pmf[i] = cdf(gen_dist, i) - cdf(gen_dist, i-1)
end
gen_pmf ./= sum(gen_pmf)

# Create reporting delay PMF
delay_shape = (report_delay_mean / report_delay_sd)^2
delay_scale = report_delay_sd^2 / report_delay_mean
delay_dist = Gamma(delay_shape, delay_scale)

delay_pmf = zeros(max_report_delay)
for i in 1:max_report_delay
    delay_pmf[i] = cdf(delay_dist, i) - cdf(delay_dist, i-1)
end
delay_pmf ./= sum(delay_pmf)

println("Generation interval mean: $(round(sum(1:max_gen_interval .* gen_pmf), digits=2)) days")
println("Reporting delay mean: $(round(sum(1:max_report_delay .* delay_pmf), digits=2)) days")

println("\nBuilding comprehensive Bayesian model...")

# For a complex model with day-of-week effects, time-varying ascertainment, and overdispersion,
# we need to implement a custom model structure

# Create a function to implement the full structured model
function structured_rt_model()

    # Model parameters
    n_t = n_days

    # Priors for Rt random walk (on log scale)
    rt_init ~ Normal(0.0, 0.2)  # Initial log(Rt)
    rt_rw_sd ~ InverseGamma(2, 0.01)  # Random walk variance

    # Rt random walk
    log_rt = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_t)
    log_rt[1] = rt_init
    for t in 2:n_t
        log_rt[t] ~ Normal(log_rt[t-1], rt_rw_sd)
    end

    # Day-of-week effects (multiplicative, on log scale)
    # Use Sunday (day 7) as reference (effect = 0)
    dow_effects = zeros(7)
    for d in 1:6  # Monday through Saturday
        dow_effects[d] ~ Normal(0.0, 0.3)
    end

    # Time-varying ascertainment (smooth random walk on logit scale)
    asc_init ~ Normal(logit(0.3), 0.3)  # Initial ascertainment ~30%
    asc_rw_sd ~ InverseGamma(3, 0.001)  # Very smooth changes

    logit_ascertainment = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_t)
    logit_ascertainment[1] = asc_init
    for t in 2:n_t
        logit_ascertainment[t] ~ Normal(logit_ascertainment[t-1], asc_rw_sd)
    end

    # Overdispersion parameter for negative binomial
    phi ~ InverseGamma(3, 0.1)

    # Initial infections seeding
    I0_log ~ Normal(8.0, 1.0)  # log initial infections
    seed_days = max_gen_interval
    I_seed = exp(I0_log) .* ones(seed_days)

    # Implement renewal equation
    infections = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_t + seed_days)
    infections[1:seed_days] = I_seed

    for t in (seed_days + 1):(n_t + seed_days)
        t_idx = t - seed_days  # Index for Rt
        Rt = exp(log_rt[t_idx])

        # Renewal equation: I_t = R_t * sum(I_{t-s} * g_s)
        renewal_sum = 0.0
        for s in 1:min(max_gen_interval, t-1)
            renewal_sum += infections[t - s] * gen_pmf[s]
        end
        infections[t] = Rt * renewal_sum
    end

    # Extract infections for observation period
    I_t = infections[(seed_days + 1):end]

    # Apply reporting delay to get expected reports by infection date
    expected_reports = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_t)
    for t in 1:n_t
        expected_reports[t] = 0.0
        for d in 1:min(max_report_delay, t)
            if t - d + 1 >= 1
                expected_reports[t] += I_t[t - d + 1] * delay_pmf[d]
            end
        end
    end

    # Apply day-of-week effects and time-varying ascertainment
    expected_cases = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_t)
    for t in 1:n_t
        dow = day_of_week[t]
        dow_effect = exp(dow_effects[dow])
        ascertainment = logistic(logit_ascertainment[t])
        expected_cases[t] = expected_reports[t] * ascertainment * dow_effect
    end

    # Likelihood: negative binomial for overdispersion
    for t in 1:n_t
        # Parameterise negative binomial by mean and overdispersion
        μ = max(expected_cases[t], 1e-8)  # Ensure positive
        r = phi  # Overdispersion parameter
        p = r / (r + μ)
        cases[t] ~ NegativeBinomial(r, p)
    end

    return (
        log_rt = log_rt,
        rt = exp.(log_rt),
        dow_effects = dow_effects,
        ascertainment = logistic.(logit_ascertainment),
        infections = I_t,
        expected_cases = expected_cases,
        phi = phi
    )
end

# Since the EpiAware integration is complex, let's implement a working
# renewal equation model with Turing.jl-style syntax manually

using Turing

@model function rt_renewal_model(cases, day_of_week, gen_pmf, delay_pmf)

    n_t = length(cases)
    seed_days = length(gen_pmf)

    # Priors
    rt_init ~ Normal(0.0, 0.2)  # log(R0)
    rt_rw_sd ~ InverseGamma(2, 0.01)

    # Random walk for log(Rt)
    log_rt = Vector{Real}(undef, n_t)
    log_rt[1] = rt_init
    for t in 2:n_t
        log_rt[t] ~ Normal(log_rt[t-1], rt_rw_sd)
    end

    # Day-of-week effects (6 parameters, Sunday = reference)
    dow_raw ~ filldist(Normal(0.0, 0.3), 6)
    dow_effects = vcat(dow_raw, 0.0)  # Sunday effect = 0

    # Time-varying ascertainment
    asc_init ~ Normal(logit(0.3), 0.3)
    asc_rw_sd ~ InverseGamma(3, 0.001)

    logit_asc = Vector{Real}(undef, n_t)
    logit_asc[1] = asc_init
    for t in 2:n_t
        logit_asc[t] ~ Normal(logit_asc[t-1], asc_rw_sd)
    end

    # Overdispersion
    phi ~ InverseGamma(3, 0.1)

    # Initial seeding
    I0_log ~ Normal(8.0, 1.0)

    # Renewal equation implementation
    infections = Vector{Real}(undef, n_t + seed_days)

    # Seed initial infections
    for i in 1:seed_days
        infections[i] = exp(I0_log)
    end

    # Renewal equation
    for t in (seed_days + 1):(n_t + seed_days)
        t_idx = t - seed_days
        Rt = exp(log_rt[t_idx])

        infectiousness = 0.0
        for s in 1:min(length(gen_pmf), t-1)
            infectiousness += infections[t - s] * gen_pmf[s]
        end

        infections[t] = Rt * infectiousness
    end

    # Extract infections for the observation period
    I_obs = infections[(seed_days + 1):end]

    # Apply delays and observation processes
    for t in 1:n_t
        # Convolve with delay distribution
        delayed_infections = 0.0
        for d in 1:min(length(delay_pmf), t)
            if t - d + 1 >= 1
                delayed_infections += I_obs[t - d + 1] * delay_pmf[d]
            end
        end

        # Apply day-of-week effect and ascertainment
        dow = day_of_week[t]
        dow_multiplier = exp(dow_effects[dow])
        ascertainment = logistic(logit_asc[t])

        expected_cases = delayed_infections * ascertainment * dow_multiplier
        expected_cases = max(expected_cases, 1e-6)  # Numerical stability

        # Negative binomial likelihood
        cases[t] ~ NegativeBinomial(phi, phi / (phi + expected_cases))
    end

    # Return key quantities for post-processing
    return (
        rt = exp.(log_rt),
        log_rt = log_rt,
        dow_effects = dow_effects,
        ascertainment = logistic.(logit_asc),
        infections = I_obs,
        phi = phi
    )
end

println("Turing model defined successfully")

# Create the model
model = rt_renewal_model(cases, day_of_week, gen_pmf, delay_pmf)

println("Model instantiated. Beginning MCMC sampling...")
println("Using Pathfinder for initialization followed by NUTS sampling")

# Use Pathfinder for fast approximate inference first
try
    pathfinder_result = pathfinder(model; ndraws=1000, maxiters=100)
    println("Pathfinder completed successfully")

    # Now run full MCMC with better initialization
    n_samples = 1000
    n_chains = 4
    n_adapt = 500

    println("Running MCMC with $(n_chains) chains, $(n_samples) samples each")

    # Sample using NUTS
    chain = sample(model, NUTS(n_adapt, 0.8), MCMCThreads(), n_samples, n_chains)

    println("MCMC sampling completed successfully!")

    # Save results
    println("Saving results...")

    # Extract key parameters
    rt_samples = group(chain, "rt")
    dow_samples = group(chain, "dow_raw")
    asc_samples = group(chain, "logit_asc")
    phi_samples = group(chain, "phi")

    # Compute summary statistics
    rt_summary = summarise(rt_samples)

    # Save to CSV
    CSV.write("results/rt_estimates.csv", DataFrame(rt_summary))

    # Create comprehensive results
    results_dict = Dict(
        "rt_posterior" => Array(rt_samples),
        "rt_summary" => rt_summary,
        "dow_effects" => Array(dow_samples),
        "ascertainment" => Array(asc_samples),
        "overdispersion" => Array(phi_samples),
        "dates" => dates,
        "cases" => cases
    )

    # Save results
    using Serialization
    serialize("results/full_results.jls", results_dict)

    println("Results saved to results/ directory")

    # Current Rt estimate (most recent)
    current_rt = rt_summary[end, :]
    println("\nCURRENT RT ESTIMATE:")
    println("Date: $(dates[end])")
    println("Rt median: $(round(current_rt.median, digits=3))")
    println("Rt 95% CI: [$(round(current_rt.q025, digits=3)), $(round(current_rt.q975, digits=3))]")

    # Day-of-week summary
    println("\nDAY-OF-WEEK EFFECTS:")
    dow_names = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
    dow_summary = summarise(dow_samples)
    for (i, day) in enumerate(dow_names[1:6])
        effect = dow_summary[i, :]
        multiplier = exp(effect.median)
        println("$(day): $(round(multiplier, digits=3))x [$(round(exp(effect.q025), digits=3)), $(round(exp(effect.q975), digits=3))]")
    end
    println("Sun: 1.000x (reference)")

    println("\nInference completed successfully!")

catch e
    println("Error during inference: $e")
    println("Stacktrace:")
    println(stacktrace(catch_backtrace()))
    exit(1)
end

println("Script completed at $(now())")
```

### simple_complete_analysis.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.

"""
Complete Rt Estimation with Structured Observation Processes

A simplified but complete implementation that estimates time-varying Rt
accounting for all required components:
- Renewal equation
- Day-of-week effects
- Time-varying ascertainment
- Overdispersion
- Reporting delays
"""

using CSV, DataFrames, Distributions, Statistics, Random, Plots, SpecialFunctions, Dates

Random.seed!(42)

println("=== Complete Rt Estimation with Structured Observation Processes ===")
println("Analysis started: $(now())")

# Load and process data
data = CSV.read("data/cases_dow.csv", DataFrame)
sort!(data, :date)

cases = data.cases
day_of_week = data.day_of_week
dates = data.date
n_days = length(cases)

println("\nData loaded:")
println("- Period: $(dates[1]) to $(dates[end]) ($(n_days) days)")
println("- Total cases: $(sum(cases))")

# Show clear day-of-week pattern
println("\nDay-of-week case patterns:")
dow_names = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
for d in 1:7
    avg = mean(cases[day_of_week .== d])
    println("  $(dow_names[d]): $(round(avg, digits=0)) cases/day average")
end

# Set up epidemiological distributions
println("\nEpidemiological parameters:")

# Generation interval (time from infection to infectiousness)
gen_shape = (5.5/2.1)^2
gen_scale = (2.1^2)/5.5
gen_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, gen_scale), t) for t in 1:15]
gen_pmf ./= sum(gen_pmf)
println("- Generation interval: $(round(sum(1:15 .* gen_pmf), digits=2)) days mean")

# Reporting delay (infection to positive test)
delay_shape = (7.0/3.0)^2
delay_scale = (3.0^2)/7.0
delay_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(delay_shape, delay_scale), t) for t in 1:15]
delay_pmf ./= sum(delay_pmf)
println("- Reporting delay: $(round(sum(1:15 .* delay_pmf), digits=2)) days mean")

# Compute infections from Rt using renewal equation
function compute_infections(rt_values)
    n_t = length(rt_values)
    seed_days = 15
    I_total = zeros(n_t + seed_days)

    # Initial seeding
    I_total[1:seed_days] .= 1000.0

    # Renewal equation: I_t = R_t * sum(I_{t-s} * g_s)
    for t in (seed_days + 1):(n_t + seed_days)
        t_obs = t - seed_days  # Index into rt_values
        Rt = clamp(rt_values[t_obs], 0.1, 5.0)  # Keep reasonable

        infectiousness = sum(I_total[(t-15):(t-1)] .* gen_pmf)
        I_total[t] = Rt * infectiousness
    end

    return I_total[(seed_days + 1):end]  # Return observation period
end

# Apply observation process (delays, day-of-week, ascertainment, overdispersion)
function compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_multipliers)
    n_t = length(infections)
    expected = zeros(n_t)

    for t in 1:n_t
        # Apply reporting delay
        delayed_infections = 0.0
        for d in 1:min(15, t)
            delayed_infections += infections[t-d+1] * delay_pmf[d]
        end

        # Apply ascertainment rate
        reported_infections = delayed_infections * clamp(ascertainment[t], 0.05, 0.95)

        # Apply day-of-week effect
        dow = day_of_week[t]
        dow_effect = dow <= 6 ? dow_multipliers[dow] : 1.0  # Sunday = 1.0 reference

        expected[t] = max(reported_infections * dow_effect, 1.0)
    end

    return expected
end

# Negative binomial log-likelihood
function negbin_ll(observed, expected, phi)
    ll = 0.0
    for i in 1:length(observed)
        k = observed[i]
        μ = max(expected[i], 1e-6)
        r = max(phi, 0.1)
        p = r / (r + μ)

        if 0 < p < 1
            ll += loggamma(k + r) - loggamma(r) - loggamma(k + 1) + r*log(p) + k*log(1-p)
        else
            ll -= 1000  # Penalty for invalid parameters
        end
    end
    return ll
end

# Simple Metropolis-Hastings MCMC
println("\nRunning MCMC inference...")
println("(This implements the full structured model with all observation processes)")

n_iter = 1500
n_burn = 500
n_samples = n_iter - n_burn

# Initialize parameters
rt = ones(n_days)  # Start at Rt = 1
dow_log_effects = zeros(6)  # Monday-Saturday log effects (Sunday = 0 reference)
ascertainment = fill(0.3, n_days)  # 30% initial ascertainment
phi = 5.0  # Overdispersion parameter

# Sample storage
rt_samples = zeros(n_days, n_samples)
dow_samples = zeros(6, n_samples)
asc_samples = zeros(n_days, n_samples)
phi_samples = zeros(n_samples)

accept_count = 0
total_count = 0

for iter in 1:n_iter
    if iter % 300 == 0
        acc_rate = accept_count / max(total_count, 1) * 100
        println("  Iteration $(iter)/$(n_iter), acceptance: $(round(acc_rate, digits=1))%")
    end

    # Update Rt values (with smoothness prior)
    for t in 1:n_days
        rt_new = copy(rt)
        rt_new[t] *= exp(randn() * 0.05)  # Log-normal proposal
        rt_new[t] = clamp(rt_new[t], 0.1, 5.0)

        # Compute likelihood
        infections = compute_infections(rt)
        infections_new = compute_infections(rt_new)

        dow_mults = exp.(vcat(dow_log_effects, 0.0))
        expected = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_mults)
        expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections_new, ascertainment, dow_mults)

        ll_old = negbin_ll(cases, expected, phi)
        ll_new = negbin_ll(cases, expected_new, phi)

        # Smoothness prior on log(Rt)
        log_rt_prior_old = -0.5 * (log(rt[t]) - 0.0)^2 / 0.3^2  # Prior centered at Rt=1
        log_rt_prior_new = -0.5 * (log(rt_new[t]) - 0.0)^2 / 0.3^2

        if t > 1
            log_rt_prior_old += -0.5 * (log(rt[t]) - log(rt[t-1]))^2 / 0.05^2
            log_rt_prior_new += -0.5 * (log(rt_new[t]) - log(rt[t-1]))^2 / 0.05^2
        end

        # Accept/reject
        log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (log_rt_prior_new - log_rt_prior_old)

        total_count += 1
        if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
            rt = rt_new
            accept_count += 1
        end
    end

    # Update day-of-week effects
    for d in 1:6
        dow_new = copy(dow_log_effects)
        dow_new[d] += randn() * 0.1

        infections = compute_infections(rt)

        dow_mults_old = exp.(vcat(dow_log_effects, 0.0))
        dow_mults_new = exp.(vcat(dow_new, 0.0))

        expected_old = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_mults_old)
        expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_mults_new)

        ll_old = negbin_ll(cases, expected_old, phi)
        ll_new = negbin_ll(cases, expected_new, phi)

        # Prior: Normal(0, 0.3^2) on log effects
        prior_old = -0.5 * dow_log_effects[d]^2 / 0.3^2
        prior_new = -0.5 * dow_new[d]^2 / 0.3^2

        log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

        total_count += 1
        if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
            dow_log_effects = dow_new
            accept_count += 1
        end
    end

    # Update ascertainment rates (with smoothness)
    for t in 1:n_days
        asc_new = copy(ascertainment)
        asc_new[t] += randn() * 0.03
        asc_new[t] = clamp(asc_new[t], 0.05, 0.95)

        infections = compute_infections(rt)
        dow_mults = exp.(vcat(dow_log_effects, 0.0))

        expected_old = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_mults)
        expected_new = compute_expected_cases(infections, asc_new, dow_mults)

        ll_old = negbin_ll(cases, expected_old, phi)
        ll_new = negbin_ll(cases, expected_new, phi)

        # Smoothness prior
        prior_old = -0.5 * (ascertainment[t] - 0.3)^2 / 0.2^2
        prior_new = -0.5 * (asc_new[t] - 0.3)^2 / 0.2^2

        if t > 1
            prior_old += -0.5 * (ascertainment[t] - ascertainment[t-1])^2 / 0.02^2
            prior_new += -0.5 * (asc_new[t] - ascertainment[t-1])^2 / 0.02^2
        end

        log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

        total_count += 1
        if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
            ascertainment = asc_new
            accept_count += 1
        end
    end

    # Update overdispersion parameter
    phi_new = max(phi + randn() * 1.5, 0.1)

    infections = compute_infections(rt)
    dow_mults = exp.(vcat(dow_log_effects, 0.0))
    expected = compute_expected_cases(infections, ascertainment, dow_mults)

    ll_old = negbin_ll(cases, expected, phi)
    ll_new = negbin_ll(cases, expected, phi_new)

    # Inverse gamma prior IG(3, 0.1)
    prior_old = -4.0*log(phi) - 0.1/phi
    prior_new = -4.0*log(phi_new) - 0.1/phi_new

    log_ratio = (ll_new - ll_old) + (prior_new - prior_old)

    total_count += 1
    if isfinite(log_ratio) && log(rand()) < log_ratio
        phi = phi_new
        accept_count += 1
    end

    # Store samples after burn-in
    if iter > n_burn
        sample_idx = iter - n_burn
        rt_samples[:, sample_idx] = rt
        dow_samples[:, sample_idx] = dow_log_effects
        asc_samples[:, sample_idx] = ascertainment
        phi_samples[sample_idx] = phi
    end
end

final_acceptance = accept_count / total_count * 100
println("MCMC completed! Final acceptance rate: $(round(final_acceptance, digits=1))%")

# Process and save results
println("\nProcessing results...")

# Helper function for robust quantiles
safe_quantile(x, q) = quantile(filter(isfinite, x), q)

# Rt estimates
rt_summary = DataFrame(
    date = dates,
    mean = [mean(rt_samples[i,:]) for i in 1:n_days],
    std = [std(rt_samples[i,:]) for i in 1:n_days],

CSV.write("results/rt_estimates.csv", rt_summary)

# Day-of-week effects (convert to multipliers)

println("All results saved to CSV files in results/ directory")

# Display key findings
println("\n" * "="^70)
println("KEY RESULTS")

current_rt = rt_summary.median[end]

println("\n🎯 CURRENT RT ESTIMATE ($(dates[end])):")
println("   Rt = $(round(current_rt, digits=3)) [$(round(current_rt_ci[1], digits=3)), $(round(current_rt_ci[2], digits=3))]")

if current_rt > 1.05
    println("   📈 Rt significantly > 1: Epidemic is growing")
elseif current_rt < 0.95
    println("   📉 Rt significantly < 1: Epidemic is declining")
else

end

# Rt trajectory
initial_rt = rt_summary.median[1]
println("\n📊 RT TRAJECTORY:")
println("   Initial ($(dates[1])): $(round(initial_rt, digits=3))")

println("\n📅 DAY-OF-WEEK REPORTING EFFECTS:")
println("   (Multiplicative effects relative to Sunday = 1.0)")
for i in 1:6
    day = dow_summary.day[i]

    # Ascertainment over time

             ribbon=(asc_summary.median - asc_summary.q025, asc_summary.q975 - asc_summary.median) * 100,
             fillalpha=0.3, linewidth=2, color=:green,
             title="Time-varying Ascertainment Rate",
             ylabel="Ascertainment (%)", xlabel="Date",

    # Model fit check
```
