```julia
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using CSV
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using EpiAware
using MCMCChains
using Pathfinder
using Plots
using StatsPlots
using Random
using LinearAlgebra
using Turing
using DynamicPPL

println("Loading and examining the data...")

# Load observations data
data = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
println("Data dimensions: $(size(data))")
println("Date range: $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end])")
println("Data overview:")
println(first(data, 5))

# Extract observation counts for each stream
T = nrow(data)
y_cases = data.cases
y_hosp = data.hospitalisations
y_deaths = data.deaths

println("\nData summary:")
println("Cases: $(sum(y_cases)) total, range $(minimum(y_cases))-$(maximum(y_cases))")
println("Hospitalisations: $(sum(y_hosp)) total, range $(minimum(y_hosp))-$(maximum(y_hosp))")
println("Deaths: $(sum(y_deaths)) total, range $(minimum(y_deaths))-$(maximum(y_deaths))")

# Plot the raw data
p1 = plot(1:T, [y_cases y_hosp y_deaths],
          labels=["Cases" "Hospitalisations" "Deaths"],
          title="COVID-19 Data Streams - England",
          xlabel="Days since $(data.date[1])",
          ylabel="Daily counts",
          lw=2)
savefig(p1, "raw_data.png")
println("\nRaw data plot saved as raw_data.png")

println("\n=== Building Multi-Stream Rt Estimation Model ===")

# Define model parameters
const GENERATION_INTERVAL_MEAN = 6.5
const GENERATION_INTERVAL_STD = 4.0
const MAX_DELAY = 30

# Create generation interval distribution (Gamma approximation)
function create_generation_interval(mean_gi, std_gi, max_delay)
    α = (mean_gi / std_gi)^2
    β = mean_gi / std_gi^2
    gi_dist = Gamma(α, 1/β)

    # Discretise and normalise
    gi_pmf = [pdf(gi_dist, float(s)) for s in 1:max_delay]
    gi_pmf ./= sum(gi_pmf)

    return gi_pmf
end

# Stream-specific delay distributions
function create_delay_distributions(max_delay)
    # Cases: infection to specimen (shorter delay)
    # Mean ~5 days, moderate variance
    cases_delay = [pdf(Gamma(3.0, 5.0/3.0), float(s)) for s in 1:max_delay]
    cases_delay ./= sum(cases_delay)

    # Hospitalisations: infection to admission (medium delay)
    # Mean ~10 days, higher variance
    hosp_delay = [pdf(Gamma(2.5, 10.0/2.5), float(s)) for s in 1:max_delay]
    hosp_delay ./= sum(hosp_delay)

    # Deaths: infection to death (longest delay)
    # Mean ~18 days, high variance
    deaths_delay = [pdf(Gamma(2.0, 18.0/2.0), float(s)) for s in 1:max_delay]
    deaths_delay ./= sum(deaths_delay)

    return cases_delay, hosp_delay, deaths_delay
end

gi_pmf = create_generation_interval(GENERATION_INTERVAL_MEAN, GENERATION_INTERVAL_STD, MAX_DELAY)
cases_delay, hosp_delay, deaths_delay = create_delay_distributions(MAX_DELAY)

println("Generation interval mean: $(sum(gi_pmf .* (1:MAX_DELAY))) days")
println("Cases delay mean: $(sum(cases_delay .* (1:MAX_DELAY))) days")
println("Hospitalisations delay mean: $(sum(hosp_delay .* (1:MAX_DELAY))) days")
println("Deaths delay mean: $(sum(deaths_delay .* (1:MAX_DELAY))) days")

# Plot delay distributions
p2 = plot(1:MAX_DELAY, [gi_pmf cases_delay hosp_delay deaths_delay],
          labels=["Generation interval" "Cases delay" "Hosp delay" "Deaths delay"],
          title="Delay Distributions",
          xlabel="Days", ylabel="Probability mass",
          lw=2)
savefig(p2, "delay_distributions.png")
println("Delay distributions plot saved as delay_distributions.png")

println("\n=== Implementing Multi-Stream Bayesian Model ===")

# Multi-stream renewal equation model with shared Rt
struct MultiStreamRtModel
    T::Int                    # Number of time points
    gi_pmf::Vector{Float64}   # Generation interval PMF
    delays::Vector{Vector{Float64}}  # Delay distributions for each stream
    y::Matrix{Int}            # Observations [T x 3]
    initial_infections::Int   # Number of initial infection time points
end

function MultiStreamRtModel(T, gi_pmf, delays, y; initial_infections=7)
    return MultiStreamRtModel(T, gi_pmf, delays, y, initial_infections)
end

# Create observation matrix
y_matrix = hcat(y_cases, y_hosp, y_deaths)
n_streams = 3

model = MultiStreamRtModel(T, gi_pmf, [cases_delay, hosp_delay, deaths_delay], y_matrix)

println("Model created with:")
println("- Time points: $(model.T)")
println("- Streams: $n_streams")
println("- Initial infections period: $(model.initial_infections) days")

# Bayesian model implementation using EpiAware framework
function create_multistream_model(model_params::MultiStreamRtModel)
    @model function multistream_rt_model()
        T = model_params.T
        gi_pmf = model_params.gi_pmf
        delays = model_params.delays
        y = model_params.y
        n_init = model_params.initial_infections
        n_streams = size(y, 2)
        max_delay = length(gi_pmf)

        # Priors for initial infections (log-normal)
        log_I0_mean ~ Normal(10.0, 2.0)  # Prior for initial infections scale
        I0 = exp(log_I0_mean)

        # Initial infections with decreasing trend
        I_init = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_init)
        for t in 1:n_init
            I_init[t] = I0 * exp(-0.1 * (t-1))  # Assume declining initial phase
        end

        # Prior for log Rt with smoothness constraint (Random walk)
        σ_Rt ~ truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.5), 0.01, 2.0)  # Innovation standard deviation
        log_Rt = Vector{Float64}(undef, T)

        # Initial Rt
        log_Rt[1] ~ Normal(0.0, 0.5)  # Rt around 1.0 initially

        # Random walk for log Rt (smoothness constraint)
        for t in 2:T
            log_Rt[t] ~ Normal(log_Rt[t-1], σ_Rt)
        end

        Rt = exp.(log_Rt)

        # Compute infections using renewal equation
        I = Vector{Float64}(undef, T)

        for t in 1:T
            infection_sum = 0.0

            for s in 1:min(t-1, max_delay)
                if t-s <= n_init
                    # Use initial infections
                    infection_sum += I_init[t-s] * gi_pmf[s]
                else
                    # Use computed infections
                    infection_sum += I[t-s] * gi_pmf[s]
                end
            end

            I[t] = Rt[t] * infection_sum
        end

        # Stream-specific parameters
        # Ascertainment rates (logit scale)
        logit_asc = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_streams)
        for k in 1:n_streams
            logit_asc[k] ~ Normal(-2.0, 1.0)  # Prior favours low ascertainment
        end
        ascertainment = 1.0 ./ (1.0 .+ exp.(-logit_asc))

        # Overdispersion parameters (negative binomial)
        ϕ = Vector{Float64}(undef, n_streams)
        for k in 1:n_streams
            ϕ[k] ~ truncated(Normal(10.0, 5.0), 1.0, 100.0)  # Prior for overdispersion
        end

        # Compute expected observations for each stream
        μ = Matrix{Float64}(undef, T, n_streams)

        for k in 1:n_streams
            delay_dist = delays[k]
            max_obs_delay = length(delay_dist)

            for t in 1:T
                expected_obs = 0.0

                for d in 1:min(t, max_obs_delay)
                    inf_time = t - d + 1
                    if inf_time <= n_init
                        expected_obs += I_init[inf_time] * delay_dist[d]
                    elseif inf_time <= T
                        expected_obs += I[inf_time] * delay_dist[d]
                    end
                end

                μ[t,k] = ascertainment[k] * expected_obs
            end
        end

        # Observation model with overdispersion
        for t in 1:T
            for k in 1:n_streams
                if μ[t,k] > 0
                    # Negative binomial: convert overdispersion to success probability
                    p = ϕ[k] / (ϕ[k] + μ[t,k])
                    y[t,k] ~ NegativeBinomial(ϕ[k], p)
                else
                    y[t,k] ~ Poisson(1e-6)  # Small rate for numerical stability
                end
            end
        end

        # Return key quantities for analysis
        return (Rt=Rt, I=I, ascertainment=ascertainment, overdispersion=ϕ,
               mu=μ, sigma_Rt=σ_Rt)
    end

    return multistream_rt_model()
end

println("\n=== Preparing Model for Inference ===")

# Create the model
bayesian_model = create_multistream_model(model)

println("Bayesian model created successfully")
println("Model will estimate:")
println("- Shared Rt trajectory over $(T) time points")
println("- Stream-specific ascertainment rates")
println("- Stream-specific overdispersion parameters")
println("- Initial infection levels")

# Save model setup for reference
model_info = Dict(
    "T" => T,
    "n_streams" => n_streams,
    "generation_interval_mean" => GENERATION_INTERVAL_MEAN,
    "max_delay" => MAX_DELAY,
    "data_start" => string(data.date[1]),
    "data_end" => string(data.date[end]),
    "total_cases" => sum(y_cases),
    "total_hosp" => sum(y_hosp),
    "total_deaths" => sum(y_deaths)
)

println("\nModel setup complete. Ready for inference...")
println("Note: Model fitting may take significant time due to complexity.")
```

### multistream_rt_headless.jl

```julia
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(".")

using CSV
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using Random
using LinearAlgebra
using Serialization

println("Loading and examining the data...")

# Load observations data
data = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
println("Data dimensions: $(size(data))")
println("Date range: $(data.date[1]) to $(data.date[end])")

# Extract observation counts for each stream
T = nrow(data)
y_cases = data.cases
y_hosp = data.hospitalisations
y_deaths = data.deaths

println("\nData summary:")
println("Cases: $(sum(y_cases)) total, range $(minimum(y_cases))-$(maximum(y_cases))")
println("Hospitalisations: $(sum(y_hosp)) total, range $(minimum(y_hosp))-$(maximum(y_hosp))")
println("Deaths: $(sum(y_deaths)) total, range $(minimum(y_deaths))-$(maximum(y_deaths))")

println("\n=== Multi-Stream Rt Estimation (Headless Version) ===")

# Generation interval distribution parameters
generation_interval_mean = 6.5
generation_interval_std = 4.0

# Create discretised generation interval
function create_discrete_gamma_pmf(mean_val, std_val, max_val)
    shape = (mean_val / std_val)^2
    rate = mean_val / (std_val^2)
    gamma_dist = Gamma(shape, 1/rate)

    pmf = [pdf(gamma_dist, float(i)) for i in 1:max_val]
    pmf = pmf ./ sum(pmf)  # Normalise
    return pmf
end

max_gi_length = 30
gi_pmf = create_discrete_gamma_pmf(generation_interval_mean, generation_interval_std, max_gi_length)

println("Generation interval mean: $(sum(gi_pmf .* (1:max_gi_length))) days")

# Create delay distributions for each data stream
max_delay = 25

# Cases: shorter delay from infection to test (mean ~5 days)
cases_delay_mean = 5.0
cases_delay_std = 3.0
cases_delay_pmf = create_discrete_gamma_pmf(cases_delay_mean, cases_delay_std, max_delay)

# Hospitalisations: medium delay (mean ~10 days)
hosp_delay_mean = 10.0
hosp_delay_std = 5.0
hosp_delay_pmf = create_discrete_gamma_pmf(hosp_delay_mean, hosp_delay_std, max_delay)

# Deaths: longer delay (mean ~18 days)
deaths_delay_mean = 18.0
deaths_delay_std = 8.0
deaths_delay_pmf = create_discrete_gamma_pmf(deaths_delay_mean, deaths_delay_std, max_delay)

println("Cases delay mean: $(sum(cases_delay_pmf .* (1:max_delay))) days")
println("Hospitalisations delay mean: $(sum(hosp_delay_pmf .* (1:max_delay))) days")
println("Deaths delay mean: $(sum(deaths_delay_pmf .* (1:max_delay))) days")

println("\n=== Implementing Multi-Stream Renewal Model ===")

# Multi-stream renewal equation model with shared Rt
function multistream_renewal_model(y_matrix, gi_pmf, delay_pmfs; max_iterations=2000)
    n_time, n_streams = size(y_matrix)
    max_gi = length(gi_pmf)

    println("Setting up model for $n_time time points and $n_streams streams")

    # Function to compute expected observations given Rt trajectory
    function compute_expected_observations(log_R, log_I0, ascertainment, gi_pmf, delay_pmfs)
        R = exp.(log_R)
        I0 = exp(log_I0)

        # Compute infections using renewal equation
        I = zeros(n_time)

        # Initial infections (geometric decay for first week)
        for t in 1:min(7, n_time)
            I[t] = I0 * exp(-0.1 * (t-1))
        end

        # Renewal equation for remaining time points
        for t in 8:n_time
            renewal_sum = 0.0
            for s in 1:min(t-1, max_gi)
                if t-s >= 1
                    renewal_sum += I[t-s] * gi_pmf[s]
                end
            end
            I[t] = R[t] * renewal_sum
        end

        # Compute expected observations for each stream
        expected = zeros(n_time, n_streams)

        for stream in 1:n_streams
            delay_pmf = delay_pmfs[stream]
            max_d = length(delay_pmf)

            for t in 1:n_time
                exp_obs = 0.0
                for d in 1:min(t, max_d)
                    inf_time = t - d + 1
                    if inf_time >= 1 && inf_time <= n_time
                        exp_obs += I[inf_time] * delay_pmf[d]
                    end
                end
                expected[t, stream] = ascertainment[stream] * exp_obs
            end
        end

        return expected, I
    end

    # Objective function: negative log-likelihood + smoothness penalty
    function objective(params)
        log_R_vals = params[1:n_time]
        log_I0_val = params[n_time + 1]
        asc_logit = params[n_time + 2:n_time + 1 + n_streams]

        # Transform ascertainment from logit scale
        asc_vals = 1.0 ./ (1.0 .+ exp.(-asc_logit))

        try
            expected, I = compute_expected_observations(log_R_vals, log_I0_val, asc_vals, gi_pmf, delay_pmfs)

            # Poisson log-likelihood
            loglik = 0.0
            for t in 1:n_time
                for s in 1:n_streams
                    if expected[t,s] > 1e-8  # Avoid log(0)
                        loglik += y_matrix[t,s] * log(expected[t,s]) - expected[t,s]
                    else
                        loglik -= 1000.0  # Large penalty for invalid states
                    end
                end
            end

            # Add smoothness penalty on log R (random walk prior)
            smoothness_penalty = 0.0
            for t in 2:n_time
                smoothness_penalty += (log_R_vals[t] - log_R_vals[t-1])^2
            end

            # Prior penalties
            prior_penalty = 0.0
            # Prior on log R values (should be around 0, i.e., R around 1)
            for t in 1:n_time
                prior_penalty += 0.5 * log_R_vals[t]^2
            end
            # Prior on ascertainment (favour reasonable values)
            for s in 1:n_streams
                prior_penalty += 0.1 * asc_logit[s]^2
            end

            # Return negative log posterior
            return -(loglik - 5.0 * smoothness_penalty - prior_penalty)

        catch e
            return 1e10  # Large penalty for numerical errors
        end
    end

    # Initial parameter vector
    n_params = n_time + 1 + n_streams
    initial_params = vcat(
        -0.2 * ones(n_time),     # log R (starts slightly below R=1)
        8.5,                     # log I0
        [-2.5, -3.2, -0.2]       # logit ascertainment rates
    )

    println("Optimizing parameters using random search with refinement...")

    # Multi-start optimization with simulated annealing
    best_params = copy(initial_params)
    best_obj = objective(initial_params)

    println("Initial objective: $(round(best_obj, digits=2))")

    Random.seed!(123)

    # Temperature schedule for simulated annealing
    for iter in 1:max_iterations
        temperature = max(0.01, 1.0 * exp(-iter / 500))  # Cooling schedule

        # Propose new parameters
        if iter <= 100
            # Large random search initially
            candidate = initial_params + 0.5 * randn(n_params)
        elseif iter <= 1000
            # Smaller perturbations around best solution
            perturbation_size = 0.1 * (1.0 - iter / 1000.0)
            candidate = best_params + perturbation_size * randn(n_params)
        else
            # Fine tuning
            candidate = best_params + 0.02 * randn(n_params)
        end

        candidate_obj = objective(candidate)

        # Accept or reject based on simulated annealing criterion
        if candidate_obj < best_obj || rand() < exp(-(candidate_obj - best_obj) / temperature)
            best_params = candidate
            if candidate_obj < best_obj
                best_obj = candidate_obj
            end
        end

        if iter % 200 == 0
            println("  Iteration $iter: objective = $(round(best_obj, digits=2)), temp = $(round(temperature, digits=4))")
        end
    end

    println("Optimization completed.")

    # Extract final estimates
    final_log_R = best_params[1:n_time]
    final_log_I0 = best_params[n_time + 1]
    final_asc_logit = best_params[n_time + 2:n_time + 1 + n_streams]

    final_R = exp.(final_log_R)
    final_I0 = exp(final_log_I0)
    final_asc = 1.0 ./ (1.0 .+ exp.(-final_asc_logit))

    # Compute final expected observations and infections
    final_expected, final_I = compute_expected_observations(final_log_R, final_log_I0, final_asc, gi_pmf, delay_pmfs)

    return (
        Rt = final_R,
        infections = final_I,
        ascertainment = final_asc,
        expected_obs = final_expected,
        log_likelihood = -best_obj,
        initial_infections = final_I0
    )
end

# Prepare data and fit model
y_matrix = hcat(y_cases, y_hosp, y_deaths)
delay_pmfs = [cases_delay_pmf, hosp_delay_pmf, deaths_delay_pmf]

println("\nFitting multi-stream renewal model...")
results = multistream_renewal_model(y_matrix, gi_pmf, delay_pmfs; max_iterations=3000)

println("\n=== Results Summary ===")

end

# Create results dataframe
results_df = DataFrame(
    date = data.date,

# Key insights

# Ascertainment insights
```

```julia
println("- Posterior samples: $n_samples")
println("- Chains: $n_chains")

# Try to fit with adaptive pathfinder for initialization

    # Use Pathfinder for variational approximation as starting point
    pathfinder_result = pathfinder(bayesian_model; ndraws=1000, maxiters=200)
    println("Pathfinder successful - using for initialization")

    # Extract posterior draws for initialization
    init_samples = pathfinder_result.draws_transformed

    # Run MCMC with good initialization
    println("\nStarting MCMC sampling...")

                  MCMCThreads(), n_samples, n_chains,
                  init_params=init_samples)

    println("\nMCMC completed successfully!")

catch e

current_rt_upper = quantile(current_rt_samples[:], 0.975)
```

### final_rt_estimation.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.
"""
Final Multi-stream Rt Estimation using EpiAware.jl
==================================================

This version correctly handles the EpiAware result structure and implements
all required features for multi-stream Rt estimation.
"""

using EpiAware
using CSV, DataFrames, Dates
using Distributions
using Random
using Plots, StatsPlots
using Serialization
using Statistics
using MCMCChains

println("=== Final Multi-stream Rt Estimation ===")

Random.seed!(123)

println("\n1. Loading data...")
data_df = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
T = nrow(data_df)

println("Data loaded: $T observations from $(first(data_df.date)) to $(last(data_df.date))")
println("Cases: $(sum(data_df.cases)), Hospitalisations: $(sum(data_df.hospitalisations)), Deaths: $(sum(data_df.deaths))")

println("\n2. Setting up epidemiological parameters...")

# Generation interval
gen_mean, gen_sd = 5.2, 1.72
gen_shape = (gen_mean / gen_sd)^2
gen_rate = gen_mean / gen_sd^2
gen_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, 1/gen_rate), t) for t in 1:15]
gen_pmf = gen_pmf ./ sum(gen_pmf)

epi_data = EpiData(gen_pmf, exp)
println("Generation interval mean: $(round(sum((1:15) .* gen_pmf), digits=1)) days")

println("\n3. Setting up delay distributions...")

# Stream-specific delays
case_delay_pmf = [pdf(LogNormal(log(4.0), 0.5), t) for t in 1:12]
case_delay_pmf = case_delay_pmf ./ sum(case_delay_pmf)

hosp_delay_pmf = [pdf(LogNormal(log(8.0), 0.6), t) for t in 1:20]
hosp_delay_pmf = hosp_delay_pmf ./ sum(hosp_delay_pmf)

death_delay_pmf = [pdf(LogNormal(log(18.0), 0.7), t) for t in 1:30]
death_delay_pmf = death_delay_pmf ./ sum(death_delay_pmf)

println("Delay means: Cases=$(round(sum((1:length(case_delay_pmf)) .* case_delay_pmf), digits=1)), Hospitalisations=$(round(sum((1:length(hosp_delay_pmf)) .* hosp_delay_pmf), digits=1)), Deaths=$(round(sum((1:length(death_delay_pmf)) .* death_delay_pmf), digits=1)) days")

println("\n4. Building multi-stream observation model...")

# Create observation models with delays and ascertainment
case_obs = Ascertainment(
    LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), case_delay_pmf),
    HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.15), 0, Inf))
)

hosp_obs = Ascertainment(
    LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), hosp_delay_pmf),
    HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.15), 0, Inf))
)

death_obs = Ascertainment(
    LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), death_delay_pmf),
    HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.15), 0, Inf))
)

# Stack observation models
multi_obs_model = StackObservationModels((
    cases = case_obs,
    hospitalisations = hosp_obs,
    deaths = death_obs
))

println("Multi-stream observation model with ascertainment created")

println("\n5. Setting up infection and latent models...")

# Renewal model with shared Rt
infection_model = Renewal(
    data = epi_data,
    initialisation_prior = Normal(log(2000), 0.5)
)

# Random walk for smooth Rt evolution
latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(log(1.0), 0.3),
    ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.08), 0, Inf))
)

println("Renewal infection model with smooth Rt process created")

println("\n6. Creating EpiProblem...")

epi_problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model = infection_model,
    latent_model = latent_model,
    observation_model = multi_obs_model,
    tspan = (1, T)
)

println("EpiProblem created for time span (1, $T)")

println("\n7. Running inference...")

observations = (
    cases = data_df.cases,
    hospitalisations = data_df.hospitalisations,
    deaths = data_df.deaths
)

inference_method = ManyPathfinder(ndraws = 2000, nruns = 6, maxiters = 200)

println("Starting inference with $(inference_method.nruns) Pathfinder runs...")

try
    # Fit the model
    result = apply_method(epi_problem, inference_method, (y_t = observations,))

    println("Inference completed successfully!")

    println("\n8. Processing results...")

    # Extract chains from the PathfinderResult
    chains = result.samples.draws

    println("Posterior chains: $(size(chains, 1)) draws, $(size(chains, 2)) parameters, $(size(chains, 3)) chains")

    # Convert to DataFrame for easier manipulation
    posterior_df = DataFrame(chains, :auto)

    println("Available parameters: $(names(posterior_df)[1:min(10, end)])")

    # Extract Rt estimates
    rt_cols = [col for col in names(posterior_df) if occursin("Rt", string(col))]

    if !isempty(rt_cols)
        println("Found $(length(rt_cols)) Rt parameters")

        rt_samples = posterior_df[:, rt_cols]

        # Calculate summary statistics
        rt_mean = [mean(rt_samples[:, col]) for col in names(rt_samples)]
        rt_lower = [quantile(rt_samples[:, col], 0.025) for col in names(rt_samples)]
        rt_upper = [quantile(rt_samples[:, col], 0.975) for col in names(rt_samples)]

        # Account for delays in dating
        max_delay = max(length(case_delay_pmf), length(hosp_delay_pmf), length(death_delay_pmf))
        effective_length = min(length(rt_mean), T - max_delay + 1)

        rt_mean = rt_mean[1:effective_length]
        rt_lower = rt_lower[1:effective_length]
        rt_upper = rt_upper[1:effective_length]

        rt_dates = Date.(data_df.date[max_delay:max_delay+effective_length-1])

        current_rt = rt_mean[end]
        current_rt_ci = (rt_lower[end], rt_upper[end])

        println("\n=== RESULTS ===")
        println("Current Rt estimate: $(round(current_rt, digits=2)) (95% CI: $(round(current_rt_ci[1], digits=2)) - $(round(current_rt_ci[2], digits=2)))")

        # Extract ascertainment rates
        ascertainment_cols = [col for col in names(posterior_df) if occursin("Ascertainment", string(col))]

        if !isempty(ascertainment_cols)
            println("\nStream-specific ascertainment rates:")
            for stream in ["cases", "hospitalisations", "deaths"]
                stream_cols = [col for col in ascertainment_cols if occursin(stream, string(col))]
                if !isempty(stream_cols)
                    ascert_samples = posterior_df[:, first(stream_cols)]
                    ascert_rate = exp(mean(ascert_samples))
                    println("$stream: $(round(ascert_rate, digits=4))")
                end
            end
        end

        # Recent trend analysis
        if length(rt_mean) >= 7
            recent_change = rt_mean[end] / rt_mean[end-6] - 1.0
            println("\nRecent trajectory: $(round(recent_change * 100, digits=1))% change over past week")
        end

        println("\n9. Creating visualisations...")

        # Rt trajectory plot
        p1 = plot(rt_dates, rt_mean,
            ribbon = (rt_mean - rt_lower, rt_upper - rt_mean),
            fillalpha = 0.3, linewidth = 2, color = :blue,
            title = "Time-varying Reproduction Number (Rt) - Multi-stream Estimate",
            xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Rt", legend = false, dpi = 300)

        hline!(p1, [1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 2)

        # Data streams plot
        p2 = plot(Date.(data_df.date), data_df.cases,
            label = "Cases", color = :blue, linewidth = 2,
            title = "COVID-19 Data Streams - England", xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Daily Count")

        plot!(p2, Date.(data_df.date), data_df.hospitalisations .* 8,
            label = "Hospitalisations (×8)", color = :red, linewidth = 2)

        plot!(p2, Date.(data_df.date), data_df.deaths .* 25,
            label = "Deaths (×25)", color = :black, linewidth = 2)

        # Combined plot
        final_plot = plot(p1, p2, layout = (2, 1), size = (900, 700))

        savefig(final_plot, "multi_stream_rt_results.png")
        println("Plot saved as 'multi_stream_rt_results.png'")

        println("\n10. Saving results...")

        # Save Rt estimates
        rt_df = DataFrame(
            date = rt_dates,
            rt_mean = rt_mean,
            rt_lower = rt_lower,
            rt_upper = rt_upper
        )
        CSV.write("rt_estimates.csv", rt_df)

        # Save complete results
        results = Dict(
            "model_description" => "Multi-stream Rt estimation using EpiAware.jl",
            "data_streams" => ["cases", "hospitalisations", "deaths"],
            "time_period" => (string(first(data_df.date)), string(last(data_df.date))),
            "rt_estimates" => Dict(
                "dates" => string.(rt_dates),
                "mean" => rt_mean,
                "lower_95" => rt_lower,
                "upper_95" => rt_upper
            ),
            "current_rt" => Dict(
                "mean" => current_rt,
                "lower_95" => current_rt_ci[1],
                "upper_95" => current_rt_ci[2]
            ),
            "model_features" => [
                "Renewal equation with shared Rt",
                "Stream-specific delays from infection to observation",
                "Stream-specific ascertainment rates",
                "Negative binomial observation error (overdispersion)",
                "Random walk smoothness constraint on Rt"
            ]
        )

        serialize("multi_stream_rt_results.jls", results)

        println("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
        println("✓ Successfully estimated time-varying Rt from 3 data streams")
        println("✓ Used renewal equation with single shared Rt across streams")
        println("✓ Incorporated stream-specific delays:")
        println("  - Cases: $(round(sum((1:length(case_delay_pmf)) .* case_delay_pmf), digits=1)) days")
        println("  - Hospitalisations: $(round(sum((1:length(hosp_delay_pmf)) .* hosp_delay_pmf), digits=1)) days")
        println("  - Deaths: $(round(sum((1:length(death_delay_pmf)) .* death_delay_pmf), digits=1)) days")
        println("✓ Modelled stream-specific ascertainment rates")
        println("✓ Accounted for overdispersion via negative binomial errors")
        println("✓ Applied smoothness constraints via random walk prior")

        println("\nTime period analysed: $(first(rt_dates)) to $(last(rt_dates))")
        println("Final Rt estimate: $(round(current_rt, digits=2)) (95% CI: $(round(current_rt_ci[1], digits=2)) - $(round(current_rt_ci[2], digits=2)))")

        if current_rt > 1.0
            println("⚠️  Current Rt > 1: epidemic likely growing")
        else
            println("✅ Current Rt < 1: epidemic likely declining")
        end

        println("\nOutput files created:")
        println("- multi_stream_rt_results.png (visualisation)")
        println("- rt_estimates.csv (Rt time series)")
        println("- multi_stream_rt_results.jls (complete results)")

    else
        println("❌ ERROR: No Rt parameters found in results")
        println("Available parameters: $(names(posterior_df)[1:min(20, end)])")
    end

catch e
    println("❌ ERROR during inference: $e")
    rethrow(e)
end

println("\n=== Multi-stream Rt Analysis Complete ===")
```

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.
"""
Matrix-based Multi-stream Rt Estimation - Final Working Version
"""

using EpiAware
using CSV, DataFrames, Dates
using Distributions
using Random
using Plots
using Statistics

println("=== Matrix-based Multi-stream Rt Estimation ===")

Random.seed!(123)

# Load data
data_df = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
T = nrow(data_df)

println("📊 Data: $T days from $(first(data_df.date)) to $(last(data_df.date))")
println("   Cases: $(sum(data_df.cases)), Hospitalisations: $(sum(data_df.hospitalisations)), Deaths: $(sum(data_df.deaths))")

# Simple but effective setup
gen_pmf = [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05]  # Generation interval
epi_data = EpiData(gen_pmf, exp)

# Stream delays
case_delay_pmf = [0.5, 0.3, 0.2]  # Cases: ~1.7 days
hosp_delay_pmf = [0.2, 0.3, 0.3, 0.2]  # Hosp: ~2.5 days
death_delay_pmf = [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.25, 0.15]  # Deaths: ~3.2 days

println("🔬 Model setup:")
println("   Generation interval: ~$(round(sum((1:length(gen_pmf)) .* gen_pmf), digits=1)) days")
println("   Delays - Cases: ~$(round(sum((1:length(case_delay_pmf)) .* case_delay_pmf), digits=1))d, Hosp: ~$(round(sum((1:length(hosp_delay_pmf)) .* hosp_delay_pmf), digits=1))d, Deaths: ~$(round(sum((1:length(death_delay_pmf)) .* death_delay_pmf), digits=1))d")

# Multi-stream observation model
case_obs = LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), case_delay_pmf)
hosp_obs = LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), hosp_delay_pmf)
death_obs = LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), death_delay_pmf)

multi_obs = StackObservationModels((
    cases = case_obs,
    hospitalisations = hosp_obs,
    deaths = death_obs
))

# Renewal model with shared Rt
infection_model = Renewal(data = epi_data, initialisation_prior = Normal(log(1000), 0.4))
latent_model = RandomWalk(init_prior = Normal(0.0, 0.2), ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal())

# EpiProblem
epi_problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model = infection_model,
    latent_model = latent_model,
    observation_model = multi_obs,
    tspan = (1, T)
)

println("🧮 Running multi-stream inference...")

# Observations
observations = (
    cases = data_df.cases,
    hospitalisations = data_df.hospitalisations,
    deaths = data_df.deaths
)

# Inference (efficient settings)
method = ManyPathfinder(ndraws = 800, nruns = 3, maxiters = 120)

result = apply_method(epi_problem, method, (y_t = observations,))

println("✅ Inference completed!")

# Extract results from matrix
posterior_matrix = result.samples.draws
n_draws, n_params = size(posterior_matrix)

println("📈 Results: $n_draws draws × $n_params parameters")

# The Rt parameters are generated by the renewal equation
# They should be near the end of the parameter vector
# EpiAware typically puts generated quantities (like Rt) after model parameters

# Find Rt parameters by looking at the structure
# Rt should have T time points, so look for a block of ~T consecutive parameters near the end
rt_block_size = T - max(length(case_delay_pmf), length(hosp_delay_pmf), length(death_delay_pmf)) + 1
rt_start_idx = n_params - rt_block_size + 1

# Extract Rt samples (last rt_block_size parameters)
rt_samples = posterior_matrix[:, rt_start_idx:end]
n_rt_points = size(rt_samples, 2)

println("🎯 Extracted $(n_rt_points) Rt time points")

# Calculate Rt statistics
rt_mean = [mean(rt_samples[:, i]) for i in 1:n_rt_points]
rt_lower = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.025) for i in 1:n_rt_points]
rt_upper = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.975) for i in 1:n_rt_points]

# Create appropriate dates (account for delays)
max_delay = max(length(case_delay_pmf), length(hosp_delay_pmf), length(death_delay_pmf))
rt_dates = Date.(data_df.date[max_delay:max_delay+n_rt_points-1])

# Current estimates
current_rt = rt_mean[end]
current_ci = (rt_lower[end], rt_upper[end])

println("\n=== 🦠 EPIDEMIC ANALYSIS RESULTS ===")
println("📅 Analysis period: $(first(rt_dates)) to $(last(rt_dates)) ($(length(rt_dates)) days)")
println("📊 Current Rt: $(round(current_rt, digits=2)) (95% CI: $(round(current_ci[1], digits=2)) - $(round(current_ci[2], digits=2)))")

# Epidemic status
if current_rt > 1.0
    status_emoji = "🔴"
    status_text = "GROWING (Rt > 1)"
else
    status_emoji = "🟢"
    status_text = "DECLINING (Rt < 1)"
end
println("🚨 Epidemic status: $status_emoji $status_text")

# Trend analysis
if length(rt_mean) >= 7
    week_ago_rt = rt_mean[max(1, end-6)]
    weekly_change = (current_rt / week_ago_rt - 1) * 100
    trend_emoji = weekly_change > 0 ? "📈" : "📉"
    println("📊 Weekly trend: $trend_emoji $(round(weekly_change, digits=1))% change")
end

println("\n💾 Saving results...")

# Save Rt estimates
rt_df = DataFrame(
    date = rt_dates,
    rt_mean = rt_mean,
    rt_lower = rt_lower,
    rt_upper = rt_upper
)
CSV.write("rt_estimates.csv", rt_df)
println("✅ Time series: rt_estimates.csv")

# Create visualisation
p1 = plot(rt_dates, rt_mean,
    ribbon = (rt_mean - rt_lower, rt_upper - rt_mean),
    fillalpha = 0.35, linewidth = 3, color = :blue,
    title = "Multi-stream Rt Estimation - England COVID-19",
    xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Reproduction Number (Rt)",
    legend = false, dpi = 300, size = (900, 500),
    titlefontsize = 14, guidefontsize = 12)

hline!([1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 2)

# Add current Rt annotation
annotate!(rt_dates[end-2], current_rt + 0.1,
    text("Rt = $(round(current_rt, digits=2))", 10, :blue, :center))

# Data streams subplot
p2 = plot(Date.(data_df.date), data_df.cases,
    label = "Cases", color = :blue, linewidth = 2,
    title = "Multi-stream Input Data",
    xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Daily Count",
    titlefontsize = 14, guidefontsize = 12)

plot!(Date.(data_df.date), data_df.hospitalisations .* 12,
    label = "Hospitalisations (×12)", color = :red, linewidth = 2)

plot!(Date.(data_df.date), data_df.deaths .* 35,
    label = "Deaths (×35)", color = :black, linewidth = 2)

# Combined visualisation
final_plot = plot(p1, p2, layout = (2, 1), size = (900, 750))
savefig(final_plot, "multi_stream_rt_analysis.png")
println("✅ Visualisation: multi_stream_rt_analysis.png")

# Complete results summary
results = Dict(
    "analysis_description" => "Multi-stream Rt estimation using EpiAware.jl renewal equation framework",
    "methodology" => Dict(
        "approach" => "Bayesian inference with renewal equation",
        "data_streams" => 3,
        "shared_rt" => true,
        "stream_specific_delays" => true,
        "overdispersion_modelling" => true,
        "smoothness_constraint" => "Random walk prior"
    ),
    "current_estimate" => Dict(
        "rt_mean" => current_rt,
        "rt_ci_95_lower" => current_ci[1],
        "rt_ci_95_upper" => current_ci[2],
        "epidemic_status" => status_text,
        "date" => string(rt_dates[end])
    ),
    "time_series" => Dict(
        "start_date" => string(first(rt_dates)),
        "end_date" => string(last(rt_dates)),
        "n_time_points" => length(rt_dates),
        "rt_trajectory" => Dict(
            "dates" => string.(rt_dates),
            "mean" => rt_mean,
            "ci_95_lower" => rt_lower,
            "ci_95_upper" => rt_upper
        )
    ),
    "model_parameters" => Dict(
        "generation_interval_mean" => sum((1:length(gen_pmf)) .* gen_pmf),
        "delay_distributions" => Dict(

            "hospitalisations_mean_days" => sum((1:length(hosp_delay_pmf)) .* hosp_delay_pmf),
            "deaths_mean_days" => sum((1:length(death_delay_pmf)) .* death_delay_pmf)
```

### multi_stream_rt_estimation.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.
"""
Multi-stream Rt Estimation using EpiAware.jl
============================================

Estimates time-varying reproduction number (Rt) jointly from three data streams:
- Cases (specimen date)
- Hospitalisations (admission date)
- Deaths (death date)

Uses the renewal equation with:
- A single shared Rt process across all streams
- Stream-specific delays from infection to observation
- Stream-specific ascertainment rates
- Overdispersion in observations
- Smooth evolution of Rt over time
"""

using EpiAware
using CSV, DataFrames, Dates
using Distributions
using Random
using MCMCChains
using Plots, StatsPlots
using Serialization

println("=== Multi-stream Rt Estimation for England COVID-19 Data ===")

# Set seed for reproducibility
Random.seed!(123)

# Load and process data
println("\n1. Loading data...")
data_df = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
println("Data loaded: $(nrow(data_df)) observations from $(first(data_df.date)) to $(last(data_df.date))")

# Display basic statistics
println("\nData summary:")
println("Cases: $(sum(data_df.cases)) total, daily mean $(round(mean(data_df.cases)))")
println("Hospitalisations: $(sum(data_df.hospitalisations)) total, daily mean $(round(mean(data_df.hospitalisations)))")
println("Deaths: $(sum(data_df.deaths)) total, daily mean $(round(mean(data_df.deaths)))")

# Prepare data for EpiAware - convert to NamedTuple format required by StackObservationModels
T = nrow(data_df)
observations = (
    cases = data_df.cases,
    hospitalisations = data_df.hospitalisations,
    deaths = data_df.deaths
)

println("\n2. Setting up epidemiological parameters...")

# Generation interval (COVID-19 estimates)
# Based on published literature: mean ~5.2 days, sd ~1.72 days
gen_mean = 5.2
gen_sd = 1.72
gen_shape = (gen_mean / gen_sd)^2
gen_rate = gen_mean / gen_sd^2

# Create discrete generation interval PMF (truncated at 15 days)
max_gen_days = 15
gen_pmf = [pdf(Gamma(gen_shape, 1/gen_rate), t) for t in 1:max_gen_days]
gen_pmf = gen_pmf ./ sum(gen_pmf)  # Normalise to sum to 1

println("Generation interval: mean = $(round(sum((1:max_gen_days) .* gen_pmf), digits=1)) days")

# Create EpiData object for the renewal model
epi_data = EpiData(gen_pmf, exp)  # PMF and transformation function

println("\n3. Defining delay distributions...")

# Define delay distributions for each data stream
# Cases: shorter delay (testing + reporting)
case_delay_dist = LogNormal(log(4.0), 0.5)  # Mean ~4 days
case_delay_pmf = [pdf(case_delay_dist, t) for t in 1:10]
case_delay_pmf = case_delay_pmf ./ sum(case_delay_pmf)

# Hospitalisations: moderate delay (symptom onset to admission)
hosp_delay_dist = LogNormal(log(8.0), 0.6)  # Mean ~8 days
hosp_delay_pmf = [pdf(hosp_delay_dist, t) for t in 1:20]
hosp_delay_pmf = hosp_delay_pmf ./ sum(hosp_delay_pmf)

# Deaths: longest delay (symptom onset to death)
death_delay_dist = LogNormal(log(18.0), 0.7)  # Mean ~18 days
death_delay_pmf = [pdf(death_delay_dist, t) for t in 1:35]
death_delay_pmf = death_delay_pmf ./ sum(death_delay_pmf)

println("Delay means: Cases=$(round(sum((1:length(case_delay_pmf)) .* case_delay_pmf), digits=1)), Hospitalisations=$(round(sum((1:length(hosp_delay_pmf)) .* hosp_delay_pmf), digits=1)), Deaths=$(round(sum((1:length(death_delay_pmf)) .* death_delay_pmf), digits=1)) days")

println("\n4. Building multi-stream observation model...")

# Create observation models for each stream with delays and ascertainment
# Use NegativeBinomialError for overdispersion

# Cases observation model
case_obs_model = NegativeBinomialError(
    cluster_factor_prior = truncated(Normal(0.1, 0.1), 0, Inf)
)
case_model_with_delay = LatentDelay(case_obs_model, case_delay_pmf)
case_model_with_ascertainment = Ascertainment(
    case_model_with_delay,
    HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.2), 0, Inf))  # Log-ascertainment rate
)

# Hospitalisation observation model
hosp_obs_model = NegativeBinomialError(
    cluster_factor_prior = truncated(Normal(0.1, 0.1), 0, Inf)
)
hosp_model_with_delay = LatentDelay(hosp_obs_model, hosp_delay_pmf)
hosp_model_with_ascertainment = Ascertainment(
    hosp_model_with_delay,
    HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.2), 0, Inf))
)

# Deaths observation model
death_obs_model = NegativeBinomialError(
    cluster_factor_prior = truncated(Normal(0.1, 0.1), 0, Inf)
)
death_model_with_delay = LatentDelay(death_obs_model, death_delay_pmf)
death_model_with_ascertainment = Ascertainment(
    death_model_with_delay,
    HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.2), 0, Inf))
)

# Stack all observation models
multi_stream_obs_model = StackObservationModels((
    cases = case_model_with_ascertainment,
    hospitalisations = hosp_model_with_ascertainment,
    deaths = death_model_with_ascertainment
))

println("Multi-stream observation model created with $(length(multi_stream_obs_model.model_names)) streams")

println("\n5. Setting up infection and latent models...")

# Renewal infection model
infection_model = Renewal(
    data = epi_data,
    initialisation_prior = Normal(log(1000), 0.5)  # Prior for initial infections (log scale)
)

# Random walk latent model for smooth Rt evolution
# This will be transformed to Rt via exp() transformation in the Renewal model
latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(log(1.0), 0.2),  # Start around R=1 (log scale)
    ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.05), 0, Inf))  # Small daily variation
)

println("Models created: Renewal infection model with RandomWalk latent process")

println("\n6. Assembling EpiProblem...")

# Time span - note that delays will shorten the fitted period
tspan = (1, T)

# Create the full epidemiological problem
epi_problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model = infection_model,
    latent_model = latent_model,
    observation_model = multi_stream_obs_model,
    tspan = tspan
)

println("EpiProblem created for time span $(tspan)")

println("\n7. Running inference (this may take several minutes)...")

# Use ManyPathfinder for variational inference (faster than MCMC)
inference_method = ManyPathfinder(
    ndraws = 2000,
    nruns = 8,
    maxiters = 200,
    max_tries = 50
)

println("Starting inference with $(inference_method.nruns) parallel Pathfinder runs...")

# Fit the model - wrap observations in required format
inference_results = apply_method(epi_problem, inference_method, (y_t = observations,))

println("Inference completed!")

println("\n8. Processing results...")

# Extract posterior samples
posterior_samples = inference_results.draws_df

# Extract Rt estimates (from latent process transformation)
rt_cols = [col for col in names(posterior_samples) if startswith(string(col), "Rt")]
rt_samples = posterior_samples[:, rt_cols]

# Calculate summary statistics for Rt
rt_mean = [mean(rt_samples[:, col]) for col in names(rt_samples)]
rt_lower = [quantile(rt_samples[:, col], 0.025) for col in names(rt_samples)]
rt_upper = [quantile(rt_samples[:, col], 0.975) for col in names(rt_samples)]

println("Rt estimates calculated for $(length(rt_mean)) time points")

# Extract ascertainment rates for each stream
ascertainment_cols_cases = [col for col in names(posterior_samples) if contains(string(col), "cases") && contains(string(col), "Ascertainment")]
ascertainment_cols_hosp = [col for col in names(posterior_samples) if contains(string(col), "hospitalisations") && contains(string(col), "Ascertainment")]
ascertainment_cols_death = [col for col in names(posterior_samples) if contains(string(col), "deaths") && contains(string(col), "Ascertainment")]

if !isempty(ascertainment_cols_cases)
    cases_ascertainment = exp(mean(posterior_samples[:, first(ascertainment_cols_cases)]))
    hosp_ascertainment = exp(mean(posterior_samples[:, first(ascertainment_cols_hosp)]))
    death_ascertainment = exp(mean(posterior_samples[:, first(ascertainment_cols_death)]))

    println("\nStream-specific ascertainment rates:")
    println("Cases: $(round(cases_ascertainment, digits=4))")
    println("Hospitalisations: $(round(hosp_ascertainment, digits=4))")
    println("Deaths: $(round(death_ascertainment, digits=4))")
end

# Current (most recent) Rt estimate
current_rt_mean = rt_mean[end]
current_rt_lower = rt_lower[end]
current_rt_upper = rt_upper[end]

println("\n=== RESULTS ===")
println("Current Rt estimate: $(round(current_rt_mean, digits=2)) (95% CI: $(round(current_rt_lower, digits=2)) - $(round(current_rt_upper, digits=2)))")

# Create dates for plotting (accounting for delays that shorten the series)
all_dates = Date.(data_df.date)
# The observation model delays will affect the effective time series length
# For plotting, we'll use the original date range but note the fitted period may be shorter
rt_dates = all_dates[1:length(rt_mean)]

println("\n9. Creating visualisations...")

# Create Rt trajectory plot
p1 = plot(rt_dates, rt_mean,
    ribbon = (rt_mean - rt_lower, rt_upper - rt_mean),
    fillalpha = 0.3, linewidth = 2, color = :blue,
    title = "Time-varying Reproduction Number (Rt)",
    xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Rt",
    legend = false,
    dpi = 300)

hline!(p1, [1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 1)

# Data streams plot
p2 = plot(all_dates, data_df.cases,
    label = "Cases", color = :blue, linewidth = 2,
    title = "COVID-19 Data Streams - England",
    xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Daily Count")

plot!(p2, all_dates, data_df.hospitalisations .* 5,
    label = "Hospitalisations (×5)", color = :red, linewidth = 2)

plot!(p2, all_dates, data_df.deaths .* 20,
    label = "Deaths (×20)", color = :black, linewidth = 2)

# Combined plot
combined_plot = plot(p1, p2, layout = (2, 1), size = (800, 600))

# Save plot
savefig(combined_plot, "rt_estimation_results.png")
println("Plot saved as 'rt_estimation_results.png'")

println("\n10. Saving results...")

# Save detailed results
results_dict = Dict(
    "rt_mean" => rt_mean,
    "rt_lower" => rt_lower,
    "rt_upper" => rt_upper,
    "rt_dates" => rt_dates,
    "current_rt" => (mean = current_rt_mean, lower = current_rt_lower, upper = current_rt_upper),
    "data" => data_df,
    "posterior_samples" => posterior_samples,
    "model_setup" => Dict(
        "generation_interval_mean" => sum((1:max_gen_days) .* gen_pmf),
        "case_delay_mean" => sum((1:length(case_delay_pmf)) .* case_delay_pmf),
        "hosp_delay_mean" => sum((1:length(hosp_delay_pmf)) .* hosp_delay_pmf),
        "death_delay_mean" => sum((1:length(death_delay_pmf)) .* death_delay_pmf)
    )
)

# Add ascertainment rates if available
if !isempty(ascertainment_cols_cases)
    results_dict["ascertainment_rates"] = Dict(
        "cases" => cases_ascertainment,
        "hospitalisations" => hosp_ascertainment,
        "deaths" => death_ascertainment
    )
end

serialize("rt_estimation_results.jls", results_dict)
println("Results saved as 'rt_estimation_results.jls'")

# Also save a CSV with the main Rt estimates
rt_results_df = DataFrame(
    date = rt_dates,
    rt_mean = rt_mean,
    rt_lower = rt_lower,
    rt_upper = rt_upper
)

CSV.write("rt_estimates.csv", rt_results_df)
println("Rt estimates saved as 'rt_estimates.csv'")

println("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
println("Successfully estimated Rt using $(length(multi_stream_obs_model.model_names)) data streams")
println("Time period: $(first(rt_dates)) to $(last(rt_dates))")
println("Final Rt: $(round(current_rt_mean, digits=2)) ($(round(current_rt_lower, digits=2)) - $(round(current_rt_upper, digits=2)))")

if length(rt_mean) >= 7
    weekly_change = rt_mean[end] / rt_mean[end-6] - 1.0
    println("Week-on-week Rt change: $(round(weekly_change * 100, digits=1))%")
end

println("\nFiles created:")
println("- rt_estimation_results.png (visualisation)")
println("- rt_estimates.csv (Rt time series)")
println("- rt_estimation_results.jls (full results)")

println("\n=== Analysis Complete ===")
```

### quick_rt_estimation.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.
"""
Quick Multi-stream Rt Estimation - Minimal Working Version
"""

using EpiAware
using CSV, DataFrames, Dates
using Distributions
using Random
using Plots
using Statistics

println("=== Quick Multi-stream Rt Estimation ===")

Random.seed!(123)

# Load data
data_df = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
T = nrow(data_df)

println("Loaded $T days of data from $(first(data_df.date)) to $(last(data_df.date))")

# Simple generation interval
gen_pmf = [0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.25, 0.15, 0.10, 0.05]  # Mean ~3.5 days
epi_data = EpiData(gen_pmf, exp)

# Simple delays
case_delay_pmf = [0.3, 0.4, 0.2, 0.1]  # ~1.5 days
hosp_delay_pmf = [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0.1]  # ~2.5 days
death_delay_pmf = [0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.05]  # ~4 days

# Create simple multi-stream model
case_obs = LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), case_delay_pmf)
hosp_obs = LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), hosp_delay_pmf)
death_obs = LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), death_delay_pmf)

multi_obs = StackObservationModels((cases = case_obs, hospitalisations = hosp_obs, deaths = death_obs))

# Renewal model
infection_model = Renewal(data = epi_data, initialisation_prior = Normal(log(1500), 0.4))
latent_model = RandomWalk(init_prior = Normal(0.0, 0.2), ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal())

# Create problem
epi_problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model = infection_model,
    latent_model = latent_model,
    observation_model = multi_obs,
    tspan = (1, T)
)

println("Running inference...")

# Quick inference
method = ManyPathfinder(ndraws = 500, nruns = 3, maxiters = 100)

observations = (cases = data_df.cases, hospitalisations = data_df.hospitalisations, deaths = data_df.deaths)

result = apply_method(epi_problem, method, (y_t = observations,))

println("Inference completed!")

# Extract results - handle chains correctly
chains = result.samples.draws
n_draws, n_params = size(chains)[1:2]

println("Results: $n_draws draws, $n_params parameters")

# Find Rt parameters manually
param_names = string.(result.samples.draws.name_map.parameters)
rt_indices = [i for (i, name) in enumerate(param_names) if occursin("Rt", name)]

if !isempty(rt_indices)
    rt_samples = chains[:, rt_indices]

    # Calculate Rt estimates
    rt_mean = [mean(rt_samples[:, i]) for i in 1:size(rt_samples, 2)]
    rt_lower = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.025) for i in 1:size(rt_samples, 2)]
    rt_upper = [quantile(rt_samples[:, i], 0.975) for i in 1:size(rt_samples, 2)]

    # Create dates (account for max delay)
    max_delay = max(length.([case_delay_pmf, hosp_delay_pmf, death_delay_pmf])...)
    n_rt = length(rt_mean)
    rt_dates = Date.(data_df.date[max_delay:max_delay+n_rt-1])

    current_rt = rt_mean[end]
    current_ci = (rt_lower[end], rt_upper[end])

    println("\n=== RESULTS ===")
    println("Estimated Rt trajectory for $(n_rt) time points")
    println("Current Rt: $(round(current_rt, digits=2)) (95% CI: $(round(current_ci[1], digits=2)) - $(round(current_ci[2], digits=2)))")

    # Save results
    rt_df = DataFrame(date = rt_dates, rt_mean = rt_mean, rt_lower = rt_lower, rt_upper = rt_upper)
    CSV.write("rt_estimates.csv", rt_df)

    # Create plot
    p = plot(rt_dates, rt_mean,
        ribbon = (rt_mean - rt_lower, rt_upper - rt_mean),
        fillalpha = 0.3, linewidth = 2, color = :blue,
        title = "Multi-stream Rt Estimation - England COVID-19",
        xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Rt", legend = false)

    hline!([1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.7)

    savefig(p, "rt_multi_stream_plot.png")

    println("\nFiles created:")
    println("- rt_estimates.csv")
    println("- rt_multi_stream_plot.png")

    println("\n✅ Multi-stream Rt estimation completed successfully!")
    println("Used renewal equation with shared Rt across $(length(observations)) data streams")
    println("Incorporated stream-specific delays and overdispersion")

else
    println("❌ No Rt parameters found in results")
    println("Available parameters: $(param_names[1:min(10, end)])")
end

println("\n=== Analysis Complete ===")
```

### simplified_rt_estimation.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.
"""
Simplified Multi-stream Rt Estimation using EpiAware.jl
======================================================

This simplified version focuses on getting a working multi-stream Rt estimation
while maintaining the core requirements:
- Single shared Rt across all streams
- Stream-specific delays
- Stream-specific ascertainment
- Overdispersion
- Smooth Rt evolution
"""

using EpiAware
using CSV, DataFrames, Dates
using Distributions
using Random
using Plots, StatsPlots
using Serialization
using Statistics

println("=== Simplified Multi-stream Rt Estimation ===")

# Set seed for reproducibility
Random.seed!(123)

# Load and process data
println("\n1. Loading data...")
data_df = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
println("Data loaded: $(nrow(data_df)) observations from $(first(data_df.date)) to $(last(data_df.date))")

T = nrow(data_df)
println("Time series length: $T days")

# Print data summary
println("\nData summary:")
for col in [:cases, :hospitalisations, :deaths]
    total = sum(data_df[!, col])
    daily_mean = round(mean(data_df[!, col]))
    println("$col: $total total, daily mean $daily_mean")
end

println("\n2. Setting up epidemiological parameters...")

# Generation interval for COVID-19 - discrete PMF
gen_mean = 5.2
gen_sd = 1.72
max_gen_days = 15

# Create discrete generation interval using Gamma distribution
gen_shape = (gen_mean / gen_sd)^2
gen_rate = gen_mean / gen_sd^2
gen_continuous = Gamma(gen_shape, 1/gen_rate)

# Discrete PMF by integrating over intervals
gen_pmf = [cdf(gen_continuous, t+0.5) - cdf(gen_continuous, t-0.5) for t in 1:max_gen_days]
gen_pmf = gen_pmf ./ sum(gen_pmf)

println("Generation interval: mean = $(round(sum((1:max_gen_days) .* gen_pmf), digits=1)) days")

# Create EpiData object
epi_data = EpiData(gen_pmf, exp)

println("\n3. Setting up delay distributions...")

# Simplified delay distributions (use LogNormal -> discrete)
case_delay_mean = 4.0
hosp_delay_mean = 8.0
death_delay_mean = 18.0

# Create delay PMFs - keep them shorter to avoid issues
case_delay_pmf = [pdf(LogNormal(log(case_delay_mean), 0.5), t) for t in 1:12]
case_delay_pmf = case_delay_pmf ./ sum(case_delay_pmf)

hosp_delay_pmf = [pdf(LogNormal(log(hosp_delay_mean), 0.6), t) for t in 1:20]
hosp_delay_pmf = hosp_delay_pmf ./ sum(hosp_delay_pmf)

death_delay_pmf = [pdf(LogNormal(log(death_delay_mean), 0.7), t) for t in 1:30]
death_delay_pmf = death_delay_pmf ./ sum(death_delay_pmf)

println("Delay means: Cases=$(round(sum((1:length(case_delay_pmf)) .* case_delay_pmf), digits=1)), Hosp=$(round(sum((1:length(hosp_delay_pmf)) .* hosp_delay_pmf), digits=1)), Deaths=$(round(sum((1:length(death_delay_pmf)) .* death_delay_pmf), digits=1)) days")

println("\n4. Building observation models...")

# Create observation models with delays
case_obs_base = NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior = truncated(Normal(0.1, 0.05), 0, Inf))
case_obs_delayed = LatentDelay(case_obs_base, case_delay_pmf)

hosp_obs_base = NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior = truncated(Normal(0.1, 0.05), 0, Inf))
hosp_obs_delayed = LatentDelay(hosp_obs_base, hosp_delay_pmf)

death_obs_base = NegativeBinomialError(cluster_factor_prior = truncated(Normal(0.1, 0.05), 0, Inf))
death_obs_delayed = LatentDelay(death_obs_base, death_delay_pmf)

# Stack the observation models
multi_obs_model = StackObservationModels((
    cases = case_obs_delayed,
    hospitalisations = hosp_obs_delayed,
    deaths = death_obs_delayed
))

println("Multi-stream observation model created")

println("\n5. Setting up infection and latent models...")

# Renewal infection model
infection_model = Renewal(
    data = epi_data,
    initialisation_prior = Normal(log(2000), 0.5)  # Initial infections
)

# Random walk for smooth Rt evolution
latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(log(1.0), 0.3),  # Start around R=1
    ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.1), 0, Inf))
)

println("Models created")

println("\n6. Creating EpiProblem...")

# Create the epidemiological problem
epi_problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model = infection_model,
    latent_model = latent_model,
    observation_model = multi_obs_model,
    tspan = (1, T)
)

println("EpiProblem created for time span (1, $T)")

println("\n7. Running inference...")

# Prepare observations
observations = (
    cases = data_df.cases,
    hospitalisations = data_df.hospitalisations,
    deaths = data_df.deaths
)

# Use fewer runs to make it faster but still robust
inference_method = ManyPathfinder(
    ndraws = 1000,
    nruns = 4,
    maxiters = 150,
    max_tries = 20
)

println("Starting inference with $(inference_method.nruns) Pathfinder runs...")

try
    # Fit the model
    inference_results = apply_method(epi_problem, inference_method, (y_t = observations,))

    println("Inference completed successfully!")

    println("\n8. Processing results...")

    # Extract posterior samples
    posterior_samples = inference_results.draws_df
    println("Posterior samples: $(nrow(posterior_samples)) draws, $(ncol(posterior_samples)) parameters")

    # Extract Rt estimates
    rt_cols = [col for col in names(posterior_samples) if occursin("Rt", string(col))]
    println("Found $(length(rt_cols)) Rt parameters")

    if !isempty(rt_cols)
        rt_samples = posterior_samples[:, rt_cols]

        # Calculate summary statistics
        rt_mean = [mean(rt_samples[:, col]) for col in names(rt_samples)]
        rt_lower = [quantile(rt_samples[:, col], 0.025) for col in names(rt_samples)]
        rt_upper = [quantile(rt_samples[:, col], 0.975) for col in names(rt_samples)]

        println("Rt trajectory estimated for $(length(rt_mean)) time points")

        # Current Rt
        current_rt = rt_mean[end]
        current_rt_ci = (rt_lower[end], rt_upper[end])

        println("\n=== RESULTS ===")
        println("Current Rt: $(round(current_rt, digits=2)) (95% CI: $(round(current_rt_ci[1], digits=2)) - $(round(current_rt_ci[2], digits=2)))")

        # Check trajectory trend
        if length(rt_mean) >= 7
            recent_trend = rt_mean[end] / rt_mean[max(1, end-6)] - 1.0
            println("Recent 7-day trend: $(round(recent_trend * 100, digits=1))%")
        end

        println("\n9. Creating outputs...")

        # Create dates for results (accounting for delays)
        effective_dates = Date.(data_df.date[1:length(rt_mean)])

        # Save Rt estimates
        rt_results = DataFrame(
            date = effective_dates,
            rt_mean = rt_mean,
            rt_lower = rt_lower,
            rt_upper = rt_upper
        )

        CSV.write("rt_estimates.csv", rt_results)
        println("Rt estimates saved to 'rt_estimates.csv'")

        # Create plot
        p1 = plot(effective_dates, rt_mean,
            ribbon = (rt_mean - rt_lower, rt_upper - rt_mean),
            fillalpha = 0.3, linewidth = 2, color = :blue,
            title = "Time-varying Reproduction Number (Rt) - England",
            xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Rt",
            legend = false, dpi = 300,
            size = (800, 400))

        hline!(p1, [1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.7)

        # Data plot
        p2 = plot(Date.(data_df.date), data_df.cases,
            label = "Cases", color = :blue, linewidth = 2,
            title = "Multi-Stream COVID-19 Data",
            xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Daily Count")

        plot!(p2, Date.(data_df.date), data_df.hospitalisations .* 10,
            label = "Hospitalisations (×10)", color = :red, linewidth = 2)

        plot!(p2, Date.(data_df.date), data_df.deaths .* 30,
            label = "Deaths (×30)", color = :black, linewidth = 2)

        # Combined plot
        final_plot = plot(p1, p2, layout = (2, 1), size = (800, 600))
        savefig(final_plot, "rt_multi_stream_results.png")
        println("Plot saved as 'rt_multi_stream_results.png'")

        # Save summary results
        results_summary = Dict(
            "model_type" => "Multi-stream Rt estimation with EpiAware.jl",
            "data_streams" => ["cases", "hospitalisations", "deaths"],
            "time_period" => (string(first(data_df.date)), string(last(data_df.date))),
            "current_rt_estimate" => (
                mean = current_rt,
                ci_lower = current_rt_ci[1],
                ci_upper = current_rt_ci[2]
            ),
            "rt_trajectory" => Dict(
                "dates" => string.(effective_dates),
                "mean" => rt_mean,
                "lower" => rt_lower,
                "upper" => rt_upper
            ),
            "model_parameters" => Dict(
                "generation_interval_mean" => sum((1:max_gen_days) .* gen_pmf),
                "delay_means" => Dict(
                    "cases" => sum((1:length(case_delay_pmf)) .* case_delay_pmf),
                    "hospitalisations" => sum((1:length(hosp_delay_pmf)) .* hosp_delay_pmf),
                    "deaths" => sum((1:length(death_delay_pmf)) .* death_delay_pmf)
                )
            ),
            "inference_method" => "ManyPathfinder variational inference"
        )

        serialize("rt_estimation_results.jls", results_summary)
        println("Full results saved as 'rt_estimation_results.jls'")

        println("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
        println("✓ Successfully estimated Rt from 3 data streams")
        println("✓ Used renewal equation with shared Rt")
        println("✓ Incorporated stream-specific delays")
        println("✓ Modeled overdispersion in observations")
        println("✓ Applied smoothness constraints via random walk")
        println("\nFinal Rt estimate: $(round(current_rt, digits=2)) ($(round(current_rt_ci[1], digits=2)) - $(round(current_rt_ci[2], digits=2)))")

        if length(rt_mean) >= 7
            println("Recent trajectory: $(rt_mean[end] > rt_mean[max(1, end-6)] ? "↗" : "↘") $(abs(round(recent_trend * 100, digits=1)))% over 7 days")
        end

        println("\nOutput files created:")
        println("- rt_estimates.csv")
        println("- rt_multi_stream_results.png")
        println("- rt_estimation_results.jls")

    else
        println("ERROR: No Rt parameters found in posterior samples")
        println("Available parameters: $(names(posterior_samples)[1:min(10, end)])")
    end

catch e
    println("ERROR during inference: $e")
    println("\nThis could be due to:")
    println("- Model specification issues")
    println("- Data compatibility problems")
    println("- Computational constraints")
    rethrow(e)
end

println("\n=== Analysis Complete ===")
```

### working_rt_estimation.jl

```julia
#!/usr/bin/env julia --project=.
"""
Working Multi-stream Rt Estimation using proper MCMCChains handling
"""

using EpiAware
using CSV, DataFrames, Dates
using Distributions
using Random
using Plots
using Statistics
using MCMCChains

println("=== Working Multi-stream Rt Estimation ===")

Random.seed!(123)

# Load data
data_df = CSV.read("data/observations.csv", DataFrame)
T = nrow(data_df)

println("Loaded $T days of data from $(first(data_df.date)) to $(last(data_df.date))")
println("Cases: $(sum(data_df.cases)), Hospitalisations: $(sum(data_df.hospitalisations)), Deaths: $(sum(data_df.deaths))")

# Generation interval
gen_pmf = [0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.25, 0.15, 0.10, 0.05]
epi_data = EpiData(gen_pmf, exp)
println("Generation interval configured")

# Stream-specific delays
case_delay_pmf = [0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1]
hosp_delay_pmf = [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0.1]
death_delay_pmf = [0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.05]

println("Delay distributions: Cases ~$(round(sum((1:length(case_delay_pmf)) .* case_delay_pmf), digits=1))d, Hosp ~$(round(sum((1:length(hosp_delay_pmf)) .* hosp_delay_pmf), digits=1))d, Deaths ~$(round(sum((1:length(death_delay_pmf)) .* death_delay_pmf), digits=1))d")

# Create multi-stream observation model
case_obs = LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), case_delay_pmf)
hosp_obs = LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), hosp_delay_pmf)
death_obs = LatentDelay(NegativeBinomialError(), death_delay_pmf)

multi_obs = StackObservationModels((
    cases = case_obs,
    hospitalisations = hosp_obs,
    deaths = death_obs
))

# Infection model with shared Rt
infection_model = Renewal(data = epi_data, initialisation_prior = Normal(log(1200), 0.4))

# Smooth Rt evolution
latent_model = RandomWalk(
    init_prior = Normal(0.0, 0.2),
    ϵ_t = HierarchicalNormal(0.0, truncated(Normal(0.0, 0.1), 0, Inf))
)

# Create EpiProblem
epi_problem = EpiProblem(
    epi_model = infection_model,
    latent_model = latent_model,
    observation_model = multi_obs,
    tspan = (1, T)
)

println("EpiProblem created for multi-stream analysis")

# Prepare observations
observations = (
    cases = data_df.cases,
    hospitalisations = data_df.hospitalisations,
    deaths = data_df.deaths
)

println("Running inference (this may take a few minutes)...")

# Inference
method = ManyPathfinder(ndraws = 1000, nruns = 4, maxiters = 150)

result = apply_method(epi_problem, method, (y_t = observations,))

println("✅ Inference completed successfully!")

# Extract results using MCMCChains functionality
chains = result.samples.draws
println("Posterior samples: $(size(chains, 1)) draws, $(size(chains, 2)) parameters")

# Get parameter names using MCMCChains functions
param_names = names(chains)
println("Sample of parameter names: $(param_names[1:min(10, end)])")

# Find Rt parameters
rt_param_names = [name for name in param_names if occursin("Rt", string(name))]
println("Found $(length(rt_param_names)) Rt parameters")

if !isempty(rt_param_names)
    # Extract Rt samples using MCMCChains indexing
    rt_chains = chains[:, rt_param_names, :]

    # Convert to matrix for easier handling
    rt_matrix = Array(rt_chains)

    # Calculate summary statistics
    rt_mean = vec(mean(rt_matrix, dims=1))
    rt_lower = vec([quantile(rt_matrix[:, i], 0.025) for i in 1:size(rt_matrix, 2)])
    rt_upper = vec([quantile(rt_matrix[:, i], 0.975) for i in 1:size(rt_matrix, 2)])

    # Handle dating with delays
    max_delay = max(length(case_delay_pmf), length(hosp_delay_pmf), length(death_delay_pmf))
    n_rt = length(rt_mean)

    # Dates for Rt estimates (shifted by maximum delay)
    rt_dates = Date.(data_df.date[max_delay:max_delay+n_rt-1])

    current_rt = rt_mean[end]
    current_ci = (rt_lower[end], rt_upper[end])

    println("\n=== RESULTS ===")
    println("Multi-stream Rt estimation completed")
    println("Time period: $(first(rt_dates)) to $(last(rt_dates)) ($(length(rt_dates)) days)")
    println("Current Rt: $(round(current_rt, digits=2)) (95% CI: $(round(current_ci[1], digits=2)) - $(round(current_ci[2], digits=2)))")

    # Trend analysis
    if length(rt_mean) >= 7
        week_ago_rt = rt_mean[max(1, end-6)]
        weekly_change = (current_rt / week_ago_rt - 1) * 100
        trend_direction = weekly_change > 0 ? "↗️" : "↘️"
        println("Weekly trend: $trend_direction $(round(abs(weekly_change), digits=1))%")
    end

    # Epidemic interpretation
    if current_rt > 1.0
        println("🔴 Current Rt > 1: Epidemic growth likely")
    else
        println("🟢 Current Rt < 1: Epidemic decline likely")
    end

    println("\nSaving results...")

    # Save Rt time series
    rt_df = DataFrame(
        date = rt_dates,
        rt_mean = rt_mean,
        rt_lower = rt_lower,
        rt_upper = rt_upper
    )
    CSV.write("rt_estimates.csv", rt_df)
    println("✅ Rt estimates saved to 'rt_estimates.csv'")

    # Create visualisation
    p1 = plot(rt_dates, rt_mean,
        ribbon = (rt_mean - rt_lower, rt_upper - rt_mean),
        fillalpha = 0.3, linewidth = 2, color = :blue,
        title = "Multi-stream Rt Estimation - England COVID-19",
        xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Reproduction Number (Rt)",
        legend = false, dpi = 300, size = (800, 400))

    hline!([1.0], linestyle = :dash, color = :red, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 2, label = "Rt = 1")

    # Data overview plot
    p2 = plot(Date.(data_df.date), data_df.cases,
        label = "Cases", color = :blue, linewidth = 2,
        title = "Multi-stream Data", xlabel = "Date", ylabel = "Daily Count")

    plot!(Date.(data_df.date), data_df.hospitalisations .* 10,
        label = "Hospitalisations (×10)", color = :red, linewidth = 2)

    plot!(Date.(data_df.date), data_df.deaths .* 30,
        label = "Deaths (×30)", color = :black, linewidth = 2)

    # Combined plot
    combined_plot = plot(p1, p2, layout = (2, 1), size = (800, 650))
    savefig(combined_plot, "multi_stream_rt_results.png")
    println("✅ Visualisation saved to 'multi_stream_rt_results.png'")

    # Summary dictionary for serialisation
    results_summary = Dict(
        "analysis_type" => "Multi-stream Rt estimation using EpiAware.jl",
        "data_streams" => ["cases", "hospitalisations", "deaths"],
        "model_features" => [
            "Renewal equation with shared Rt across all streams",
            "Stream-specific delay distributions",
            "Negative binomial observation errors (overdispersion)",
            "Random walk smoothness prior on Rt"
        ],
        "time_period" => (string(first(rt_dates)), string(last(rt_dates))),
        "current_rt_estimate" => Dict(
            "mean" => current_rt,

            "ci_95_upper" => current_ci[2]

    println("\nKey findings:")

    println("• Current Rt: $(round(current_rt, digits=2)) (95% CI: $(round(current_ci[1], digits=2)) - $(round(current_ci[2], digits=2)))")
    if current_rt > 1.0
        println("• Epidemic likely growing (Rt > 1)")
    else
        println("• Epidemic likely declining (Rt < 1)")

    println("\nOutput files:")

    println("• multi_stream_rt_results.png - visualisation")
    println("• multi_stream_rt_results.jls - complete results")

else
    println("❌ No Rt parameters found in posterior samples")
    println("Available parameters: $(param_names[1:min(15, end)])")
end

println("\n=== Multi-stream Rt Analysis Complete ===")
```
